articleTitle: Hepatitis C Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Hepatitis C virus (HCV), which affects millions of people globally is a serious global health issue. Effective management and diagnosis of HCV infection depend on early detection and precise prediction of its effects. The historical patient data that comprises demographic data (e.g., age, gender), clinical data (e.g., symptoms, medical history), and laboratory results (e.g., viral load, liver function tests) is used to train logistic regression models. Logistic regression methods calculate the chance or probability of HCV infection, disease progression, or treatment response by analyzing these factors. Logistic regression models provide targeted treatments and public health planning by prioritizing prevention efforts and resource allocation by considering factors like age, gender, lifestyle, and location. In order to accurately anticipate and categories diseases, machine learning (ML) techniques are frequently applied, serving as a useful tool for doctors and specialists. In this study, we suggest that to improve accuracy, a different model should be trained for each scenario. We made use of the accessible real-world data. The 615 patients in the collected dataset have 13 different traits. For model evaluation, the logistic regression approach has been used. The accuracy of the logistic regression model was initially 88.66%; however, it was increased to 90.24% after the hyper parameter values were changed.

articleTitle: Real-Time Hand Signal Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper aims at developing a robust hand signal detection system using the popular deep learning framework of TensorFlow. By harnessing the power of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), the study endeavors to achieve real-time, accurate, and efficient recognition of hand signals from video or image data. The dataset serves as the foundation for training a CNN model using TensorFlow. Through the process of training, the model learns to extract discriminative features associated with different hand signals. Various pre-processing techniques, including data augmentation, normalization, and resizing are employed to enhance the model’s ability to generalize across different variations of hand signals. The developed hand signal detection system utilizes the trained CNN model for inference. Input video or image data is fed into the model, which analyzes and classifies hand signals based on the learned features. To enhance the real-time performance of the system, optimization techniques such as model quantization and hardware acceleration are explored and implemented. Performance metrics such as accuracy(96.5%), precision(0.91), recall(0.94), and F1-Score(0.92) are measured to assess the effectiveness and efficiency of the developed system and same results are declared in the result section.

articleTitle: Coordinate Attention Mechanism with Convolutional Neural Network for Tomato Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The tomatoes are worldwide grown important vegetable and taken as economic pillar of several states. Although, plants are susceptible to diversity of weakness which minimize and affect generation of healthy plant, made accurate and initial identification of this disease is challenging. By using of cutting-edge and computer vision gives a solution of this problems. In this research, the Coordinate Attention Mechanism (CAM) with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed for detecting tomato leaf disease. The dataset utilized for the research is plant village dataset and data pre-processing are performed. The detection and classification of tomato leaf disease is performed by proposed CAM with CNN method. The proposed method is evaluated with performance measures of accuracy (%), precision (%), recall (%) and f1-score (%). The proposed method attained huge accuracy of 99.98%, precision of 99.45% and recall of 99.53% which is superior than other existing methods like Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Multinomial Logistic Regression (MLR), CNN based Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Faster Region based Convolutional Neural Network (Faster-RCNN).

Author Keywords: Plant Village and Tomato Leaf Disease

articleTitle: Automatic Synthesis of Realistic Images From Text using DC-Generative Adversarial Network (DCGAN)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Automatic Conversion of text to realistic images is an interesting, amazing and useful technique. There are several methodologies proposed by many researchers in achieving this but none of them have addressed this effectively. They lack efficiency in terms of images generated in terms of quality or precision. This work intends to generate realistic and semantically correct images from the given input text. Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) are used to convert human written description text into its corresponding image pixels. The model is designed to initially learn the features hidden in text to capture the unique visual details. These factors are further used to synthesize semantically correct images which humans might mistake for real images. The data set, the Oxford 102 flower dataset is used which has at least five text descriptions describing the image. The specific Deep Convolutional - Generative Adversarial Network consisting of a Generator and a Discriminator is used to implement the proposed model. DC-GAN is a direct extension of the GAN which explicitly uses convolutional and convolutional-transpose layers in the discriminator and generator. The aim is to train the DC-GAN model to produce compelling and accurate images for the corresponding input description. The clarity of the image obtained is directly proportional to the number of epochs the model was trained for. The greater the number of epochs the model is trained, the better the efficiency/clarity of the image. The model is evaluated for the various performance metrics. The model is evaluated based on the image clarity obtained and the context of image generation. The performance of the model is measured based on the clarity of the images generated and the context for which the image was generated.

articleTitle: A Neural Style Transfer Network for Image Augmentation of Corn Leaves using Convoluvational Neural Netwok
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: We proposed a novel style transfer network using a convolutional neural network for creating augmented corn leaf images in this article. The proposed network is called the Six Convoluvational Layered Neural Style Transfer (6C-NST) Network. The proposed 6C-NST model consists of six convolutional layers and five maxpooling layers. The 6C-NST was trained on the corn leaf disease dataset to create the augmented images. There are 1346 images created by the proposed 6C-NST network. The 6C-NST network created images that are used to balance the corn leaf disease dataset. The classification performance of the augmented dataset was compared with the original dataset using pre-trained models such as AlexNet, VGG16Net, and InceptionV3Net. The classification accuracy of the augmented dataset trained by AlexNet, VGG16Net, and InceptionV3Net was 93.47, 96.27 and, 97.82 respectively. the The results show that the standard transfer learning techniques performed better on the augmented dataset than on the original dataset. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed 6C-NST model created an augmented dataset that improved the performance of the classification techniques.

articleTitle: Medicine Drug Name Detection Object Recognition using Deep Learning based OCR System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In a digital picture, such as a photo, document, or any other image with tags or steps, OCR is a system that can identify characters like letters, numbers, and symbols. Pre- processing is the initial stage in which the EAST pre-processes images to improve the chances of successful detection. The EAST (Efficient and Accurate Scene Text) algorithm is a deep learning-based method for detecting and recognizing text in images. EAST is known for its speed and accuracy in handling text detection tasks in various applications, such as OCR (Optical Character Recognition). The Tesseract model is an optical character recognition engine which finds pixels, letters, words and sentences. OCR can be employed to extract text from images of medicine labels. The name of the drug is extracted from the label using the EAST and Tesseract models, which help low-vision individuals read the medication name.

articleTitle: Unlocking 5G Potential: Exploring a Single-Layer MIMO Antenna for Enhanced Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This article presents a hexagonal Multiple Input-Multiple Output (MIMO) antenna designed for 5G at 27.5 GHz in the mm-wave spectrum. With soaring data demands, the 28 GHz mm-wave band is vital for high data rates and minimal air attenuation. The hexagonal MIMO antenna efficiently mitigates interference while maintaining a compact design. Utilizing MIMO technology to its fullest, the antenna delivers substantial enhancements in system performance. It achieves exceptional isolation, surpassing -29dB across the entire operating bandwidth, and boasts an impressive peak gain of 6.06dBi. The proposed antenna has robust performance with 89% of overall efficiency and minimal return loss. Beyond 5G, this antenna holds promise in AI applications, serving as a wireless signal collector for critical feature extraction. Notably, in radar data collection, it aids object identification and tracking, critical in autonomous vehicles, aviation, and defense. This article quantifies the antenna’s advantages, emphasizing its role in advancing 5G and its potential in enhancing AI systems. In summary, the hexagonal MIMO antenna is a high-performing solution poised to revolutionize 5G communication and open new vistas in AI signal processing.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Model for Blended Learning of University English Based On K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the context of the new economic era, both the development and application of new technologies have put forward higher requirements for the cultivation of talents in colleges and universities. In order to address the shortcomings of the existing research on the dynamic model of blended learning of university English, this paper briefly introduces the learning support design and behavioral science theories as well as the K-means clustering algorithm. After the discussion of the selection of data collection and online learning behavior metrics for the university English blended learning platform, the blended learning model of the university English online platform and the evaluation model of the university English blended learning platform based on the K-means clustering algorithm are designed, and the clustering results of students’ learning behaviors calculated by the K-means clustering algorithm show that 128 learners have a completion degree of less than 0.8 in the five indicators. The K-mean clustering algorithm was verified to be effective in mining and analyzing learner’s behavioral characteristics.

articleTitle: E-waste—Study of Environmental Impacts and Waste Management Practices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Technologica1 advancements have brought forward a massive use of electronic devices especially smartphones and laptops. Over 300 million consumer electronic devices become obsolete each year, and this is only in the United States of America. E-waste output is expected to reach 20–25 million tonnes per year globally. Many governments have been driven to develop and adopt ecologically sound management techniques and collection systems for E-waste management in order to avoid environmental damage and increase re-use, recovery, and recycling of valuable materials as a result of the e-waste crisis. This first section of this paper gives the reader an overview of the topic e-waste. The first section will look at the definition of e-waste, what it is composed of and how much is generated in different countries. The second part will cover the health hazards and the environmental impacts of electronic waste. It looks at the effects of heavy metals found in electronic waste, how they reach the soil, plants, water bodies, seafood and into the human bodies. The health effects of these metals are also discussed. Finally, the third part discusses the management practices put by a few countries and multinational companies to reduce e-waste in our environment.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Techniques to Determine DDR5 SDRAM I/O Buffer’s Slew Rate at Different PVT Variations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This study focuses on optimizing specialized input/output (I/O) buffers for DDR5 SDRAMs, specifically examining slew rate variations due to Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) variations. Using advanced techniques like Generalized Regression Neural Network (GRNN) and Genetic Algorithms (GA), the research models slew rate (SR) changes under diverse PVT variations. The dataset taken from simulations has been partitioned into two distinct sections, namely the training set and testing set, with proportions of 80% and 20% respectively. The simulation yields comparative outcomes for the real and anticipated SR. Furthermore, GA exhibits superior performance in forecasting slew rate when compared to GRNN. The regression value yields a significantly closer approximation to unity, thereby achieving a better fit to the dataset. The R2 coefficient of 0.98705 indicates a strong linear relationship between the provided dataset and the line of best fit. Surprisingly, based on the model, a temperature detector circuit was found redundant, resulting in substantial power and area savings. However, voltage variations significantly impacted slew rate. A voltage detector design is therefore recommended. This research advances I/O buffer optimization, offering crucial insights into temperature, voltage, and slew rate dynamics.

articleTitle: Product Automatic Design Process Detection System based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Automatic product design is an effective strategic demand design method to meet the diversified needs of customers, and it is the clustering result of market demand and competition. With the development of information society and the further popularization of e-commerce, products have become an important part of people's daily life. However, many companies that adopt agile and iterative methods for software development find that manual or manual testing is likely to encounter many timeliness problems due to accelerated code change. Therefore, this paper studies the product automatic design process DS based on genetic algorithm(GA). The theory and development of automatic test technology and the design of functional automatic test subsystem architecture are analyzed; A GA is proposed and applied to the overall architecture design of the product automatic design process detection system(DS), which improves the detection efficiency of the system, realizes the basic functions required by the system, and achieves the expected effect as a whole.

articleTitle: Light Pollution Assessment Decision Model Based on Entropy Weight Topsis and Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Based on recent global night scene data, this study explores the relationship between light pollution and factors such as population, economy, environment, and geographical location. By utilizing indicators such as EKC-GDP (regression-based GDP index), artificial light intensity (LP), population density, nearest distance from the coastline, and vegetation coverage, an evaluation model for light pollution level is established using the Entropy-TOPSIS method, and a decision tree classification model is constructed to categorize the study area into three categories: A, B, and C. Three strategies are developed based on characteristics of each category: the Dark City Strategy, the Green Space Strategy, and the Bright Light Strategy. Our model is not sensitive to the change of artificial light intensity, and can be applied to a variety of areas with different degrees of light pollution. We believe that the model is stable, and the three classification results and three governance strategies can be applied to the global scope.

articleTitle: Design of Distribution Network Operation and Maintenance Mode based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the increasing scale and complexity of power distribution networks, traditional operational maintenance approaches are no longer able to meet the requirements of stable, reliable, and efficient management. The design of power distribution network operational maintenance models based on deep learning has become a hot topic of research. This article will discuss how to utilize deep learning technology to design operational maintenance models for power distribution networks, aiming to improve their reliability and operational efficiency. Specifically, deep learning can be applied in fault detection and diagnosis, load forecasting, and equipment status monitoring in power distribution networks. By leveraging these applications, the power distribution system can more accurately detect and diagnose faults, predict load variations, and monitor equipment statuses, thereby enhancing the network’s stability and efficiency. The results indicate that the deep learning-based power distribution network operation and maintenance model achieves an accuracy rate of over 95%, significantly improving the reliability and operational efficiency of the network. It outperforms traditional particle swarm algorithms, providing important references and guidance for the practical maintenance of power distribution networks.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Design System for Product Packaging Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In response to the problem of low recognition accuracy of traditional sanitary ware product packaging systems for right angle valve products, inability to accurately obtain product position and posture, resulting in poor product packaging effectiveness, the author designs a virtual design system for sanitary ware product packaging based on machine vision. After obtaining sanitary ware images through industrial cameras and robots, the system elaborates on the hardware design structure and software design process, and analyzes the principles and processes of machine vision inspection systems. The inspection results show that the missing and passing inspection rates of the sanitary ware product packaging quality inspection system using machine vision are within 0.02% and 0.05%, respectively, which can achieve a high production process recognition rate and meet the packaging requirements of sanitary ware products, it is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Mobile-Based Charity Application with the Implementation of Internet-of-Things (IoT) For the Need to Feed the Need (NGO)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Studies have been performed to gain a thorough understanding on the current issues of poverty in Malaysia and the common initiative taken by the community in helping the poor. With the numerous numbers of urban poverty population in Kuala Lumpur, The Need to Feed the Need (NFN) was established as Malaysian NGO body to help in the fight of urban poverty issue by handing out free necessities to the poverty plus with the help of volunteers. Currently, the NFN does have a limited channel to reach out the community to attract people on their good cause and has restricted time and venue to conduct their activities. Primary researches were initiated via interviews and surveys to investigate the NFN ways of handling the activities and identify the communities’ interest in helping the poor with NFN. Results and analysis have proven that the communities are still lacking of the awareness towards the situation of urban poverty and how the NFN and communities are agreed with the integration of mobile application and IoT technologies to improvise the NFN’s current business methods that could allow them to contribute to the urban poverty positively.

Author Keywords: The Need to Feed the Need

articleTitle: Design of a College Student Employment System Platform Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to meet the employment needs of most college students, the author proposes an artificial intelligence based college student employment system. The author analyzed the needs of college student employment platforms and designed a college student employment system based on database and internet technology. Firstly, the overall architecture of the system is introduced from the aspects of system functions, databases, network structure, etc. Then, the implementation method of the system is introduced using key modules as examples. Finally, the system is tested from both performance testing and functional testing. The test results show that even under the highest user load (500 people accessing simultaneously), the response time of the system remains within the range of less than 2 seconds. This indicates that the system can quickly respond to user requests and provide a good user experience. The test also measured the CPU usage of the server. Even under high load conditions, the CPU utilization rate of the system is only 10%. This means that the server resource utilization is low, and there is still a lot of room to handle more user requests, thereby ensuring the scalability and stability of the system. The system proposed by the author has been verified to have the advantages of rich functionality, safety and stability.

articleTitle: Novel and Effective Approach for Multiview Biometric Object Detection using Deep Learning based Cutting Edge Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Currently, deep learning is experiencing rapid and significant growth in many fields. It offers solutions to a wide range of real-world problems. Additionally, its strong capacity for human authentication can help overcome challenges including human trafficking, border security, immigration control, etc. Many case studies failed to deal with crowdy places where human authentication is important. Addressing these challenges requires the development of a more robust and adaptable facial recognition model that can handle crowded and dynamic environments. So, in this paper, both RetinaFace and ArcFace (additive angular margin loss) are used to overcome the limitation. RetinaFace is employed for the detection of faces, while ArcFace is utilized to authenticate whether the detected faces are known or unknown. The main contribution of this work is to develop an application for personface recognition in crowdy places using RetinaFace and ArcFace. The model demonstrates strong performance, with an accuracy of 96% when tested in crowded places.

articleTitle: Active Power Distribution Hierarchical Energy Optimal Management of IoT Smart Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the development of modern power systems, the research on energy optimization management at the distribution level has also become a hot topic in recent years. In the microgrid system, two safety indicators, load power shortage rate and energy waste rate, are considered and incorporated into the model as constraints. The proposed energy optimization management method is verified by Python programming. To verify the advantages of the particle swarm optimization algorithm used in this paper in energy optimization management, the method in this paper is compared with the traditional real-time one-step optimization method. In this paper, the particle swarm algorithm is used, and the average node voltage deviation is about 0.01pu. The overall voltage evaluation index obtained is 25.86% lower than that of one-step optimization, and the overall optimization effect of reactive power voltage is better.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Neural Network for Primary User Emulation Attacks in Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The shortage of spectrum during peak hours slows up the speed of the network due to the increasing number of gadgets where, the licensed primary users (PUs), as well as the unlicensed secondary users (SUs) in CRN employ the spectrum resources together by evading intervention from SUs. Even though, the process of spectrum sensing is regularly distracted by a safety problem termed the Primary User Emulation Attack (PUEA). A model of an adaptive neural network (ANN) is developed for PUEA in CRN to recognize the secondary users when acting as the primary user and detect the attack adaptively without intruding on the network functioning. The proposed PUED model detects the attack that arises in the network and provides authentication to the unlicensed user that utilizes the spectrum that is not used. The proposed method’s results state that the delay is decreased and the throughput of the proposed method increased to 499.494kbps when compared to the existing methods.

articleTitle: Phishing Website Detection Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As the internet promotes the growth of ecommerce businesses, the security of financial and personal data becomes a concern. Phishing attacks are becoming more complex and difficult to detect. Several Machine Learning (ML) algorithms that gather data from multiple sources, such as website addresses, search engines, and other internet resources, might be useful in distinguishing a legitimate website from a phishing website. This paper investigates supervised ML techniques such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Decision Tree (DT), Logistic Regression (LR), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Gradient Boosting (GB), and AdaBoost that are used to detect phishing websites. After training the ML models, the top-performing ML model is deployed using Streamlit so that it can be accessed to check the legitimacy of the website before it is accessed.

articleTitle: The Layout Construction of Multi-Dimensional Parking Lots by Space Planning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As an important part of urban traffic management, the layout construction of traditional three-dimensional parking lots based on genetic algorithms plays a key role in solving urban parking problems and optimizing traffic flow. Based on the space planning method, this paper aims to study the method of constructing the layout of 3D car park. Firstly, by analyzing the spatial characteristics and functional requirements of 3D car park, the objectives and constraints of layout construction are determined. Secondly, a layout construction method based on space planning method is proposed, which maximizes the function and improves the efficiency of 3D car park through the division of the internal space, the layout of the parking space and the planning of the traffic path. Finally, through the analysis of specific examples, the method in practical application is obtained. This paper puts forward the theory of traditional data analysis method, and combines multi-dimensional comprehensive judgment technology to improve the data technology. The accuracy rate reaches 98.91% with layout construction and layout construction decision making, so the layout construction of three-dimensional parking lot in space planning method is better.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Enterprise Transformation Risk by Computer Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Risk prediction is the main content of enterprise transformation, and enterprise digital transformation, business strategy and work efficiency will affect the decision-making results Make an impact and reduce the rationality of risk predictions. Given the existing problems, this paper introduces a computer data mining method to perform predictive analysis on enterprise digital transformation decision-making and improve enterprise digitalization Transformation level, shorten the time to make decisions about enterprise transformation. Then, make a comprehensive forecast of the market data. Finally, continuous monitoring is used to predict risks and output the final decision-making results. The results show that the computer data mining algorithm can accurately predict risks, improve the level of risk prediction decision-making, and rationality Greater than 95% is better than traditional risk assessment methods. Therefore, computer data mining algorithms can meet the requirements of enterprise digital transformation risk prediction and are suitable for continuous analysis of enterprise transformation.

articleTitle: Digital Management System of Archival Information Based on Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, communication technology and Internet technology, the traditional archives management mode has also encountered severe challenges. Archival informatization is a modern process of collecting, organizing, storing, developing and utilizing documents based on networks, computers and information technology. With archival resources as the goal and archival work as the basis, following the latest archival management theories, archival informatization has become an important part of modern archival management with the development of archival business. The aim of this paper is to study a digital management system for archival information based on intelligent algorithms. A TextRank-based method for the automatic extraction of key information from digitised archives is proposed to address the need for the extraction of key information from worded archives, and the algorithm is integrated into the archival information digitisation management system, and the modules of the system are experimentally tested, with the experimental results showing the superiority and technical feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Parallel Corpora Construction Based on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The paper processes and analyzes the parallel corpus texts of Chinese versions of the English novel Pride and Prejudice, by constructing two parallel corpora of its Chinese versions and the original text as a reference corpus. The tools used to process the data include ctbparser_0.11, PatCount, EditPad Pro, AntConc, SPSS 19, and the like. Two findings are shown as follows: first, either Chinese version of Wang or Zhang is significantly different from the original text, in that the Chinese version is filled with more adverbs, cardinal numerals, common nouns, punctuation marks, and fragment sentences; while the original text is full of more adjectives, conjunctions, pronouns, copulative verbs which are used in progressive tense and passive voice. Second, compared with Zhang’s version, Wang’s is nearer to Austen’s text, especially in the frequency of uses of adjectives, pronouns, copula verbs, and passive marker suo, i.e. by, that is, Wang’s version is more foreignized than Zhang’s. Wang’s version is more foreignized than Zhang’s. Nevertheless, either version has its merits; it can be said in such a way that Wang’s version is slightly quaint; while Zhang’s version is very vivid.

articleTitle: Fully Autonomous Restaurant Robot based on Raspberry Pi with Wireless Call Buttons Queue Updating System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Restaurant robots have become a trend nowadays, every restaurant owner would like an affordable restaurant robot which could replace the waiters in the restaurants and also provide seamless experience. Due to COVID - 19 pandemic the customers started preferring delivery from hygienic robots instead of waiters, it would be a great effort to call the waiters while eating and human waiters might forget the orders or confuse between them. This project aims to make a robot which could take orders, serve food and provide bill to the customers. Our robot reaches the customers with just a click of a button present at the table and reduces the efforts to be made by manually calling the waiter. The chef’s device is connected to the robot through Wi-Fi and call buttons are connected to the robot using Bluetooth making the whole process wireless and automatic.

articleTitle: Design of ANSYS Optimization Algorithm in Steel Structure Intelligent Network Security Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The steel structure intelligent network security monitoring system can detect potential abnormal behaviors and structural problems in advance through real-time monitoring and early warning, thereby improving the safety of steel structures. This research is based on the ANSYS optimization algorithm and aims to design an intelligent network security monitoring system for steel structures. This article collects and establishes monitoring data and related parameters of steel structures, uses ANSYS optimization algorithms to model and analyze steel structures, and improves the safety and stability of steel structures by optimizing structural parameters and performance indicators. After experimental testing, the anomaly detection accuracy of this method system is between 89% and 96%. Design based on ANSYS optimization algorithms can improve the real-time performance and accuracy of the system and achieve automated and intelligent monitoring and decision-making processes. This research provides an effective method and technology for the design of steel structure intelligent network security monitoring system.

articleTitle: Multimodal Sentimental Classification using Long-Short Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The increasing popularity of mobile devices and social networks has leads people to share images and text to express their emotions and opinions. This paper proposed a deep learning-based technique for multimodal sentimental analysis. For this work, the CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI dataset is utilized which contains video, audio and text clips. The inputs are in the form of video, audio and text, so individual preprocessing and feature extraction techniques are performed with separate techniques. Then, the extracted features from separate techniques are concatenated and given as input for the classification of sentimental analysis. The Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) is utilized in this research for classification. The performance metrics like 7-class accuracy (Acc-7), binary accuracy (Acc-2), F1-score, Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Correlation Coefficient (CORR) are utilized to evaluate the LSTM model. The attained result shows that the LSTM model obtains better Acc-2 of 91.57% on CMU-MOSI dataset and 91.28% of CMU-MOSEI dataset when compared to existing techniques like Multi-Tensor Fusion Network with Cross-Modal Modeling (MTFN-CMM), Sparse and Cross-Attention Network (SCANET) and Sparse and Cross-Attention Network (SCANET).

articleTitle: Long Short-Term Memory optimized with Improved Artificial Rabbits optimization Algorithm for Stock Market Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The stock market is financial market where stocks of openly listed corporations are bought and sold. It is needle of economic health of country, reflects the company performance and entire environment of business. The stock prices are determined through demand and supply. Investing in stock market may be risk, but that offered potential fir important returns over high term. In this research, the Long Short-term Memory (LSTM) with Improved Artificial Rabbits optimization (IARO) algorithm for predicting the stock market price. The IARO algorithm is utilized to optimize hyperparameters of LSTM method to maximize accuracy of stock market price prediction. The dataset used for predicting stock market price is collected dataset. The performance of proposed method is estimated with error rates of Mean Square Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) and Coefficient of Determination (R2). The proposed method less MSE of 0.43, MAE of 0.37, MAPE of 0.21 and R2 of 0.17 which is superior than other existing methods.

Author Keywords: Stock Market and Stock Price Prediction

articleTitle: Context Processing in Intelligent Machine Translation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to address the issues of long sentence processing, ambiguity resolution, and ambiguity in statistical machine translation methods, researchers need to develop more adaptive context processing methods to improve translation generalization ability. This article investigates the advantages of neural networks in processing language changes, and explores the establishment and training of short-term and short-term memory network models by analyzing the application of neural networks in context processing. Based on the loss function of mean square error and the forward propagation data output process, the following conclusion is drawn: the improved algorithm improves the overall translation accuracy of context processing by about 10%, while the processing efficiency increases by an average of about 15.8%. This article aimed to provide optimized design for context processing methods in intelligent machine translation systems in China through theoretical and empirical research. This study enables machine translation systems to learn more complex language patterns and accurately translate within a wider context.

articleTitle: Exploration on Quantitative Analysis Method for Diversified Financial Systems Based on Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The financial condition of a listed company is the main basis for investors to make investment decisions. Traditionally, effective prediction of financial conditions is crucial. Financial analysis is based on financial reports and information, but due to the nonlinearity of financial indicators, traditional multiple linear regression methods cannot accurately predict the financial situation of enterprises. After the 1990s, with the increasing maturity of numerical simulation research, the application of numerical simulation in financial data analysis was also increasing. For diversified financial systems, quantitative analysis methods based on numerical simulation are more effective than other subjective judgment methods. Financial data analysis must rely on mathematical analysis, but also subjective judgment. A complex diversified financial system refers to a system composed of multiple interacting economic factors, such as the stock market, foreign exchange market, and commodity market. The research on quantitative analysis methods for diversified financial systems based on numerical simulation can help people better understand the internal laws and operating mechanisms of financial systems (the Z and F score models in 2020 and 2022 in this experiment had the same results for analyzing the number of companies in the pharmaceutical industry with financial crises). Through simulation and analysis, quantitative conclusions about the behavior of the financial system can be drawn, and recommendations on economic policies and investment strategies can be provided to decision-makers.

articleTitle: Identification of NPK Deficiency in Toor Dal Leaf Using CNN Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The main economic contributor to India is agriculture. The Nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), and potassium (K), are the crucial parts of nutrients in plant growth. NPK deficiency levels affect plant development and crop productivity. By analyzing the leaf properties, we hope to build a model for an artificial neural network (Convolutional Neural Network Technique) that will be able to identify and categorize nutrient deficiencies in toor dal leaf. The two main characteristics used to determine NPK deficiencies in plants are the color and shape of a leaf. The dynamic capture of toor dal leaves by scanning was employed in this work to investigate how the regulation of leaf attributes changed in response to nutritional stress. In this work, the impact of various activation functions on the artificial neural network is also investigated. The findings demonstrate that the suggested technique was highly accurate in classifying and identifying NPK deficiencies in toor dal leaf.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Network Routing Based on Granular Computational Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In today's era, with the continuous development of the network, people have higher and higher requirements for intelligent devices, and traditional computers have been unable to meet these needs. Therefore, a new technology that can solve these problems and has good adaptability and reliability is needed for information management and maintenance work, currently there are mainly server-side, convergence layer and access layer consisting of a three-layer structure system, the core part of which is the routing protocol and IP-bound network link design method, in order to achieve high efficiency and stability, the use of layered architecture design mode, the data is concentrated in different In order to achieve high efficiency and stability, a hierarchical architecture design pattern is used to centralize the data in different layers to process. This paper focuses on the research of computer network routing based on granularity computing intelligence, using server-side and aggregation layer to solve the traditional PC-side routing problem and apply it to various applications. As a result, this method provided Network load balancing 95(%), Network life cycle 92(%), and 0.52 $\times 10^{6}$ energy consumption.

articleTitle: Cooperative Communication By Using Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The growing demand for the spectrum has made it necessary to utilize the available resources in an efficient and sustainable manner. The cognitive radio (CR) system is an approach where the unutilized spectrum of primary user (PU) is used by the secondary user (SU). The SU compares PU signal with a threshold to detect the freely available channel. Thus, there is a need for an appropriate threshold. Therefore it is necessary to have an optimum threshold by minimizing the probability of false alarm rate. We try to implement a cooperative communication using cognitive radio Spectrum sensing technique by the combinations of different methods which exists in the literature, like Energy detection, Cyclostationary feature detection and matched filter detection etc. The main aim of our proposed system is to increase the probability of signal detection by using Cooperative Communication among Secondary Users and to minimize the rate of false detection, the cooperative communications among cognitive users provides better results when compared to independent (non-cooperative) specteum sensing & ensuring minimum interference to the licensed user

articleTitle: Dynamic Programming Algorithm for Voltage Distribution Analysis of Photovoltaic Power Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: To address the voltage distribution problem and enhance the power generation efficiency and stability of the photovoltaic system, a voltage distribution method based on dynamic programming algorithm is proposed in this study. Firstly, a comprehensive analysis of the working principle and voltage distribution characteristics of photovoltaic power optimize rs is performed, and a mathematical model is established to abstract the voltage distribution problem as a constrained optimization problem. Then, the dynamic programming algorithm is utilized to solve the optimization problem and obtain the optimal voltage distribution scheme. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, a series of experiments are conducted and compared with traditional static allocation methods and other dynamic allocation methods. The experimental results demonstrate that the voltage distribution method based on the dynamic programming algorithm achieves significant improvements in voltage optimization for photovoltaic power optimize rs, enabling better adaptability to varying environmental conditions and changes in light intensity, resulting in enhanced power generation efficiency and system stability.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of Foundation Pit Engineering Above Underpass Tunnel Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Foundation pit project is a very complex process, involving many aspects, including geological conditions, the surrounding environment and various construction equipment and other factors, there are many uncertainties in the construction process, and therefore, it is necessary to optimize the analysis of these various elements affecting the foundation pit project. In the actual work, there are often various problems. In the actual construction process, due to various factors, the support system often causes large deviation or displacement, so in order to effectively control and reduce the excavation risk of the foundation pit must be optimized analysis and related design work; at the same time, we must also take into account the impact of the change in the stress-strain state of the enclosure structure, so that it can ensure the safety of the premise to minimize the cost of the project. As a result, the obtained values of the scheme category’s design variable of optimal scheme are number of longitudinal blocks of foundation pit excavation/PCS is 6, anti-float plate/m of thickness is 0.7, uplift pile/m diameter is 0.6, respectively.

articleTitle: Enhancing Skin Cancer Diagnosis with AlexNet Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Skin cancer, characterized by the unusual growth and rapid multiplication of skin cells, mostly occurs as a consequence of exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation originating from the sun or indoor tanning devices. It stands as the most prevalent form of cancer worldwide, with its incidence steadily rising over the years. Timely identification plays a pivotal role in effectively combating this disease. Recent advancements in the field of medical image recognition have opened new avenues for early diagnosis and treatment. Skin cancer takes on multiple forms, yet the predominant types are Basal cell carcinoma, Squamous cell carcinoma, and Melanoma. While Basal cell carcinoma and Squamous cell carcinoma are common, they generally exhibit less aggression and tend to remain localized. In contrast, Melanoma, while less frequent, is more aggressive and prone to spreading to various parts of the body. In this study, three different deep learning networks are analyzed: Google Inception V3, AlexNet, and VGG19. The objective is to assess their efficacy in the realm of medical image recognition for skin cancer diagnosis. Among the models, Alex net achieves an accuracy of 91.1%. The goal of this study is to enhance the detection of skin cancer through observing the two most effective models and making changes to the network so they are more effective.

articleTitle: Because Life Matters- A Disaster Management Web Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Disaster Management Web Application is a comprehensive solution designed to facilitate efficient communication and coordination during disaster situations. This application aims to provide a platform for seamless communication among disaster management teams, authorities, and affected individuals. One of its unique features is the ability to function without an internet connection by leveraging server-based technology. It is a software tool designed to assist in the management and response to disasters. It makes use of artificial intelligence and other technologies to give emergency responders, impacted communities’ real-time information, coordination, and support. Features like resource allocation and tracking, mapping and visualization of impacted areas, real-time monitoring of disaster situations, communication and collaboration tools, and access to pertinent guidelines and information can all be found within the application.

articleTitle: Collaborative Virtual Storage Technology based on Mobile Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As a new service model, cloud computing provides users with more efficient and efficient shared information resources. Based on mobile cloud computing technology, the collaborative relationship between data and server systems in the network is realized by using virtual storage. This paper mainly discusses how to use a cloud server with common characteristics and low degree of correlation to complete the collaborative process, and to ensure its security performance and stability as the main goal of design research. Based on cloud computing technology, this paper constructs a set of shared information resource management model that is suitable for different application scenarios and can meet the individual needs of users. After that, the effect of this technology was tested. The test results showed that the resource utilization rate of the mobile cloud computing based collaborative virtual storage technology was as high as 90%, the memory restart time was fast, and the virtual storage space was also stable. This shows that the storage technology can meet the network needs of users.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Evaluation System and Protection Strategy Based on Hierarchical Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, it has created many conveniences for people’s production life, but it also brings significant challenges. Among them, computer network security is the most critical aspect. This paper begins with an overview of network security and assessment-related content and explains the importance of establishing a network security evaluation system. The current problems of computer network security, such as human attacks on the network, the risk of network viruses and Trojan horses, and the management of network information, are presented. If these issues are not effectively addressed, they will pose a threat to the rights and interests of users in the IoT. Subsequently, this paper analyses management security, environmental security, hardware security, software security and data security, develop a network security evaluation index system and constructs an evaluation index system model using hierarchical analysis, which effectively reflects the vulnerability of the information network through an overall assessment of the impact of each element in the information network. Finally, protection strategies include using data encryption technology for active defence of network security, playing a protective role through firewall technology, using intrusion detection systems (IDS) to prevent attacks by hackers and using intrusion prevention systems (IPS) to stop attacks proposed. It provides a theoretical basis for subsequent research and evaluation of information network security by information management and operation and maintenance departments.

articleTitle: Enhanced Antlion optimization based resource allocation in vehicular cloud environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: There exists several complications with contemporary modes of transport in terms of security, accessibility, sustainability, and limitations in space. Vehicular networks are frequently seen as a viable strategy for enhancing ease and happiness in commuting. However, guaranteeing the optimal use of resources and addressing the rising needs continue to be difficult given the soaring popularity of vehicle users and the expanding diversity of requests for different services. By improving resource allocation from the perspectives of both suppliers and clients, the gaps in the prior research is closed and concentrate on resource allocation in vehicular cloud computing (VCC). The goal of our multi-objective optimisation approach for this issue is to increase levels of acceptance while conserving service supplier expenses. By adjusting the initial sample size in accordance with the pairing variable, unique overlap likelihood to favour exceptional members and increase demographic variation, we develop the Enhanced Ant lion optimization to handle such issues. The simulation results demonstrate that our suggested strategy outperforms the earlier methods in terms of performance.

articleTitle: Simulation of Employment Information Service System for Foreign Language Majors in Internet Informatization in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the advent of the era of artificial intelligence, employment information management has become inseparable from information-based Internet equipment such as networks and computers. The current social consensus is that the employment prospects of foreign language graduates are not optimistic and the employment pressure is high. To better solve the employment problem and carry out the employment work smoothly, this paper simulates the system for foreign language majors in the Internet informatization era. The research purpose of this paper is to simulate the employment information service system for foreign language majors in Internet informatization in the era of artificial intelligence. In the experiment, through the questionnaire survey, the purpose is to get users to simulate the employment information service system for foreign language majors on campus, and finally design the database and design and simulate the employment information service system for foreign language majors. The system meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Application of ID3 Decision Tree Classification Algorithm in Mathematical data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: ID3 decision tree is the most extensive method. It can be used to classify, identify and predict data information, and the whole system can be divided into several stages according to its nature. It plays an important role in mathematical data analysis. Therefore, based on ID3 decision classification algorithm, this paper studies mathematical data analysis. This paper firstly introduces the decision tree classification algorithm, and paper expounds the ID3 decision tree classification algorithm in data analysis, the application of mathematics algorithm in the application of mathematical data analysis process is introduced, and the performance of ID3 decision tree classification algorithm was tested. Finally, the test results show that for a high-resolution decision tree, if the traditional method is used for classification, it will increase the amount of calculation and time. When the ID3 decision number algorithm is used to improve the model, it can effectively improve the decision accuracy. The mathematical data analysis time based on the ID3 decision number algorithm increases with the increase of the number of data. However, the overall time is within 1-4 seconds, and at the same time, the classification accuracy is more than 93%, which shows that the performance of the algorithm is good.

articleTitle: Development of Intelligent Agricultural Automation Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper analyzed in detail the application of computer vision technology to four aspects of intelligent agricultural automation production, which saved a lot of manpower and material resources for the whole process of agricultural products from growth to harvest to logistics. Finally, combined with the realization of automatic classification of apples, the real-time monitoring and classification technology of fruit quality is discussed, which has great practical significance and economic benefits for improving the market competitiveness of Chinese fruit products. The error rate of machine grading results is 11.8% and below, and the error rate of apple grading outside the grade is 0, which can basically be applied in real life. Through computer vision technology, the automatic detection and grading of fruits are realized, thus improving the consistency and accuracy of agricultural products quality. This is very important to meet the demand of modern market for high-quality agricultural products.

articleTitle: Identification of Indian Traffic Signs Using Artifical Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The paper addresses a crucial aspect of modern transportation technology by focusing on enhancing the robustness of traffic sign recognition systems. In the context of intelligent transportation systems, accurate traffic sign recognition plays a vital role in ensuring road safety and optimizing traffic management. This study introduces an innovative approach that combines color information with edge magnitude patterns, demonstrating its effectiveness in achieving robust traffic sign recognition. The proposed methodology includes data collection from diverse sources, grouping traffic signs into categories, preprocessing steps for standardization, and the extraction of 22 features using Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) analysis. These features are then organized into a database and utilized for training a feedforward neural network with two layers for precise traffic sign detection. The project culminates in an overall accuracy rate of 90.2%, underscoring its potential to significantly enhance road safety and traffic regulation.

articleTitle: K-means Clustering Powered Context Aware Food Recommender System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper designed a K-means clustering powered context aware food recommender system (CAFRS). The CAFRS is based on dividing the food data sets into clusters to minimize the error between the user input and available data by computing the distance between the cluster centroid and available food data in the data set of CAFRS. Recommended food has the minimum distance from the K-means clustering (KMC) centroid. Root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) are computed to evaluate requirement of the repeat orders to meet energy demand of the user. Proposed CAFRS is effective to recommend a suitable recipe for the user and RMSE and MAE are effective to estimate the requirement of repeat order. Performance of the proposed CAFRS is superior compared to a rule based food recommender system (RBFRS). This study is performed in MATLAB environment.

articleTitle: A Method for Calculating the Digital Economy Index Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the popularization of the Internet, the digital economy (DE) has become an important engine for promoting economic growth and innovation. Exploring its measurement methods is of great significance for the economic competitiveness of countries and regions. How to improve the calculation accuracy of DE index is a key issue that urgently needs to be solved in the entire research on DE index calculation methods. Based on a comparative analysis of the main measurement methods in DE, this article analyzes the application process of Analytic Hierarchy Process in DE indicator calculation. The determination of sub indicators, construction of hierarchical structure model, creation of judgment matrix, and calculation of digital economy indicators have led to the following conclusion: the calculation accuracy of the AHP based digital economy indicator calculation method has improved by about 6%. This study provides a quantitative tool to evaluate and compare the development status of the digital economy in different regions or countries.

articleTitle: Model stacking of Spatial Spectral Network with Capsule Networks for Classification of Hyper-Spectral Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the development of remote sensing technology, the application of Hyperspectral Images (HSI) is vastly utilized in various fields. In specific, the classification methods of HSI plays a major role in detecting the targets, environment management, mineral mapping and so on. The existing approaches based on classification of hyper spectral images faces problems related to poor classification results due to constrained receptive field and inability to acquire long range features. The spatial spectral network has the ability to perform pixel wise classification of HSI but training the model for large labeled datasets can be challenging and leads to overfitting issues. Caps Nets are designed to capture hierarchical relationships between features. In hyperspectral image classification, where complex spectral and spatial patterns may exist, Caps Nets can potentially model these hierarchical relationships in an effective manner and helps in effective classification. So, this research introduced the model stacking of SSN and Caps Net which enhance the overall performance of classifying the HSI with better accuracy. The data is acquisitioned from Indian pines and University of Pavia to estimate efficiency of proposed technique in classifying HIS. Experimental outcomes exhibits that the proposed approach achieved better results in overall metrics. The overall accuracy of proposed approach for Indian pines dataset is 97.82% which is comparably higher than the existing Weighted Feature Fusion of Convolutional Neural Network and Graph Attention Network (WFCG) with 90.86%.

Author Keywords: Model stacking and Spatial Spectral Network

articleTitle: Analysis of Public Policy Formulation Process Based on Information System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In government decision-making, information plays a fundamental and decisive role. For public policy to be effective, it must invest in information on a need-based basis and in accordance with the principles of economics. However, in the current public policy decision-making, a series of problems have emerged, especially information problems, which have brought great challenges to the information management of public policies. Therefore, this article will explore the necessity and possibility of information management from the perspectives of the characteristics of public policy formulation and the changes of the environment, and optimize the public policy information system model based on this. Then this article establishes an information platform for public policy formulation based on data to avoid decision-making based on experience and achieve the purpose of scientific decision-making. In addition, based on the high-frequency words extracted from the public policy formulation information platform, we found that the starting point and end point of public policy are government and development, and the solutions specifically include the construction of infrastructure and basic education, paying attention to the wishes of the people, as well as reform and optimization in various fields.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Elderly Care System under the Background of Internet of Things and Big data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Elderly care services can improve the level of old-age care, happiness, and the quality of life in old age. However, in the process of elderly care services, there are problems of complex life data processing and inconsistent data on cultural differences, which in turn affects the quality of elderly care and reduces the level of services of elderly care institutions. In order to improve the quality of elderly care services, this paper designs an intelligent elderly care system, which analyzes the data of elderly care institutions with Internet of Things and big data. Then, health monitoring and early warning, life assistance and convenience functions and social interaction and loneliness alleviation are comprehensively evaluated, and the evaluation results are systematically analyzed, and finally personalized pension plans are made. The results show that the intelligent elderly care system can accurately analyze the elderly care service and improve the social pension level, and its accuracy is greater than 95% for the artificial elderly care service. Therefore, the intelligent pension system can meet the requirements of the elderly and provide auxiliary support for the social pension.

articleTitle: Multimedia Encryption Over Wireless Communication Using Fuzzy Logic based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Regarding safeguarding private medical information via remote medical services, telemedicine security is crucial. Telemedicine security is essential for protecting patient data and guaranteeing the effectiveness and reliability of remote medical services. Traditional methods to safeguard telemedicine data are Firewalls, User Authentication, Data Encryption, and Virtual Private Networks. Fuzzy logic is used to adapt encryption methods to the particulars of telemedicine data, improving security. Fuzzy logic’s essential elements involve rule bases, fuzzification, an inference engine, and defuzzification which are used to customize security protocols for telemedicine. The suggested method guarantees the safe and effective sharing of medical records between patients and healthcare providers in addition to improving data protection. An efficient encryption of multimedia data can be achieved through fuzzy logic. The efficiency of the proposed method is measured in terms of encryption time concerning the existing multimedia encryption techniques.

articleTitle: Customer Market Analysis Based on Interval Value Data Dynamic Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The traditional K-means clustering center initial value algorithm does not perform well in massive data. In order to improve the initialization efficiency of the clustering center, this article adopted the idea of dynamic clustering algorithm for inter region value data to classify the data, and selected the center of dense grids as the initial clustering center based on the distribution characteristics of the data. This method can ensure that the cluster center is located in a high-density area rather than being overly concentrated, allowing the K-Means algorithm to quickly and efficiently initialize the cluster center when processing massive data. Finally, this article compared and analyzed the performance of data clustering methods using traditional K-means algorithm and K-means++algorithm through simulation experiments. The evaluation indicators of the experiment are CR index, Silhouette Score, and accuracy. From the comprehensive analysis of three indicators, it can be seen that the performance of customer market analysis data based on this algorithm was superior to other algorithms (Silhouette Score: this algorithm was 0.1249 higher than K means++and 0.4903 higher than K-means algorithm). The results indicated that compared with traditional clustering methods, clustering methods had significant advantages in the clustering process.

articleTitle: Beam Selection Approach in Millimeter Wave Communication using Multi-Objective Prairie Dog Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The selection of beam relies as a major conflict in wireless communication systems. The beam selection has been widely utilized in millimeter wave bands which helps to mitigate the path loss and minimize the energy consumption. The existing beam selection approaches results in high computational and communication costs and hinders the widespread deployment of mm Wave communications. Moreover, the existing approaches faced issues related to select the users for multiple radio frequencies and this suffers the users to face computational burden and results in beam optimization problem. So, this research utilized a Multi-Objective Prairie Dog Optimization (MOPDO) algorithm to perform an effective beam selection for multiple users in a single iteration. MOPDO considers the multiobjective functionalities such as beam power, energy efficiency, spectral efficiency and computational time. The experimental evaluation of proposed approach is evaluated with Alternative Grey Wolf with Beetle Swarm Optimization (AGW-BSO). For example, computational time of the proposed MOPDO is 320.87 seconds whereas the existing AGW-BSO is 355.72 seconds.

articleTitle: Brain Tumour Detection and Segmentation using CNN Architecture and U-Net Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Tumours are abnormal cell growths, which can be benign or malignant. Brain tumours involve the abnormal cell growth in the brain, potentially leading to cancer and increased intracranial pressure. To enhance brain tumour detection and segmentation, a hybrid method is introduced, combining CNN and U-Net architectures. CNN aids in object detection, while UNet ensures precise tumour segmentation. This integration delivers precise localization and detailed tumour segmentation. By leveraging CNN’s robust object detection and U-Net’s spatial detail preservation and segmentation, the approach significantly improves tumour detection and segmentation accuracy compared to using either architecture individually. The hybrid model, with a 98% accuracy rate, not only optimizes data use but also significantly enhances computational efficiency. By using CNN for tumour detection and U-Net for segmentation, it empowers precise treatment planning, promising improved clinical outcomes in brain tumour cases.

articleTitle: Classification of Spam and Ham Emails with Machine Learning Techniques for Cyber Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: People often receive spam emails that may cause of cyber threats. Hence, classification of spam and ham emails is necessary for cyber security. Lack of classification accuracy is one of the common problems in this context. This paper proposes a new method of spam and ham classification based on machine learning (ML) techniques. The proposed method considers TF-IDF technique for feature selection. In this concern, flexible threshold based pruning in TF-IDF technique is introduced. In addition, the proposed method takes account of six popular ML techniques to classify the emails. Experimental results reveal that the flexible threshold helps to improve the classification accuracy of the ML techniques. The proposed method declares Support Vector Machine (SVM) as the best classifier with accuracy of 96.22%. Thus, the proposed method helps the users in identification of spam emails to avoid cyber threats.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Feasibiity and Realibilty of Nextcloud as a Network Attached Cloud Storage Solution on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Since network technology is advancing so quickly, every industry that uses networking now has a great need for data storage facilities. The proposed system inspects the feasibility of creating a network-attached storage system using Raspberry Pi and Nextcloud. A network-attached storage system, or NAS, that provides data access to a variety of network clients is connected to a computer network. The potential use of this system is for file and photo storage. Additionally, the study’s main focus is on communication via the chat feature. The advantages of such an approach are highlighted, including its affordability, adaptability, and simplicity. The presented work summarizes that a Raspberry Pi-based network-attached storage system with Nextcloud software is a viable solution for individuals and small businesses looking for a secure and efficient way to store data and communicate with others. It allows the storage and retrieval of data from a centralized location for authorized network users and clients.

articleTitle: Analysis of Network Marketing Performance Evaluation System Based on BP Neural Network Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, corporate marketing has become an essential way for the survival of companies in the market. Improving corporate marketing and providing support for companies effectively is extremely important. In response to these needs, this paper attempts to introduce the BP neural network clustering algorithm, through the construction of a three-layer index system for enterprise network marketing, to clarify the specific set of enterprise network marketing indexes; on this basis, through the BP neural network clustering method, enterprise network marketing is carried out. Comprehensive multi-level fuzzy evaluation of performance. Finally, the actual enterprise network marketing evaluation is conducted according to the specific calculation of index calculation. The results of the simulation experiment show that 0.435 of estimated vale, 0.096 of standard deviation, and 4.545 of Z-value of the BP neural network clustering algorithm is effective and can support enterprise network marketing performance evaluation and analysis.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Denial of Service Attack Detection in Cloud Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: One of the most widely used technologies today, both by developers and end users, is cloud networking. Despite the widespread use of cloud networks, security in the cloud continues to be a crucial research problem and a hotly debated subject. One or more attackers use several compromised nodes to flood a specified target during a denial of service (DoS) assault in the cloud, which renders services unavailable. It is possible to discover the attack characteristics or frequent trends of such denial of service attacks using classification algorithms. In order to identify the Denial of Service attacks, feature selection and classification utilizing deep learning approaches have been applied in this study. This study proposes a novel method for identifying DoS attacks that makes use of the expertise of an authority on the domain. In addition, deep learning algorithm such as Gated Recurrent Units is proposed in this research for Detecting DoS Attacks. In this algorithms, the final classification is carried out and validated on NSL-KDD dataset. The suggested approach is tested on a cloud-based experimental setup, and found that it performed better at detecting DoS attacks than the current security classification methods.

articleTitle: Control Strategies and Converter Configurationsin EV application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The world over, EVs with the best performance and zero carbon emissions are becoming more and more popular. The effectiveness of EVs is led by the proper interaction between energy managing systems and electric power modulators. Despite this, there are occasionally significant, uncontrollable, and unstable changes. Conversions are required for the secure and dependable transfer of energy from ESS toDrive System, EVs, control schemes, and modulation schemes.
