However, Power converters and controlschemes havemany issues, including a large number of parts, a high level of tension, a low rate of change, a slow response time, and a lack of safety features. This is why this survey presents a thorough examination of various electrical converters with a focus on topology, characteristics, components, operation, forces, and weaknesses. This evaluation also looks at the various modulation methods and converter controller types for electric vehicles in terms of their operational capabilities, advantages, and disadvantages. In order to highlight areas for future research, this review also looks at the key problems and difficulties associated with electric vehicle converters, controllers. Finally, significant and detailed recommendations are offered for developing an effective converter for potential future uses with spark-ignited electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Dynamic High-speed Traffic Flow Statistics Algorithm Based on Artificial Intelligence Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The rapid development of urbanization brings a large number of people to the city, and the traffic demand generated by people’s travel has exceeded the traffic supply capacity of urban roads, resulting in the overload of traffic infrastructure. Urban traffic flow statistics is an important link of state road traffic control and management, is the foundation of the intelligent traffic analysis, as the city scale expands unceasingly, traffic present a variety of complex shape, how to doing a lot of congestion in complex scene surveillance video for accurate statistical traffic has become one of research hotspots in the field of intelligence traffic. This paper mainly carries on the research of dynamic high-speed traffic flow statistics algorithm based on artificial intelligence simulation technology. Firstly, the YOLO algorithm is optimized for vehicle detection, and a high-speed traffic flow statistics system based on YOLO algorithm is designed and implemented. The UA-DeTRAc data set is used to test the system performance, and the detection result shows that the system accuracy of this paper is up to 95%.

articleTitle: Computer Mathematical Simulation Model Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Computer simulation technology needs to establish mathematical models for calculation and simulation, and its calculation speed and accuracy will directly affect the calculation results. In order to improve the calculation rate of the computer mathematical simulation model and the accuracy of the obtained results, this paper studies the genetic algorithm. In this paper, the genetic algorithm is applied to the computer mathematical simulation model, so that the model can use the genetic algorithm to continuously learn the relevant data of the system, analyze and optimize the acquisition of the optimal solution according to the data, and use it to solve some complex problems. The experimental results show that the probability of obtaining the optimal solution by the computer mathematical simulation model using the genetic algorithm is 19.45% higher than that of the traditional algorithm, which proves that the application of the genetic algorithm to the computer simulation model can improve the optimal solution question.

articleTitle: An English Online Learning System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to understand the functions of English online learning systems, the author proposes research on an artificial intelligence based English online learning system. The system is built using the CIS architecture, with software design as the main focus, and is compatible with most models of PC hosts. Design the audio encoding method for English speech testing. Design a question bank based on the difficulty coefficient and use JDBC database connection technology to construct a database access connection method. Secondly, using particle swarm optimization algorithm, an automatic generation algorithm for test papers is established in the system, and an online learning interaction module is added to complete the system design. Finally, the functionality and performance of the system were tested using the English test question bank of a certain university as the database. The experimental results show that when the concurrent users are between 150 and 460, the system’s operation response time remains between 30 and 55 ms, and the application CPU utilization rate remains between 3.2% and 5.9%, with relatively slow growth; When the number of users exceeds 560, the system response time increases to 70-100 ms, and the application CPU usage rate increases to 7.4%-10%, which is relatively significant but still within the normal range.

articleTitle: Design of Data Information Technology Optimization based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: System optimization is the main content of big data technology, but in the process of big data technology management, data changes and computing methods will manage big data influence as well as minimize rationality of system optimization. This paper proposes a deep learning algorithm to optimize and analyze the data information technology, enhance a development level of big data technology, and shorten the time of data statistics formulation. Then, the big data is estimated comprehensively. Finally, continuous monitoring is used to optimize the data information technology. Deep learning method can identify the relationship between information and data, better analyze data correlation, simplify the complexity between data and improve the accuracy of information analysis. The deep learning (DL) algorithm can accurately calculate parameters, improve the level of data information technology, and the rationality is greater, and better than traditional statistics law. Therefore, the deep learning algorithm can meet the requirements, and is appropriate for continuous examination of the development of information technology.

articleTitle: Mango Disease Classification using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Mango is a profitable agricultural product and widely consumed fruit. Mango production is significantly reduced when disease attacks the plant, which makes it difficult for farmers to sell their harvest. This issue drove us to create innovative methods for identifying diseases that damage mango plants. In order to maximise output and quality, it is imperative to stop these dangerous diseases early on. in our nation most many farmers lack literacy. They are unable to find correct information about illnesses as a result. It needs a knowledgeable advisor or agriculture officer. But reaching every farmer can be difficult for a professional counsellor or agricultural authority. So, in this project we are suggesting a trained model that will identify the disease of any mango plant by just providing its picture to the model. We have used Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to classify the images and we have trained the model on 4000 images and 8 different diseases. Accuracy of the model is around 98% and is giving accurate results.

articleTitle: Automatic Crowd Detection, Prediction and Surveillance System using Collaborative IoT Sensor Network for Physical Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Surveillance systems of the modern day have been improving upon the concept of physical security. From manual inspection, to CCTV surveillance, there have been many different techniques that have evolved over the years. Although the traditional method of monitoring and estimating crowd density involves analyzing footage and applying equations to find out estimated number of persons, this paper discusses a different approach to crowd monitoring, by focusing on WiFi-enabled devices on each person and is carried out by utilizing collaborative Internet of Things sensors to scan the environment for Wi-Fi enabled devices and observe the number of devices. Not only the number of persons are found from the surveillance videos, but also to predict future value of number of persons by using Time Series Forecasting through the proposed method. This method is found to be accurate in estimation of numbers as it does not depend on image and video to capture the density of crowds.

articleTitle: “Parkify” Automated Parking System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) is an increasingly popular technology enabling the identification of vehicles by scanning license plate numbers. Automatic parking systems eliminate the issues associated with traditional methods by using technological innovations. Issues like collecting parking tickets, waiting in long queues, making on-the-spot payments, monitoring parking lots, enhancing security, storing number plate details, and tracking vehicles entering and leaving the lot can be avoided. We propose a solution that involves developing a machine-learning object detection model using YOLOv5 to detect number plates and implementing a CNN character recognition model to read the characters on the number plate. Discussion on the current state of parking IoT management systems, and their features, such as the ability to check for available parking slots, scan number plates, and record entry/exit timestamps for fare calculation and payment. Accuracy and performance are analyzed and it is observed that the proposed method is better than the existing one.

articleTitle: Road Traffic Assignment Algorithm Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the development of social economy, people pay more and more attention to traffic problems. How to reasonably allocate road resources and reduce traffic accidents is a hot topic. The most important thing in road traffic is traffic information. At present, the urban vehicle dispatching in China mainly adopts the management method of combining manual calculation and static planning. Computer vision technology can improve efficiency and save labor costs. Therefore, this paper will use MATLAB software to design the road resource allocation algorithm on the road. First, the concept and significance of road traffic allocation are introduced, and then the concept of computer vision is expounded. On this basis, the road traffic allocation algorithm is studied, and then the performance of the traffic allocation algorithm is tested. The final test results show that the average delay time and road allocation time are short and the allocation accuracy is high. This shows that the road traffic assignment algorithm based on computer vision has good performance.

articleTitle: Language Translation Technology Based on Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile internet, language translation technology has also been widely applied and developed. Language translation and communication have been realized through speech recognition, speech synthesis, Machine translation and other technologies. This article conducted in-depth research and analysis on language translation technology based on mobile internet. First, the development background and status quo of mobile Internet language translation technology based on Big data analysis technology were introduced, including the current mainstream translation applications and platforms. Secondly, key technologies such as speech recognition, speech synthesis and machine translation were introduced and analyzed in detail, including technical principles, application scenarios, advantages and disadvantages, etc. Finally, through experimental analysis, a comparison of the translation speed and matching rate of several translation systems was conducted, verifying the feasibility of this method. The experiment showed that the translation speed of this method was about 8 sentences per second, with a matching rate approaching 100%, far surpassing the other two translation systems.

articleTitle: Hybrid Salp Swarm and Particle Swarm Optimization based Secure Aware Energy-Efficient Routing in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is an interconnected of Sensor Nodes (SN) which are combined with one other in network through wireless. The main objective of the WSN design is to maximize the network lifetime. The network lifetime can be extended and energy consumption can be balanced properly through the utilization of clustering and routing. However, the WSN’s restricted battery supply means that energy efficiency is observed as a complex task in a network. In this paper, Hybrid of Salp Swarm Algorithm and Particle Swarm Optimization (HSSPSO) is proposed to maximize the efficiency of energy in WSN. The secure aware Cluster Head (CH) and route path from the network are selected by utilizing HSSPSO. The proposed HSSPSO minimizes the usage of energy nodes when maximizing the data transmission in WSN. The performance of HSSPSO is evaluated using throughput, packet delivery ratio, delay and energy efficiency by various nodes of 100, 200, 300 and 400. The HSSPSO attained a high throughput of 580kbps and packet delivery ratio of 99.4% with less delay of 12.3ms and energy consumption of 321.8J when compared to existing methods like Enhanced Trust-Based Secure Route Protocol (ETBSRP) and Enhanced Energy Efficient-Secure Routing (EEE-SR) protocol.

articleTitle: English Intelligent Translation Software Framework Based on data Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Language is not only a mirror reflecting human thinking, but also the most important medium of communication between people. In today’s information age, the communication barriers between different languages in the generation, storage, transmission and transformation of massive digital information every day have become more and more serious. Therefore, breaking the language barriers, communicating with each other and understanding each other has become an increasingly urgent need. In today’s globalization, with the progress and innovation of science and technology, it has promoted the diversification of foreign language learning ways and the development of convenient learning methods. The purpose of this paper is to study the construction of English intelligent translation software framework based on data analysis algorithm. Based on the clustering model algorithm idea, the TTL algorithm is applied to the extraction of English-Chinese translation patterns. Also, the English intelligent translation software platform is constructed. The designed is tested in terms of performance, and the results show that the translation software designed in this paper achieves the initial goal of the project with certain feasibility and practicality.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Acoustic Scene Classification Using ANN and CNN Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Artificial neural networks have achieved notable improvements in various learning tasks and have also been used to classify environmental sounds. The technique for allowing devices to recognize and interpret the surroundings from a recording is called Acoustic Scene Classification (ASC). Computational Auditory/Scene analysis is analyzing scenes using computational techniques. This research paper’s primary goal is to categorize audio recordings based on the scenarios or environments in which they were captured. In most applications, deep learning is one of the most recent trends. In this work, we have concentrated on two deep learning techniques employed to classify audio scenes: Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) to develop the model. ReLU and LeakyReLU activation functions are used to train and validate the model. For evaluating the model performance, K-fold cross-validation was used with K=10 and obtained an accuracy of 75.8% using an Artificial Neural Network and a proposed model with 90.6% accuracy using a Convolutional Neural Network. Comparing the results with other baseline models that achieved a performance of 73.3% for MCLNN with Mel-spectrogram, 78.2% for Pyramid-Combined CNN, 78.3% for Envnet-v2, and 81.9% for D-CNN.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Sensitivity of Different Models of Conventional Silicon and Reduced Graphene Oxide based MEMS Pressure Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Over the past decade, piezoresistive pressure sensors have gained significant attention in the electronics and sensing field due to their superior sensitivity, resolution, and dynamic range. However, traditional silicon-based sensors necessitate complex and time-consuming clean room fabrication processes. This paper presents a novel approach to design and enhance the sensitivity of pressure sensors, offering a simpler structure, reduced volume, and cost-effective fabrication. In this study, various models of conventional silicon-based piezoresistive pressure sensors are designed, modeled, and simulated for sensitivity analysis. Furthermore, authors propose an innovative pressure sensor design that replaces traditional silicon with a thin piezoresistive film made of reduced graphene oxide (rGO) on a flexible Kapton substrate. Importantly, this fabrication process eliminates the need for a clean room, making it a simple and low-cost alternative. Sensor models are of square membrane with length and thickness 783um, 63um respectively are simulated using piezoresistive module of COMSOL Multiphysics 5.5 and analysed for output voltage, sensitivity over a pressure range of 0 to 100 MPa. The results demonstrate that the rGO-based Lynn Fuller model outperforms its silicon-based counterpart, offering a sensitivity of 15.05 mV/MPa compared to 6.657 mV/MPa for the traditional silicon-based Lynn Fuller model. The theoretical sensitivity values closely approximate the simulated results, with rGO-based and silicon-based sensors yielding 17.02 mV/MPa and 6.524 mV/MPa respectively. Additionally, this paper investigates sensor performance at various temperatures, revealing that silicon-based sensors exhibit reduced sensitivity at higher temperatures, while rGO-based pressure sensors maintain stability, making them suitable for high-temperature applications.

articleTitle: Time-allocation Optimization of Regional Traffic Computer Control Based on Distributed Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Timing problem is an important application of distributed algorithm, but it still has many shortcomings in practical engineering, such as traffic flow information cannot be effectively transmitted. The purpose of this paper is to solve the problem that the speed of road vehicles is too fast, the traffic capacity difference between motor vehicles and non-motor vehicles on the road is large, and the traffic network congestion is serious. Firstly, this paper analyzes the timing problem of the traditional method based on probability weighting to calculate the optimal strategy of the road section. Secondly, it analyzes and summarizes a hybrid heuristic method based on distributed algorithm to solve the shortest time model of urban main roads, and verifies its feasibility and effectiveness through simulation experiments. Finally, the simulation results show that based on the distributed algorithm, the regional traffic calculation and control timing is optimized. The traffic control timing is short, the delay time is low, the distributed algorithm has fast response time and high prediction accuracy, which indicates that the optimization result of the algorithm is good.

articleTitle: Acoustic Fall Detection using Genetic K-NN and SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Falls are abnormal movement coordination that forces a person to rest on the ground causing significant health risks involuntarily. This study aims to develop an Acoustic Fall Detection system based on the Genetic K-Nearest Neighbour (ADF-GKNN) feature selection approach and extract significant audio features from spectrogram and Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs). The support vector machine classifier is used to identify the falls using the extracted features. The audio signals are extracted from two benchmarked fall video datasets for experimentation. Classification results obtained using the proposed frameworks outperform other feature selection techniques regarding prediction accuracy with 90.6 and 91.8 percentages.

articleTitle: A Study on Diabetic Retinopathy using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a widespread difficulty of diabetes mellitus, which begins lesions on retina and it affects a vision which leads to blindness. A physical color fundus images screening detects DR at an early stage is computationally expensive and consumed a much time. Consistently, a diagnosis of automated DR has become a basis of research recently because of immense growth of diabetic patients. And it is very difficult to identify the disease features in the images at the early stages of the disease. Machine learning based medical image analysis has come up with the good results of fundus images and early diagnosis of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is possible with the application of Deep Leaning Techniques. The paper discusses more about the Detection, Segmentation and Classification of Diabetic Retinopathy with available datasets. The main moto of the paper is not just early identification of diabetic Retinopathy, but also takes a major role in detecting the stage of defect like normal, mild, moderate o severe. Many papers have proposed different methods to study the diabetic retinopathy but no paper has presented the case of limited training dataset. It has become the major challenge of this paper. The segmentation of eye’s vasculature can be done manually [21] with the help of expertise but it is very tedious and time consuming and also requires extra attention. Study of research gaps in the field of DR Segmentation and Classification leads to the challenges and investigation has also included in this paper.

articleTitle: DEA Based Model for Evaluating the Utilization Rate of Power Grid Assets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Nowadays, the efficient utilization of resources and energy is a key issue related to the national economy and people’s livelihood, among which the power industry is very important. Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) is a method of operations research and economic production boundary research, which is generally used to measure the production efficiency of some decision-making departments. In order to solve this problem, this article conducted research on DEA, aiming to establish a PG asset utilization evaluation model through DEA, which could efficiently utilize power resources while ensuring power safety, thus saving unnecessary resource consumption and making a contribution to promoting the development of the power industry. Experimental evidence showed that the DEA based model for evaluating the UR of PG assets could enhance the safety of PG construction, reduce the risk coefficient by approximately 10%, and increase the UR of PG assets by 15%.

Author Keywords: efficient utilization of resources and energy

articleTitle: Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization based Multi-Objective Improved Cat Swarm Optimization for Image Contrast Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The contrast enhancement technique is utilized to enhance the image quality which produce good quality images for various image processing tasks. The Histogram Equalization (HE) is one of the widely utilized technique for enhance the contrast and estimates the intensity frequency in an image. The Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) is one of the local HE technique. Therefore, the CLAHE can handle the issues of classical HE algorithm. The CLAHE utilizes two various parameters such as number of tiles and clip limit, moreover the effectiveness depends on these two parameters. In this paper, Multi-Objective Improved Cat Swarm Optimization (MOICSO) is proposed to determine the optimum parameters for CLAHE to improve the image contrast. The first fitness function is utilized for estimating entropy and second is utilized for calculating Fast Noise Variance Estimation (FNVE) which produce local preservations and avoid noise amplification in an output image. The parameters like Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Peak Signal-to-noise Ratio (PSNR) and Computing Time (CT) are utilized to evaluate the proposed methodology. The obtained result shows that the MOICSO achieves less MAE of 6.28 which is which is better than other existing methods.

articleTitle: Whale Optimization Algorithm with Convolutional Neural Network for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Object detection is method of computer vision for locate instances of objects in videos or images. Algorithms for object detection generally control Machine (ML) or Deep Learning (DL) for producing results. Several ML methods are used for detecting objects from image acquired through video. Huge incoming volume information is high for ML methods to manage. DL methods are used for recognizing objects and individuals from videos in accordance with handle high quantity of information as input. Several DL methods are used like Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and etc., to handle huge quantity of input data and also human and object recognition. Thus, Hybrid Whale optimization Algorithm (WOA) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed to detect object from video frames. WOA is used to enhance the method parameter of CNN architecture. Initially, the pre-processing technique is used to delete noise in image and quality of image is improved. Gaussian filter is utilized to subtract background in images. The proposed method improved accuracy of object detection and identifies the small targets in videos. The proposed algorithm attained high accuracy of 98.23%, precision of 96.78%, recall of 96.02% and f1-score of 96.45% which is higher than other existing methods.

Author Keywords: Video frames and Whale optimization Algorithm

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Ultra Reliable Communication (URC) in Future 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Ultra Reliable Communication (URC) plays a very significant character in 5G Network Communication by providing services anywhere and anytime to the end user. In the existing system, Ultra Reliable Connection (URC) on 5G Network operates under a time zone like Uptime and Leisure Time. In terms of metrics, URC parameters such as packet delivery rate, minor error rate etc., are popular. What you need to understand in general is not the issue of trust. For this we need to move the URC to space domain from the time zone. In this proposed work, we begin the definitions of Ultra Reliable Communication in 5G Network operating under space domain. Throughout this process the Network is divided into a Homogeneous Network and a Heterogeneous Network by a number of Nodes or Cells. The Homogeneous and Heterogeneous Network is categorized based on Voronoi tessellation and Poison Point Process. Homogeneous Network operates under the same coverage of all Nodes with the same type of cells. With regard to the metaphor used for displaying reliable communications, parameters such as packet delivery rates, shutdown probability should be considered. To implement URC in a real time, investigating transactions between mobile power and mobile cloud computing applications. In addition, a review has been provided of the latest developments in short packets communication. The proposed work shows that Poisson Voronoi (PV) distributed mobile network will achieve URC for future network using cell availability and system availability.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence Machine Translation Based on Fuzzy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the technical field, achieving semantics for AI machine translation is a challenge that must be overcome. The model uses rule reasoning in natural language processing for deep understanding, and combines machine learning theory to optimize model parameters, so as to achieve the purpose of improving translation accuracy. After experimental verification, the model proposed in this paper shows a high accuracy rate of more than 90% when translating different translations; in addition, compared with DocNMT and SENTNMT, two common artificial intelligence machine translation models, the model proposed in this paper shows higher accuracy in machine translation, up to 97%, far exceeding them. At the same time, the model also has a certain degree of fault tolerance, which can ensure the stability and reliability of the machine translation system. Therefore, using the method proposed in this paper, the quality level of machine translation can be significantly improved.

articleTitle: Modelling of Micro-Optical Ring Resonator as an Optical Filter with a 1×3 I/O Bus Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: A micro-optical ring resonator (MORR) is developed here using four unsymmetrically connected rings with $(1\times 3)$ I/O ports that have been mathematically studied and analyzed in the Z-domain. The delay line technique and Mason’s gain formula are used to obtain the transfer functions for various output ports. The proposed model’s frequency response study is accomplished in MATLAB, and its performance parameters are also graphically presented. This proposed structure provides a wider FSR of 1.82 THz, 1.567 THz, and 1.53 THz at different ports with appreciable crosstalk. In optiFDTD, the suggested structure is then developed using the design parameters. The designed MORR’s frequency response is computed, and the results are compared with MATLAB’s results. Also, optiFDTD software is used to evaluate the proposed structure’s electric field distribution. The proposed architecture significantly improves the data processing capabilities of communication networks by inserting many communication channels through three output ports.

articleTitle: Impact of Supply Chain Collaboration on Innovation Performance Based on Structural Equation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This study aims to explore the impact of supply chain collaboration on the innovation performance of the integrated circuit industry in Guangdong Province by constructing a structural equation model, identify influencing factors, measure path coefficients and analyze the interactions and relationships between variables. This study focuses on the integrated circuit industry in Guangdong Province. Through literature review, the research framework and hypotheses are constructed, with supply chain collaboration as the independent variable and innovation performance as the dependent variable, and corresponding research hypotheses are proposed. Subsequently, by collecting data related to supply chain collaboration and innovation performance, a structural equation model is established and path coefficients are measured. Finally, the research results are explained and discussed, and the interactions and relationships between variables are analyzed. Through experimental analysis, it can be seen that the structural equation supply chain collaboration has increased the innovation performance from 2.532 billion yuan to a maximum of 4.139 billion yuan. These research findings provide important management suggestions and decision-making basis for relevant enterprises and policy makers. As a result, the regression coefficient with similar regression models. Regression coefficient achieved the accuracy of 97%, precision of 95%, f-measure of 93%, and recall of 94%.

articleTitle: The Application of Human-Computer Interaction Technology in the Design of Digital Media Mobile Interface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As modern technology continues to evolve, human-computer interaction (HCI) technology is becoming increasingly prevalent in various industries, including entertainment, e-commerce, education, artificial intelligence, and game development. The application of HCI is particularly critical in the field of digital media, especially when it comes to designing interfaces for digital media on mobile devices, where HCI forms the foundation of the entire design process. This article delves into the details of HCI technology, presenting an overview of human-computer interaction interfaces and exploring how to assess their usability. The discussion extends to the optimization of these interfaces using the GOMS model and the eventual development of a novel GOMS layered quantitative model. Practical testing of this design system has demonstrated that the application of HCI technology plays a pivotal role in enabling multi-screen interactions for digital media. The test results indicate that the utilization of this technology offers a new perspective on the development of digital media for mobile devices, making their use more efficient. The ongoing success of the digital media industry hinges on the continuous development and application of HCI technology. Looking forward, it is crucial to persist in exploring and improving this technology to create even more powerful and effective interfaces, propelling the growth of this field for years to come.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain Technology based on Decision Tree Algorithm to Digital Asset Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Blockchain technology is a very popular technology in the economic field today. Given the above background, this manuscript describes a decision tree model to deduce blockchain decision-making with digital asset management, and control the management decision-making time. This method can carry out digital asset management with constraints, formulate digital currency management, intellectual property management and virtual asset management, and improve the rationality of digital asset management. Finally, digital assets with blockchain technology can be managed and final decision-making results can be output. The outcomes descripted that proposed method can exactly make blockchain digital asset management decisions and improve the level of digital asset management of blockchain technology, the optimization rate is more than 95%, which is better than traditional asset management methods. Meanwhile, for short-term forecasting, the model still has a high validity when the amount of data is small since the algorithm proposed extracts the relatively optimal samples in advance under digital asset management of blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Application Programming Interface with a Case Study of SOA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: A set of ways, procedures and tools used in programming to develop software operations is known as an Application programming interface (API). An API exposes the procedures, inputs, issues and underpinning types of a software element. An API separates features from their applications, enabling definitions and functionalities to evolve without degrading the interface. By providing all of the required building blocks, a good API makes developing a software easy. In this paper, APIs of Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) are implemented and discussed along with SOAP, JSON-RPC, XML-RPC, REST. APIs for securing Web services also focused by coding examples. A Web service request message and response messages are resulted through SOAP envelop and discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Financial data Security Protection System Based on Improved Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to enhance the security of the database, the database system should be protected according to the characteristics of the database system to ensure the security of the database. The database is a collection of data logic, and the data between different sites have strict constraint rules, which makes the security of financial data more important. Today’s society has seen many hacking events, these data and information leakage events are all warning people to improve the security protection of financial data. In order to solve this problem, this paper discusses the financial data security protection system based on the improved random forest algorithm, firstly, the financial data security and random forest algorithm are carefully explained, and then it discusses how to construct the financial data security system based on the improved random forest algorithm, and experimentally verifies the high accuracy of this system in predicting the risk (the financial risk index in 2016 is only 0.2999 different from the actual risk index). 0.2999 difference).

articleTitle: Adaptive Adjustment System of Light Source and Lighting Based on Visual and Non-Visual Effects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Light source and lighting play a vital role in architectural design and life, and can affect the comfort, functionality and aesthetic feeling of architectural space. However, the traditional static lighting system cannot meet the lighting requirements in different environments and use scenarios. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an adaptive regulation system of light source and lighting based on visual and non-visual effects. In this paper, we apply experimental tests and comparison to analyze the lighting adaptive regulation system. Through the experimental results, the difference in physiological indicators between the two groups does not exceed 2. This method is applied to supplement greenhouse lighting, which can achieve the goal of energy saving and reducing consumption, and has high application value. The adoption of a light source and lighting adaptive regulation system can promote building sustainability. As a result, the total energy consumption of the two plant growth boxes was 7kWh and 11kWh, respectively.

articleTitle: Distributed Artificial Intelligence and Adaptive Fish Swarm Optimization based Resource Allocation in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a decentralized and distributed ad-hoc network that comprises the powerful computing, sensing and processing nodes. In WSN, the sensor nodes are limited in terms of computational latency, communication range, bandwidth, storage and battery power. The efficient utilization of WSN resource is a difficult task for improve network lifetime, throughput, minimize the computational delay and overhead. Various intelligent strategies are developed through adopting intelligent resource management approaches. Due to the sensor heterogeneity, the inter and intra-cluster cooperative communication among sensor node in terms of response time and energy consumption. In this paper, a Distributed Artificial Intel ligence (DAI) with a hierarchical resource allocation for address the resource allocation issues. For inter-cluster power allocation, this paper considers the Quality of Service (QoS) and energy consumption with DAI. Additionally, for intra-cluster resource allocation, the Adaptive Fish Swarm Optimization (AFSO) is utilized which utilizes its objective functions as node distance and corresponding energy loads. The proposed DAI and AFSO less energy consumption of 7.86%, packet delivery ratio of 99.4% which is better than other existing methods.

articleTitle: A Synthesized K-fold approach for Detecting DDoS attack using Machine Learning Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: A distributed denial of service attempt is a sort of cyber-attack in which the perpetrator attempts to starve a network/server of services by flooding the network/server with unnecessary requests, rendering it unable to process valid requests. Using the bots devices false requests makes the system busy and unavailable. Since the rate of cyber attacks include ransomware, phishing, and DOS / DDOS attacks etc. increasing becoming more difficult to identify and protect online businesses against them. Researchers are working hard to figure out in defending against these attacks using the machine learning to prevent from causing maximum harm. This paper reveals the various machine learning paradigms for detecting DoS/DDoS threats and also discussed recent years’ big cyber-attacks and their peak traffic. This paper discuses distinct datasets that are widely used by researchers and their accuracy and analyze their approaches used in the detection of DDoS

articleTitle: Study of Topologies, Power Converters, and Control Techniques for the Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Power quality is an urgent issue and is of the highest priority, especially for complex and technologically advanced devices, whose efficiency is dependent on the quality of the supply. Concerns about power quality issues that damaged or malfunction sensitive loads. Sensitive loads, such as ups and power electronics devices etc., malfunction due to outages and disruptions, resulting in large financial losses Fact’s devices are suggested for boosting power quality, with DVR regarded as the finest and most affordable option. DVR is facts device for reducing and resolving voltage related fluctuations. This manuscript presents into great detail on and survey the DVR is based on Topologies, Power Converters, and Control Techniques. The survey states the research in t a reasonable analysis of P.Q problems, the DVR principle and working methods, the DVR parts the DVR structures based on DC link voltage, the DVR is based on 3$-\phi$ VSI, and control parts with various phases of control processing. Also included are the DVR’s improved and modified configurations. This manuscript is a complete and useful resource for those who want to learn more about DVRs.

articleTitle: Network Security Situation Awareness Forecast Algorithm using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to predict network threats more accurately, this study proposes a prediction model using artificial bee colony(ABC) algorithm to optimize RBFNNK. Step one, we use the self-encoder to reduce the dimension of the input data, so as to improve the data processing efficiency. Step two, we use ABC to optimize the parameters of RBFNNK. After optimization, implementation efficiency and accuracy of the RBFNNK is improved. Finally, because the input data values of the RBFNNK is nonlinear time series values, RBFNNK is used to find out the nonlinear mapping relationship of network security situation values, in this way we can realize the network security situation awareness and prediction process. Through experiments, the designed algorithm is compared with the existing prediction methods. From the experimental results, we can see that the RBFNNK designed in this study is effective and has very high accuracy.

articleTitle: Dangerous Behavior Image Recognition Algorithm of Smart Port Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this paper, a new deep learning-based image recognition method is proposed to address the problems of existing image recognition methods. Through the depth neural network, the Generative adversarial network model is improved, so that the generated images can be classified, and the image recognition algorithm is optimized. And to verify the effectiveness of DNN in the application of image discrimination algorithm for dangerous behaviors in smart ports, this paper compares it with the traditional image recognition algorithm. The research results show that when the number of dangerous behavior images of Smart port is 500, it has been experimentally verified that its recognition accuracy can reach 94.40%, and the time required for image recognition is 0.29 seconds. This shows that the algorithm in this paper has high recognition accuracy, fast recognition speed, and can effectively identify dangerous behaviors in the port, which plays an important role in ensuring the safety of life and property of Smart port staff.

articleTitle: Waterwheel Plant Algorithm Optimization Based Resource Allocation in the Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent years, the Cloud Computing (CC) is one of the most fast developing distributed computing technologies and the cloud-based applications have extended crucially. The CC environment provides the computing resources according to the need of cloud user’s demand. The CC develops resource allocation system by the distributed computing as well as virtualization to highlights the cloud services scalability. One of the most important problems faced by the cloud customers are choosing the resources for the application deployment without compromising the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements. However, to control the user demand creates critical problems in the on-demand resource allocation framework. To address this problem, this research proposed the Waterwheel Plant Algorithm (WWPA) based resource allocation in the cloud. The virtualization conception supports to implements the task based on the resource accessibility as well as minimizes response time. The WWPA utilizes the hunting strategy to attains the efficient and effective resource allocation. The proposed WWPA method attains better results and it achieves the execution time of 80.5667, energy consumption of 7453.201 and resource utilization of 0.876 respectively when compared to the existing methods like Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) and Emperor Penguin Optimization (EPO).

Author Keywords: Virtual Machine and Waterwheel Plant Algorithm

articleTitle: Personalized Recommendation Algorithm for Electronic Commerce Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the era of e-commerce, a large amount of data and complex business models make traditional manual recommendations difficult to adapt to constantly changing personalized needs. Finding a more efficient product recommendation algorithm has become an important topic in the field of e-commerce. The scale of online shopping is constantly expanding, and it is necessary to match higher technological investments to explore the value of data. By comparing the advantages, disadvantages, and application scenarios of collaborative filtering algorithms and artificial intelligence technology, this article constructs a personalized recommendation system for e-commerce according to data mining. The results show that the recall rate of AI based recommendation algorithms is about 0.1 higher than that of collaborative filtering-based recommendation algorithms, and after using artificial intelligence algorithms for personalized recommendations, eBay’s recommendation accuracy has improved by about 8.26%. The recommendation system designed in this article can provide recommendations for products or services that meet users’ needs according to their interests as well as preferences, thereby improving their shopping experience.

articleTitle: Utilizing Machine Learning to Analyze and Implement Task Scheduling Algorithms in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Today many online users may access a number of facilities that utilizes cloud computing. Task scheduling, which involves assigning work to virtual computers hosted in data centers, is one of these services. Typically, there are more tasks than virtual machines, thus algorithms must be used to guarantee two important goals: (i) the swift completion of all tasks, and/or (ii) the fair allocation of the burden. In order to assess their performance across various tasks, we have tested both conventional algorithms (such as First Come First Serve, Round Robin, and Shortest Job First) and evolutionary algorithms (such as Particle Swarm Optimization and Ant Colony Optimization) within the CloudSim framework. The job completion durations of these algorithms are then contrasted. Result shows that analysis varies depends on number of data centers and the number of virtual machines for conventional algorithms. Among the evolutionary algorithms, Ant Colony Optimization is better choice.

articleTitle: CD-RNN: An Implementation of Cascaded Dilated RNN for Secured Routing Mechanism in Software-Defined Network with Block Chain Technology over IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Geographical exploration has grown in popularity in recent decades, with Internet of Things devices being used. The Internet of Things networks are often used in different situations such as smart equipment, smart agriculture, food production etc. As a result, the IoT network confronts several challenges, piqueing the interest of academics seeking to increase its efficiency. The hash addresses are used to link the blocks together. Each block records the hash of the preceding block.A block’s hash is constructed using the information contained in it, and modifying a block’s contents also changes its hash. As a result, an assailant cannot tamper with a chunk without being detected. For data routing, however, a centralised technique is called as Software Defined Networking is utilised. The data plane and the control plane are kept distinct in SDN.

articleTitle: Prairie Dog Optimization Based Efficient Task Scheduling in the Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In Cloud Computing CC, scheduling the algorithms depicts the significant role of identifying the possible tasks scheduling. An efficient task scheduling is considerable to achieve the cost-effective execution as well as enhance the resource utilization. The task scheduling problem is to classified as the Nondeterministic Polynomial (NP)-hard problem. To solve this issue, this research proposed an efficient metaheuristic algorithm named Prairie Dog Optimization (PDO) to enhance the task scheduling behaviour in the cloud. The PDO is proposed to improve the task transmitting performance by the cloud network based on the workload of the cloud resources. The proposed method utilizes four prairie dog activities to attains the two basic optimization phases such as exploration and exploitation. The PDO utilizes the two strategies named burrow and foraging to attains the efficient and effective resource allocation. The PDO is modelled for scheduling and distributing the tasks are developed by utilizing the Virtual Machine (VM) factors, time as well as cost. The proposed PDO method attains better results and it achieves the makespan of 112.65, energy consumption of 90.47 and Degree of Imbalance (DoI) of 1.1 respectively when compared to the existing methods like Particle Swarm Optimization, Antlion Optimization (ALO) and Genetic Algorithm (GA).

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Association Rule Algorithm in Big data of College English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this paper, data mining tools and methods are used to provide data basis for college teachers to evaluate students’ English learning, and personalized evaluation model is developed. Teachers’ teaching methods are adjusted according to the evaluation results of data information, so as to understand students’ learning ideas and facilitate English teaching management. Therefore, in college English teaching, association rule algorithm is used to explore valuable teaching information from students’ English data database, so as to explore feasible teaching programs. Based on the actual situation of college English teaching database, this paper analyzes the application of college English teaching big data based on association rules algorithm. From the experiment, we discovered that teaching methods affect teaching effectiveness, and it is necessary to improve hardware facilities and teaching methods. The correlation between teaching attitude and teaching effectiveness is high, it is necessary to correct the attitude of teachers, encourage them to participate in training, and improve their physical and mental health.

articleTitle: Text-to-Image Generator using GANs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Text-to-image generation is a fascinating frontier in artificial intelligence, where machines translate textual descriptions into realistic visual representations. One remarkable approach that has stirred excitement and innovation in this field is the integration of Stable Diffusion, a ground-breaking deep learning framework. This fusion elevates the art of image synthesis, pushing the boundaries of what AI can achieve in creative content generation. At its core, text-to-image generation aims to bridge the semantic gap between language and vision, enabling machines to understand and generate images based on textual descriptions. Stable Diffusion, an evolution of generative adversarial networks (GANs), introduces stability and control to the training process. This method enhances the generation of high-quality images by mitigating issues like mode collapse, enabling better convergence, and facilitating the production of diverse and visually coherent outputs. The incorporation of Stable Diffusion into text-to-image generation projects has yielded remarkable results. It empowers AI models to create intricate and contextually relevant images from textual input. Whether it’s describing a serene mountain landscape or a whimsical unicorn in a magical forest, the AI harnesses the power of Stable Diffusion to breathe life into these imaginative concepts. One of the key advantages of Stable Diffusion is its ability to fine-tune the trade-off between image quality and diversity. By controlling the diffusion process, researchers and developers can manipulate the output variance, allowing them to strike the ideal balance for their specific application. This adaptability makes Stable Diffusion an invaluable tool in the toolkit of text-to-image generation projects. Moreover, the stable training dynamics offered by this framework empower developers to explore various text-conditional generation tasks beyond mere realism. It opens the door to generating images that evoke specific emotional responses, aligning AI-generated visuals with human intentions and artistic vision.

articleTitle: The Evaluation and Testing System of Automobile Performance Based on Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the face of the rapid growth of China's car ownership, the variety of vehicle types, and the increasingly complex structure and use conditions of modern cars, the majority of car manufacturers urgently need to further control the performance of cars in the process of car design and production, and effectively measure the performance of cars and analyse and process the results so that they have high practicality and economic benefits. The purpose of this paper is to study the vehicle performance evaluation and testing system based on multi-objective genetic algorithm. The indicators for the evaluation of the vehicle performance are determined, including vehicle dynamics, fuel economy, braking, handling stability and environmental friendliness. The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to establish the subordinate degree function of each factor, so as to obtain the scores of the vehicle performance evaluation, select the appropriate input and output parameters, and establish the evaluation model using the neural network of multi-objective genetic algorithm. As a result, the overall vehicle performance scores after the two sets of real-world tests were 79 and 80 respectively.

articleTitle: Spectrum Sensing in Cognitive Radio Networks using Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to identify and make use of unused, underused frequency bands, cognitive radio (CR) makes extensive use of spectrum sensing (SS). Successful implementations of CR rely heavily on accurate spectrum sensing. As a result, this paper presents a novel multi-stage detector for use in high-fidelity signal and spectrum sensing equipment. As a first step is estimate the SNR of the sampled signal. Here, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture to estimate the SNR. Next choose a detection method that best fits predicted SNR of incoming signal. There are two ranges of SNR, one at low frequencies and one at high frequencies. In cases of high SNR, here "Energy Detector (ED) & Singular Value based Detector (SVD)," but in cases of low SNR, here employ modified Non-negative matrix factorization (MNMF). Here, use the Levy updated SLNO (LU-SLNO) method to choose the best possible weights for CNN. In addition, the combined results from many detectors provide definitive verdict on spectrum's tenancy and signal's presence.

articleTitle: Band Selection Approach based on Modified Cuckoo Search Algorithm for Hyperspectral Image
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Band Selection refers to the procedure of selecting the most relevant bands in the Hyperspectral Image (HSI). The HSI consists of important number of adjacent dense spectral bands which continuously have greater redundancy and high correlation that results into “curse of dimensionality” in an analysis of HSI. Hence, the efficient band selection approaches are significant for the reduction of HSI dimensionality without the any loss of spectral data involved in it. In this research, the new selection method based on the Modified Cuckoo Search Optimization (CSO) is proposed for the reduction of data dimensions of HSI. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated by utilizing the HSI dataset. The MCSO examines the various land-cover classes as well as stability of the selected features among two scenes named leading to discriminative as well as domain-invariant features of the subset of selected features. The performance of the proposed MCSO method attains better results and it achieves the Overall Accuracy (OA) of 90.67%, Average Accuracy (AA) of 75.89% and Kappa coefficient (k) of 0.897 respectively when compared to the existing methods named Binary Particle Swarm Optimization with Local Band Index (LBI-BPSO), β-Whale Optimization Algorithm (β-WOA) and Modified Hybrid Rice Optimization (MHRO).

articleTitle: Evolutionary System for Voltage Reactive Power Control in Distribution Network based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper presents an evolutionary system for voltage reactive power control in distribution networks based on the Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm (IPSA). Extensive experiments are conducted in various environmental scenarios, including urban areas, industrial settings, renewable energy integration, residential areas, commercial zones, and rural regions. Evolutionary system in minimizing reactive power losses, regulating voltages, improving power factor, and mitigating voltage violations. The findings of this study contribute to the field of power system optimization by providing a practical and efficient solution for voltage reactive power control. The proposed evolutionary system will be validated using realistic distribution network models and benchmarked against traditional optimization methods, such as genetic algorithms and basic PSO. The system offers a reliable approach to enhance the performance and efficiency of distribution networks in diverse environmental scenarios. The study presents a valuable contribution to the field of power system optimization and provides insights for power system operators and planners in optimizing voltage control strategies and enhancing the overall performance of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Alzheimer’s Disease Prediction using Deep Learning Technique in 3D Brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is one of dangerous neurodegenerative diseases affecting elderly worldwide. A several Deep Learning (DL) and Machine Learning (ML) approaches are employed, but it attains high complicated patterns from MRI scans for detecting AD. To overcome these limitations, an efficient DL approaches are proposed for predicting Alzheimer disease in 3D brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). A proposed DL approach involves two stages namely segmentation as well as classification, these approaches are based on DL. 3D Brain MRI input is converted into 2D slices and Adaptive Histogram Equalization (AHE), skull stripping approaches are utilized in preprocessing. Then preprocessing, integration of Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) is applied for segmenting a MRI input. After segmentation, an integration of Deep Neural Network (DNN) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) are utilized for classifying an AD based on segmented tissues. In this proposed approach, datasets such as Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS) are utilized and attains better performance of 99.85% and 99.84% of accuracies when compared with existing approaches.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Learning Approach to Improve Credit Scoring Accuracy for Imbalanced Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The assessment of loan risks, known as credit scoring, is a critical procedure within the financial industry. However, this process often faces difficulties as a result of uneven data distributions. Imbalances are evident when one class has a much greater representation than the other, resulting in standard machine learning techniques displaying a bias towards the more prevalent class. The present work presents a new ensemble learning approach that aims to enhance the accuracy of credit scoring in situations when there are imbalanced class distributions. The proposed methodology incorporates a combination of several fundamental classifiers that have been trained on separate subsets of the initial dataset, resulting in a cohesive ensemble model. A series of experiments were done on a credit scoring dataset with unbalanced classes, exploring several ensemble methodologies like as bagging, boosting, and stacking. The results indicate that the ensemble strategy proposed in this study outperforms traditional techniques, exhibiting greater accuracy and F1 score. Furthermore, we conduct an analysis on the effects of various ensemble tactics on performance, offering significant insights into the process of ensemble learning for credit scoring data that is uneven. The technique proposed in this study offers a viable alternative to address the problem of imbalanced credit scoring data, hence improving the accuracy and fairness of credit scoring models in the financial industry.

articleTitle: Object Detection in Adverse Weather Conditions using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Object detection in challenging weather conditions is a formidable hurdle in the realm of computer vision. Unfavorable weather circumstances, encompassing rain, snow, fog, and low light conditions, substantially impede the effectiveness of conventional computer vision algorithms. This research paper introduces an innovative approach to image-to-image translation by harnessing the power of CycleGAN, a deep learning architecture renowned for its proficiency in transmuting images from one domain to another. This study is dedicated to tailoring the CycleGAN framework to the specific task of enhancing images captured in adverse weather conditions, such as rain, fog, and snow. The proposed methodology capitalizes on the deployment of two distinctive generators, trained cyclically, for the transformation of images between a source domain (representing adverse weather) and a target domain (signifying clear weather). These generators are bolstered by discriminator networks, enabling adversarial training to enhance the quality of image translation.

articleTitle: Strategies Optimization of Enterprise Marketing Based on Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the continuous penetration of the Internet, new marketing methods are breaking the traditional market development pattern, and Tiktok Live has accelerated the transformation of book marketing methods. Based on the questionnaire survey, this study takes book marketing as the research object, analyzes its development status and the sales volume model of Tiktok, and uses the Logistic regression model to empirically analyze the influencing factors of Tiktok marketing on book purchase intention. The results show that the monthly income of consumers, the interactive experience of Tiktok platform, the after-sales security of Tiktok platform, and the promotion means of Tiktok platform have a significant positive impact on consumers’ purchase of books. All other factors do not pass the significance test and do not have statistical significance. Based on the above results, this paper puts forward relevant suggestions on Tiktok marketing books, including enhancing interactive experience, increasing promotion frequency and improving after-sales level to provide reference for relevant researchers.

articleTitle: Research on Photographic Image Classification Based on Multi-model Fusion and Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The study adopted a multi model fusion approach to improve image classification accuracy, using two classic convolutional neural network models, AlexNet and VGGNet, for training. A data augmentation method based on optimized classification was also proposed. This method improves the classification performance of the network model by adding input samples for categories with poor classification performance. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the fusion model on a single dataset reaches 0.95. Compared with other models, the fusion model exhibits higher classification accuracy, stronger classification ability, and higher AUC value. In summary, data augmentation methods and multi model fusion can effectively improve the accuracy of image classification. The research results indicate that the application of fusion models and appropriate data augmentation strategies in power terminal security protection models can improve classification accuracy and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Recognition Technology of Print Robot in Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the digital era, the interaction between people and machines is constantly changing the way of interaction between people and between people and society, making people feel the unprecedented development of science and technology. In order to systematically study the influence of human-computer interaction on automatic recognition technology of print robot, the influence of human-computer interaction on human thinking mode, behavior mode and experience demand is analyzed. Secondly, from the perspective of media and its interaction, it describes the impact of human-computer interaction on machine recognition methods from four aspects: expanding the range of spatial information through multisource data, and improving the sensory experience through multi-channel interaction. Finally, under the background of new information technology, new interaction mode, intelligent feedback and new emotional factors, the dynamic response process is improved through real-time recording and feedback. The interaction between machines can create more opportunities for the automatic recognition technology of printing robots, and expand the research direction and the development of new designs.

articleTitle: Analysis of Classical and Machine Learning Techniques in Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this work, a detailed review of literature is conducted on the state of the research of classical and machine learning methods in cognitive radio networks. While the current focus is on machine learning by the research community, it is always important to understand how the classical methods have the advantage over machine learning methods and vice versa. Hence the analysis of both the approaches are undertaken in this study. Classical methods like energy detection, matched filter methods, cyclostationary methods, cluster methods etc are discussed in detail along with the advantages and limitations. In the space of machine learning techniques, most of the methods applied to cognitive radio system are discussed. Machine learning, deep learning, evolutionary methods, fuzzy methods are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Collaborative Recommendation of E-commerce Products Based on Data Mining of Consumer Purchasing Behavior Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the development of network economy, using e-commerce platform to establish the relationship between enterprises and consumers and enhance trust has become an important goal of enterprise management. By mining the distributed information power of consumer behavior, combining the community trust and preference similarity of user relations, we can find the nearest neighbor of the target user, predict consumer purchase behavior. Apply SMOTE-ENN method to solve the uncertainty problem to ensure the accuracy of product recommendation. The improved algorithm is compared with random forest algorithm, XG boost algorithm and light GBM algorithm. The results show that the estimation performance of random memory model is the best among the three models, and the accuracy and memory of test results exceed 0.85%. It is the second and only model of LightGBM, but there are differences in predictable performance. The practice shows that the improved recommendation algorithm has obvious advantages in accuracy, recall and F-index system.

articleTitle: Predicting Chronic Kidney Disease using Machine Learning in the Early Stages
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: chronic kidney disease (CKD) is an illness that causes a decline in kidney function. The CKD early diagnosis is tough since it does not have initial symptoms. The early disease can stop the infection advancement with a well-timed diagnosis. The research aim is to implement and compare the various algorithm’s performance and identify the best combinations that can provide better detection accuracy. We have found the solution using Machine Learning (ML) approaches that can achieve risk minimization. Seven ML algorithms have been utilized in this work with Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and Support as model evaluation parameters. In this comparison, RF and AdaBoost algorithms provided the uppermost accuracy worth 99%. Finally, data analysis is performed such as frequency distribution, Correlation between the features, Feature distribution plots, classification, and prediction plots. The domain of predictive analysis of CKD can be significantly enhanced by ML algorithms. By collaborating with them, healthcare professionals will be able to design a computer-aided diagnosis system that can enhance their ability to treat patients effectively.

articleTitle: A Methodological Study on Selection of Comparable Companies for Mergers and Acquisitions of Listed Companies Based on KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the frequent occurrence of mergers and acquisitions (M&As) by listed companies, valuation has become an important component of the M&A process. This study first analyzes the current situation of comparable companies in the valuation of mergers and acquisitions of listed companies, and divides the impact of comparable company selection into industry level and enterprise level. This study analyzed the distribution characteristics of comparable companies through Gini coefficient analysis. Simultaneously use the K-Nearest neighbor algorithm for high-dimensional similarity matching to screen comparable companies. The results show that when $K=5$ is set, 5 most similar companies can be obtained as comparable companies. The average price to book ratio of the 5 comparable companies is 2.51, and the difference rate from the average price to book ratio of comparable companies is 20.15%, which is within an acceptable range. Therefore, the rationality of the model for selecting comparable companies can be verified.

articleTitle: Application of Liu Ge Conference Artificial Neural Network in Landscape Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to study the application of artificial neural networks in landscape design, referring to the general process of psychophysical methods in landscape evaluation, the concept of "water surface visual proportion" was introduced to study the application of artificial neural networks in river landscape quality evaluation. An artificial neural network model that can predict the quality of river landscape in reduced water reaches was established. This model has good convergence and generalization ability. The prediction and evaluation results of this model indicate that when the vegetation around the river is good, the visual proportion of the water surface increases between 5% and 20%, and the river landscape improves significantly; When the surrounding vegetation is poor, the visual proportion of the water surface increases between 15% and 40%, and the river landscape improves significantly. That is, the vegetation around the river can alleviate the adverse landscape impact of water reduction in the river section. In the development and utilization of water resources, in addition to ensuring a certain flow rate within the river, plant measures and engineering measures should also be fully combined to carry out appropriate restoration of the river channel, in order to maintain or improve the river landscape.

articleTitle: Fostering Global Stability: Machine Learning for Anticipating Terrorism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The threat of terrorism remains a significant global concern, with governments and security agencies continually seeking advanced methods for mitigating and preventing attacks. Machine learning has emerged as a powerful tool for predictive analysis, offering the potential to anticipate and prepare for potential terrorism incidents. This paper aims to develop a machine learning model that can predict the likelihood of a terrorism attack based on historical data and relevant features. The results of the study will offer valuable insights into the potential application of machine learning to enhance counterterrorism efforts. It’s important to emphasize that terrorism is a multifaceted issue and should be seen as a supplementary tool rather than a comprehensive solution.

articleTitle: Cloud Network Traffic Classification and Intrusion Detection System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the increasing adoption of cloud computing, the security of network traffic and the detection of intrusions within cloud environments have become paramount concerns. This survey paper delves into the realm of cloud network traffic classification and intrusion detection systems, focusing on the application of deep learning techniques.
