The paper provides an in-depth analysis of the fundamental concepts of cloud network traffic and intrusion detection, highlighting the challenges associated with securing these dynamic and distributed environments. The survey thoroughly explores various deep learning techniques, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, autoencoders, and transfer learning, elucidating their relevance and applicability to cloud security. It delves into their strengths and limitations, paving the way for their integration into cloud security strategies.Two major aspects of cloud security are individually addressed. First, the paper investigates cloud network traffic classification using deep learning models. It dissects different architectural designs, such as CNN-based and RNN-based models, and examines their efficacy in accurately categorizing network traffic. Additionally, the survey delves into intrusion detection systems (IDS) powered by deep learning algorithms, showcasing approaches like anomaly detection with autoencoders and sequence-based intrusion detection with RNNs.The survey goes beyond individual techniques to explore hybrid approaches that combine traffic classification and intrusion detection. Real-world case studies are presented to demonstrate the practical implementation of these techniques in diverse cloud environments, from multi-cloud setups to edge clouds. A comprehensive comparison and analysis of techniques are conducted, focusing on evaluation metrics and factors influencing model performance.As the paper concludes, it highlights emerging trends in deep learning for cloud security and underscores the open challenges in scalability, real-time processing, and ethical considerations. This survey not only serves as a comprehensive guide for researchers and practitioners but also underscores the critical importance of robust cloud security frameworks in an era of evolving cyber threats and cloud-based operations.

articleTitle: Designing a ARRHHO with MCFSA-CNN based Models for DevOps practices in Software Organizations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Best practises for deploying DevOps have been identified through study utilising the freely accessible HELENA2 dataset. Additionally, an adaptive relative reflection Harris Hawks optimisation (ARHHO) is utilised as a feature selection, which broadens the scope of traditional HHO, solves the issue of local optimal solution stagnation, by a mapping-based cuttlefish optimisation method (MCFA) to create a forecast model for DevOps deployment. Based on this research, the next four practices are the most vital for managing DevOps practises efficiently across the life cycle of projects. This study’s contribution goes beyond simply finding the most effective DevOps techniques; I t also allows for the forecasting of DevOps project success and the prioritisation of these techniques. Assists software companies in causal which best practises to prioritise depending on the specifics of their projects. After the MCFSA-CNN perfect attained the accuracy of 95.69 and the MCC rate as 92.01 then preccision rate as 96.24 then recall rate as 94.76 and F1-score as 95.48 correspondingly.

Author Keywords: Adaptive relative reflection Harris Hawks optimization

articleTitle: Design Practice of Network Information Security System Based on CA Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The arrival of the information age has not only brought rapid technological progress and the emergence of new technologies, but also brought serious challenges such as technological crime and technological security. The Internet is the most promising new technology in the 21st century, and its rapid development has enabled it to enter various aspects of people’s daily lives, from simple weather information to data collection, and then to cross-border business. Many people want to know how reliable the internet is because it is so close to us, closely connected to our lives and work, and the reality is always unsatisfactory. No one believes that today’s internet is secure; The openness of the Internet has made it public, and its security has been severely affected. This article discusses a practical enterprise level application security solution. This solution combines CA (Certificate Authority) technology, LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol), and database technology to create a PKI based network security framework. Deploying and practicing this solution would effectively solve many enterprise application security issues and significantly improve application security. Finally, experiments have also verified that the network information security system based on CA technology has good performance (with a packet loss rate of 16% when the contracting rate is reduced to 10000p/s, which is the smallest of the five technologies).

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Optimized Irrigation System using Soil Moisture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Agriculture serves as a crucial foundation for developing any growing nation, being the primary source of sustenance and employment. However, in the face of a rapidly changing world, the agricultural sector must adapt to continue fulfilling its role in supporting the country. With climate change altering rainfall patterns, the traditional knowledge that has been passed down through generations for predicting rainfall is no longer adequate for ensuring efficient farming practices. This can result in situations where crops experience either inadequate hydration or excessive irrigation. Under-hydration can be detrimental to crop survival, while over-irrigation poses issues with soil aeration and salinity. The consequences of over-irrigation include increased weed growth and the development of diseases that may shorten plants’ lifespans and diminish overall tree health and vitality. To address these challenges, it becomes essential to adopt innovative techniques that conserve water during the irrigation process. In the proposed system, both soil moisture levels using a soil moisture sensor and the probability of precipitation over the field - fetched from the weather API - are continuously monitored. By combining data from these factors, an optimized decision is made to ensure the plants receive water only when necessary. This approach aims to enhance watering efficiency while promoting optimal plant growth and sustainability.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Finance Risk Management Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This study aims to explore supply chain finance risk management leveraging blockchain technology. Supply chain finance, integral to business progression, contends with several risks, such as credit risk, liquidity risk, and information asymmetry. Blockchain technology, celebrated for its decentralization, security, and transparency, emerges as a solution for these challenges. After a thorough literature review on supply chain finance and blockchain technology, we delve into the practical implications of blockchain in this domain. Our newly proposed blockchain-based supply chain finance risk management model gets underscored, discussing its pivotal elements like smart contracts, distributed ledger, and data encryption. In testing our model, we observed a 35% reduction in credit risk incidents, a 50% increase in supply chain transparency, and a 20% cut in transaction costs. These tangible results validate the profound advantages of integrating blockchain in supply chain finance risk management.

articleTitle: Attitude Control of Steel Structure Damage Detection under YOLO Algorithm and PID
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Strengthening the real-time monitoring and diagnosis of steel structure buildings is very important for timely detection of structural damage, evaluation of its safety, and guidance on its maintenance. Based on fuzzy fractional order PID control, YOLO algorithm is used to adjust the fractional order PID order effectively. Based on the mathematical model and the controller, the pitch angle of the flexible robot is taken as input and the rotational torque is output to control the motion of the flexible robot, so as to realize the real-time control of the motion attitude of the flexible robot. The adjustment time of the ordinary PID controller is 20s, that of the fuzzy PID controller is 15s, and that of the fuzzy frit-order PID controller is 5s. The method presented in this paper can make the flexible damage detection robot quickly reach the desired motion posture, and can effectively suppress the jitter, and the reaction speed is fast and the stability is good.

Author Keywords: fuzzy fractional order proportional integral differential

articleTitle: DiffWA: Diffusion Models for Watermark Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep neural networks (DNNs), many robust blind watermarking algorithms and frameworks have been proposed and achieved good results. At present, the watermark attack algorithm can not compete with the watermark addition algorithm. And many watermark attack algorithms only care about interfering with the normal extraction of the watermark, and the watermark attack will cause great visual loss to the image. To this end, we propose DiffWA, a conditional diffusion model with distance guidance for watermark attack, which can restore the image while removing the embedded watermark. The core of our method is training an image-to-image conditional diffusion model on unwatermarked images and guiding the conditional model using a distance guidance when sampling so that the model will generate unwatermarked images which is similar to original images. We conducted experiments on CIFAR-10 using our proposed models. The results shows that the model can remove the watermark with good effect and make the bit error rate of watermark extraction higher than 0.4. At the same time, the attacked image will maintain good visual effect with PSNR more than 31 and SSIM more than 0.97 compared with the original image.

articleTitle: License Plate Recognition using Attention-LSTM with Dove Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent years, license plate prediction has advanced with machine learning, enabling accurate automated identification of vehicle plates for various applications, including law enforcement and surveillance. This study addresses the problem of effectively anticipating variations in traffic flow on metropolitan road networks, which are characterized by intermittent patterns and intense short-term volatility. DSOA-LSTM integrates Dove Swarm Optimization with Attention-based LSTM to improve traffic volume estimates using data analysis that takes into consideration spatial-temporal correlations. The attention mechanism in temporal correlation modeling demonstrates the importance of historical observations in the LSTM model. DSOA enhances license plate prediction by iteratively modifying parameters, emulating collaborative optimization, and is inspired by dove flocking behavior. The results showed that DSOA-LSTM is superior, with low Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 6.55 and Mean Absolute Error of 4.65 and improved stability throughout several prediction phases, particularly in capturing intense short-term variations in traffic volume.

articleTitle: Assessing the Efficiency of Machine Learning Techniques on Multiple Cloud Platforms for Detecting Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Breast cancer is a serious global concern, accounting for 12.5% of all new cancer cases every year. Half of all breast cancer cases are diagnosed in women who have no recognized risk factors. The fundamental causes of breast cancer remain unknown, and no definitive cure has been discovered. Inadequate health-care resources frequently result in delayed diagnoses and treatments. This problem can be solved via machine learning. Advanced deep learning algorithms can provide early diagnoses, which can improve patient outcomes and boost survival rates dramatically. However, the main objective of this paper is to assess the computational power of the three different cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft AzureML (AML) over the range of algorithms namely Support Vector Machines (SVM), Naive Bayes (NB), Decision Trees (DT), Neural Network Classifier (NNC), and Logistic Regression (LR). The reference dataset for testing and comparison is the Wisconsin Breast Cancer Database (WBCD). Binary Neural Network has the highest accuracy and recall, with scores of 97.20% and 95.26%, respectively. Logistic Regression, on the other hand, displayed the highest precision, with a score of 99.13%. At 85.99%, the Boosted Decision Tree regressor had the greatest coefficient of determination for a regression model. Overall, across all the three cloud platforms chosen for the study Support Vector Machine has taken highest run time across the cloud platforms. The outcome shows that classification ML algorithms outperform regression ones for binary disease diagnosis like breast cancer, while regression models are less accurate. Also, the study suggests further research with a larger dataset and diverse ML algorithms for more conclusive insights into computational power on cloud platforms.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Extractive Text Summarization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Automatic Text Summarization (ATS) is a developing area of Natural Language Processing (NLP). It is concerned with simplifying a summary from a given text while retaining key information. Because of the exponential increase of content on the internet, this is a current area that is used in summarizing a text available in books, newsletters, internal document analysis, patent research, e-learning, and so on. Manually summarizing large amounts of text is difficult for humans. As a result, the demand for more complicated and powerful summarizers has skyrocketed. To match the performance of human-generated summaries, various machine learning algorithms are applied. Extractive text summarization finds and connects fundamental segments of a record to make a more limited report that sums up the first archive’s items. A machine learning approach for Extractive text summarization has been explored in this paper.

articleTitle: Stock Market Time Series Forecasting using Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Stock market analysis and prediction are indeed challenging due to the inherent unpredictability and complexity of stock price movements. Stock market data is characterized by its fluctuating nature, making it a crucial source of market efficiency. However, this volatility also adds to the difficulty of making accurate predictions. Researchers have long sought to understand and forecast future market trends, and recently, machine learning has become a significant player in this field. Machine learning techniques, such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models, have gained prominence for their ability to handle sequential data and make predictions. LSTM models are a type of recurrent neural network (RNN) that excels in capturing dependencies and patterns in time series data. They have proven useful in predicting stock prices and market trends by leveraging historical data and identifying meaningful patterns and features. The integration of machine learning in stock market prediction involves the deployment of various predictive models and algorithms to automate decision-making processes. These models can analyze large volumes of historical stock data, news sentiment, economic indicators, and more to make informed predictions about future stock values. LSTM models, in particular, have shown promise in capturing the temporal dynamics of stock prices, allowing for more accurate forecasting.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Model for Traffic Control in Urban Area
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Reinforcement learning offers a novel approach for addressing complicated signal optimization challenges at intersections. Previous research was conducted to conventional traffic detection methods, resulting in imprecise traffic information. However, with technological advancements, access to highly accurate traffic data becomes possible through advanced detector technology. This serves as a reliable data source for deep reinforcement learning. Given the numerous intersections in urban networks, effectively applying reinforcement learning in real-world situations requires addressing the challenge of transferring knowledge gains during training of new scenarios. This study presents a novel approach to traffic control system design using reinforcement learning, focusing on evaluating its performance in terms of waiting time and standard deviation. Compared to existing models, the proposed system demonstrates remarkable improvements, with significantly reduced waiting times and standard deviation. The low waiting time highlights the system’s efficiency in managing traffic flow, leading to reduced congestion and a better commuting experience. Moreover, the decreased standard deviation signifies a more predictable traffic pattern, contributing to safety and reliability in travel times. These findings hold promise for improving urban mobility and reducing the environmental impact of traffic congestion. By harnessing reinforcement learning, cities can aspire to implement more sustainable transportation systems, benefiting both commuters and the environment. The results indicate that the presented approach offered least waiting time up to 0 for emergency vehicles, 40 seconds for regular vehicles and lower standard deviation (SD) in contrast to the existing methods.

articleTitle: The Application of Intelligent Computing and Machine Learning in OPGW Temperature Monitoring and Early Warning System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The construction scale of transmission lines continues to expand, and the safety, stability and reliability of their operation have become particularly important. This article proposes a temperature monitoring and early warning system based on Internet of Things technology to address the temperature problem in OPGW (Optical Power Grounded Wave) lines. This article uses intelligent computing and machine learning technology to monitor and provide early warning of OPGW temperature data, and applies Savitzky-Golay filtering, Bayesian and other algorithms to process and analyze the temperature data, thereby achieving temperature monitoring and early warning. In the experiment, different solutions were used to test the OPGW temperature data. Experimental data shows that as the temperature increases, its Brillouin frequency value changes in proportion to the difference between 0.01 and 0.02, respectively, and then increases. The system uses advanced temperature sensors, wireless communication technology and big data analysis methods to achieve real-time temperature monitoring and early warning of the OPGW line.

articleTitle: Construction of Air Pollutant Monitoring and Air Quality Prediction Models based on Optimized Random Forests
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the accelerated pace of industrialization and urbanization, effective monitoring and accurate prediction are key to maintaining the environment. In this study, a random forest model based on adaptive genetic algorithm optimization was developed. The results show that the prediction results are highly consistent with the actual data, with the highest and lowest values of 178 and 21 for the test data, and 176 and 33 for the actual data. It is found that the model has high prediction accuracy and robustness, which provides scientific basis and technical support for air pollution management and policy making.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy based CNN Method for Covid 19 Classification in Noisy Chest X-ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused a global health crisis. Chest X-ray (CXR) imaging is most commonly utilized techniques for diagnosing COVID-19. However, accuracy of CXR-based diagnosis is limited by the presence of noisy labels. Noisy labels are labels that are incorrect or inaccurate. They can be caused by a variety of factors, such as human error, image artifacts, and variations in imaging protocols. In this paper, a novel method is introduced for COVID-19 CXR image classification in the presence of noisy labels. The primary objective of this research is to improve the accuracy of COVID-19 detection in X-ray images that are characterized by the presence of noise. To achieve this, proposed method incorporates direction-based fuzzy rules into our methodology, which allows to effectively identify and analyse edges and textures within the X-ray images. The labels are then subjected to undergone manifold learning and multidimensional scaling to eliminate noise. High confidence samples are further chosen as training set for label-recovered dataset in order to increase constancy and precision of a classification framework without compromising its intrinsic performance. The proposed method is evaluated on three publicly available COVID-19 CXR datasets. The results showed that our method can achieve an accuracy of 96.59% on the large dataset, 97.12% on the medium dataset, 98.79% on the small dataset. These results are comparable to the state-of-the-art methods for COVID-19 CXR image classification. This can help to improve the early diagnosis and treatment of COVID-19 patients.

articleTitle: A Resilient Approach to Robust JPEG Steganography: Ensuring Hidden Data Integrity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Modern-day steganography algorithms leveraging the Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG) images have made impressive progress in achieving imperceptibility and undetectability by employing cost-effective embedding techniques. However, these algorithms often fall short in effectively addressing the challenges posed by JPEG recompression, limiting their practical viability. To transcend this limitation, the paper introduces a novel method that judiciously embeds confidential data in discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients to enhance robustness. Experimental results demonstrate superiority of the proposed approach compared to state-of-the-art techniques. Under JPEG recompression with same quality factor, the technique achieves less than 1% message extraction error rate in most test cases, significantly lower than 10-50% error rates of existing methods. Besides, imperceptibility is maintained with PSNR of 51-62 dB. Moreover, by selectively modifying DCT coefficients, computational time is reduced to tens of milliseconds. These advancements hold great potential for various real-world applications, including secure communication over social networking platforms, where JPEG re-compressions are prevalent.

articleTitle: Phishing sites detection using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Phishing links are disseminated by bushwhackers using e-mail, textbook delivery systems, and social media channels. They manipulate drug users into accessing phishing websites and providing crucial information by using social engineering skills. In the end, the stolen personal data is utilized to obtain illicit gains by abusing the confidence of legitimate websites or financial organizations. Some solutions rely on features that rules have forced to be removed, while others need the use of third-party services, which will lead to insecurity and time-consuming problems with the vaccination service.In this study, phishing websites are identified using a machine literacy-grounded frame. The real-time vaticination service combines a number of techniques to improve delicacy, lower the percentage of false alarms, shorten calculation times, and improve machine learning (ML) prediction. Several machine learning models are compared using various datasets in the ML prediction module. The result of the project is that when provided with a link, it can accurately determine whether it is a phishing site or not.Based on the empirical findings, the Logistic Regression model achieved the top accuracy rate of 96.38%, affirming the viability of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Construction of a Motion Data Collection System for Mobile Device Heart Rate Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The heart rate monitoring system is a system based on modern optical technology and computer communication methods. Its main function is to collect real-time physiological data of the human body, analyze motion information, and obtain motion patterns. This article first introduced the research background, significance, and current development status at home and abroad. Then, the heart rate detection method and its principle based on mobile devices were elaborated in detail. Through experiments, the mathematical expression of pulse beating was obtained and converted into corresponding pulse signals to obtain necessary relevant numerical indicator values. Finally, a hardware platform was constructed using a microcontroller in the software and tested. The experimental results showed that the heart rate monitoring system could accurately obtain human heart rate information, with an accuracy rate of 95% or above in normal state and 92% or above in exercise state. The system had high accuracy for heart rate detection in different states. This shows that the accuracy and reliability of heart rate monitoring algorithm for mobile devices are continuously improving. By improving the algorithm and sensor technology, the accuracy of heart rate monitoring is improved, which is close to the level of traditional heart rate monitoring instrument. Mobile devices can collect and record movement data, such as steps, distance, speed and calorie consumption. These data can help users better understand their exercise ability and progress, so as to make a more reasonable fitness plan.

articleTitle: Strengthening Cloud Data Security using Web- Based File Encryption and Decryption with AESCBC- 256
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Ensuring robust data security in cloud computing remains a pressing concern, as the proliferation of cloud services introduces vulnerabilities and risks. This research paper focuses on the implementation of web-based encryption and decryption mechanism for files stored in cloud computing environments, employing the AES-CBC-256 encryption algorithm to rectify the backlogs in cloud security. The encryption algorithm that is extensively employed in the realm of computer security and cryptography is AES-CBC-256, which stands for Advanced Encryption Standard with Cipher Block Chaining mode and a key size of 256 bits. Its primary purpose is to provide secure and confidential communication and data protection. When comparing to other encryption algorithms AES-CBC-256 provides a high level of security due to its large 256-bit key size. The key length makes it highly resistant to brute-force attacks. This structure allows for parallel processing and is suitable for various data formats. The proposed work aims to utilize the AES-CBC-256 algorithm for file encryption and decryption, providing a strong level of security with a 256-bit key. This approach adheres to industry standards and offers efficient computational performance, making it a trustworthy option for protecting confidential information.

articleTitle: Construction of an Intelligent Tourism Public Service Platform Featuring Communication Big data and Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The characteristic intelligent tourism public service platform refers to an online platform that integrates various functions such as tourism information query, product display, reservation, purchase, navigation, voice assistant, etc. Due to its openness and interconnectivity, it has become a massive communication big data and blockchain application scenario. This article aimed to study the application of communication big data and blockchain in the construction of characteristic intelligent tourism public service platforms, and explore the methods and effects of using communication big data and blockchain technology to improve the quality of tourism services and enhance the security and credibility of the platform. This article also adopted experimental design and design comparison methods to explore and analyze the construction of a characteristic intelligent tourism public service platform from two aspects: communication big data and blockchain. According to the evaluation results, the weight value of smart information services is 0.245, which indicates that attention needs to be paid to information services and two major technologies should be utilized to improve the intelligence of information service modules. As a result, importance of tourism information feedback and interaction is 4.44, and the satisfaction is 3.7.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity Through Machine Learning-Based Classification of IoT Network Traffic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: An exponential increase in smart devices connected to the internet leads to progress in the growth of Internet of Things (IoT) technology that has become integral to part of our daily lives. IoT plays a pivotal role in manufacturing, enabling companies to monitor machine statuses in real-time, assess product quality, and track environmental variables within factories. This not only empowers managers to mitigate risks and minimize losses but also facilitates decision-making from a broader operational perspective. However, the proliferation of IoT also introduces security and safety concerns, making anomaly detection crucial for IoT networks. Detecting anomalies promptly and alerting users is essential to prevent potential damage or losses. In this work, utilizing the Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques for detecting anomalies in the IoT network and the dataset used to conduct the experimentation on IoT-23 dataset. Finally, identifying the best model for detecting the anomalies in the IoT network by considering the performance of the model and its training time of different models. In the proposed machine and deep learning models, decision tree outperformed with other models in detecting the anomalies with an accuracy of 73% and model time of 7 seconds.

articleTitle: Chaotic Sparrow Search Algorithm with Deep Learning for Anomaly Detection in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Anomaly Detection (AD) systems play a crucial role in identifying potential cyber-attacks or data breaches by recognizing patterns of irregular data within the Internet of Things (IoT). Standard Machine Learning (ML) techniques often prove inefficient in the face of unpredictable network behaviors and diverse anomalous methods. Deep Learning (DL) has appeared as an efficient as well as robust approach for AD, capable of classifying abnormal behaviors or patterns in data. A Chaotic Sparrow Search Algorithm with DL utilizing Recurrent Neural Network (RNN-CSSA) is proposed for AD in IoT aided sustainable smart cities. A primary objective of RNN-CSSA technique is to accurately detect anomalies in IoT aided smart cities. To achieve this, the RNN-CSSA system employs Binary Pigeon optimization Algorithm (BPEO) for effective feature selection. Additionally, CSSA technique utilizes the RNN approach for classifying anomalies. The evaluations results of the RNN-CSSA algorithm utilized the benchmark databases such as UCI-SECOM and UNSW NB-15. The results exhibit an effectiveness of proposed RNN-CSSA methodology, achieving accuracies of 99.54% and 99.55% in UNSW NB-15 and UCISECOM, when compared with existing models.

articleTitle: A Model-free Approach for Short Term Voltage Stability Assessment of Power System and Individual Bus
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The voltage evolution of power system after large disturbance has chaotic behavior and uncertainty. It is necessary to evaluate the short-term voltage stability of power system. However, current assessment methods rely on system models and are computationally time-consuming, which are not suitable for online assessment. In this paper, we find that nonlinear dynamics theory can effectively solve this problem. Therefore, we use the Lyapunov exponent in nonlinear dynamics as a criterion for evaluating short-term voltage stability. Based on the Lyapunov Exponent, we evaluate the voltage stability of the whole system and the voltage stability of individual buses. Further, we propose a partition method for the unstable region in the power grid and locate the severely unstable bus. Finally, we provide simulation results and performance comparison in IEEE-14 bus system and the IEEE39 bus system, which are used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Art Design System Based on B/S Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In response to the shortcomings of traditional C/S architecture in system performance, compatibility, and other aspects, the author proposes a computer-aided art design system based on B/S architecture. The system adopts a three-layer framework structure, and the hardware part includes a visual interaction subsystem, a graphics processing module, a control module, and an execution module, the author elaborated on the functions of each module separately; At the software level, the system designs the main control process and compilation rules based on JSP technology, and executes the saywhat instruction set program; The database design is based on the SQL Server language and is connected to hardware modules in an embedded manner. The system test results show that the computer assisted system based on B/S architecture has stable functions, faster system response under high load conditions, and stronger scalability.

articleTitle: Face and Action Detection for Crime Prevention: Balancing Promise and Ethical Considerations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This research paper explores the pivotal role of face detection and action detection technologies in the realm of crime prevention. The application of action detection technology is particularly significant as it serves as an invaluable investigative tool for the detection and prevention of criminal activities, mitigating imminent threats to health and safety, bolstering public protection, and enhancing overall security measures. The overarching objective of this project is to leverage these technologies for crime detection and to augment contemporary security frameworks through technological advancements. Face and action detection technology represent promising innovations in the field of crime prevention, gaining widespread recognition in recent times. This paper underscores the substantial potential of these technologies in curbing violent crime. Nevertheless, it underscores the need for a comprehensive examination of the ethical implications pertaining to discrimination and privacy, emphasizing the importance of striking a delicate balance between security and personal liberties. When implemented thoughtfully and ethically, these systems have the potential to serve as instrumental tools in safeguarding public safety and reducing crime rates, offering a promising avenue for future exploration and implementation.

articleTitle: Exploration on Facial Image Recognition and Processing Algorithms under Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Face recognition is an important technology in the field of digital image processing, which has a crucial impact on subsequent work. This article introduced an example of facial recognition based on the combination of Hadoop algorithm and facial feature extraction. The experimental results were validated in the MATLAB environment and trained using neural networks to improve system performance and adaptability. The test results indicated that the processing speed was between 0.84 and 0.97; the highest resource utilization rate was 0.06, and the lowest was 0.02; the throughput range of facial data was between 13598 and 15479, and the throughput range of user data was between 5037 and 5879. This indicated that the system had fast recognition speed and high-precision image output, and exhibited good fault tolerance and robustness compared to other methods. Exploring facial image recognition and processing algorithms in the Hadoop environment can utilize Hadoop’s distributed computing capabilities to accelerate the processing of large-scale facial image data, achieve fast and efficient processing of large-scale facial image data, accelerate algorithm operation, and possess distributed computing capabilities. Multiple computing nodes can be used for parallel processing to improve algorithm performance.

articleTitle: EEG Data Analysis for Stress Detection using K-Nearest Neighbor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Stress is a impactful condition affecting individuals’ well-being, making its objective assessment and management vital. In recent years, electroencephalography (EEG) has emerged as a promising tool for real-time stress measurement. This paper presents a comprehensive review of EEG-based stress detection methods and their applications. Notably, the proposed model showcased remarkable performance, achieving 100% accuracy in classifying stress and relaxation levels using EEG signals. The review underscores the identification of distinct EEG patterns associated with stress, such as elevated beta and theta power alongside decreased alpha and beta coherence. Various feature extraction techniques have been leveraged to extract pertinent information from EEG signals. Machine learning algorithms like K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) have been instrumental in accurately classifying stress levels. This model when compared to the CIS-KNORAU DES model described in the research article with reference number of 17 as in the references.

articleTitle: Integrated Emergency Communication System Based on Low Earth Orbit Satellite and Beidou Satellite Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to adapt to the characteristics of unexpected events in China, a rapid response and efficient coordination emergency communication and command system has been constructed. The article adopted a "space-air-ground" integrated emergency communication system solution based on low orbit satellite and Beidou satellite technology, analyzed the overall architecture and key technologies of the system, and elaborated on the system composition, working principle, and application effect in detail. The results showed that the coverage of the system increased from an average of 88.30% to 95.56%. The article has provided a high coverage, high reliability, and high efficiency emergency communication solution for responding to emergencies, which has certain reference value for the construction of emergency communication guarantee system.

articleTitle: Earlier Detection of Plant Disease and Recommending Pesticides using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Plant disease detection systems may face challenges in accurately distinguishing between various diseases, especially when symptoms overlap or environmental factors introduce ambiguity, impacting the system’s reliability. The agricultural innovation described involves an integrated system for early plant disease detection and targeted pesticide recommendations. It utilizes preprocessing, feature extraction, and advanced classification algorithms. Data from IoT sensors and high-resolution imaging devices are collected to monitor crop conditions and remove image noise using Gaussian smoothing. Feature extraction, particularly the Histogram Oriented Gradients method, is employed to identify disease symptoms and environmental parameters. Advanced machine learning algorithms, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), are used to classify diseases and recommend pesticides based on disease type, severity, crop, and environmental conditions. This innovation enhances timely disease identification and promotes more precise and sustainable pesticide use, leading to increased agricultural productivity and reduced environmental impact. MATLAB is used for research evaluation, showing 7% superior performance compared to existing methodologies.

articleTitle: Data Exploratory on Taxi Data in New York City
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With increasing amounts of urban data being collected and made available, new possibilities of data-driven research emerge lead to changes in people living through scientific proof-based decision-making and strategies. In this paper, the researcher concentrates on an urban data set of particular significance which is taxi rides. Taxis are essential instruments, and taxi-related information can provide groundbreaking insight into different facets of city life, from economic activity and human behavior to mobility trends. Taxi data involves geographical components as well as several variables associated with each ride. Throughout this research, data insight is gain through data pre-processing, feature engineering and data exploratory analysis on the city transportation. The data exploration reveals the time, geo-location details, taxi fare and optimal fleet size of taxi transportation in the city. This transformation of raw data enables researcher, data scientist to have the meaningful insight into the data and understand the mobility pattern of New York City.

articleTitle: Recommendation of College English Education Information Based on Fuzzy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to better cope with the explosive growth of network teaching information more accurate extraction of user required education information. In this study, a college English teaching information recommendation system based on multiple mixed criteria fuzzy algorithm is designed. Through English educational information retrieval, database design and recommendation display application, higher recommendation information can be better extracted by combining user preferences. Through the system application test results, it can be seen that the English educational information recommendation system involved in this article can achieve a wider range of content coverage. In addition, when the number of system users increases to 500, the accuracy of system users’ discovery is stable at 95%, and the recommendation recall rate is always above 90%. The recommendation effect of education information system is good, it fully shows that the recommendation effect of the English education information system proposed in this paper is good.

articleTitle: A Research on Carbon Power Market Synergy Strategy Based on Electricity Trading Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Clarifying the relationship between power market and carbon market is an important starting point for deepening the reform of power market and realizing the goal of “double carbon”. Based on the electricity transaction flow, this paper studies the carbon trading mechanism and quota allocation scheme of power industry, analyzes the direct or indirect coupling influence mechanism of power market and carbon market and their correlation through grey correlation, establishes the electricity spot market model under the carbon market environment, analyzes the mechanism of electricity spot market and the marginal cost of short-term operation of units, and sets up different scenarios to analyze the objective functions and constraints of power generation enterprises and power economic dispatch, and uses the unified clearing mechanism to clear the electricity spot market. It is found that the power supply cost of units increases significantly after carbon emission cost is included, and the carbon price needs to exceed a certain threshold to make low-emission units clear first, so as to achieve the effect of system emission reduction, which provides reference for the realization of the Carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals. As a result, the LSTM method provided MAPE, MAE, and Error with values of 1.31, 1.05, and 0.22, that the LSTM provided less errors compared with state-of-the-art-methods.

articleTitle: Utilization of Virtual Reality Technology in Crime Scene Investigation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In Malaysia, crime scene forensics animations are becoming an increasingly important visual aid in courtroom situations, where complex data relating to a sequence of events is being visualized before a general public who may have little or no understanding of established forensic procedure or methodology. This paper will introduce and discuss a spectrum of new technology that utilize new developments of Virtual Reality (VR) for a range of incident investigation and presentation scenarios. This paper discussed on the past research that has been carried on in relation to the Crime Scene Investigation Framework. Crime Scene Investigation is a method of protecting, processing and reconstructing the particular crime. It is a process of preserving the evidence, running test on the preserved evidence and construct the possible scene that could picture the crime. The process includes a framework that is used as a guideline on what needed to be followed to get all evidences to be accepted in the court room. In this paper, the specific objective would be supported with journals with elaboration. The journals would not be so specific to the topics, but they will be related in small portion. This is where the discussion of the objective is made. This will allow the users to understand the specific purpose of utilizing VR in crime scene investigation.

articleTitle: Mulberry Leaves Diseases and Disease Identification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In sericulture, the young caterpillars of the common silk moth, also known as ”Bombyx Mori,” are the most widely used species of silkworm. For the purpose of raising silkworms, mulberry plants are grown. Mulberry leaves are the main source of food for silkworms. Mulberry leaves are an important economic factor in sericulture because they directly influence the quality and quantity of cocoons produced per unit area. Mulberry leaf diseases cause both a loss in leaf quality and a reduction in leaf yield. Feeding silkworms diseased leaves has an effect on both the quality of the silk produced and the number of cocoons formed. Traditional techniques have been used to detect diseases. However, plant pathologists or agricultural professionals have traditionally used empty-eye observation to find leaf diseases. It takes a lot of labour and in-depth understanding of plant illnesses to detect diseases in plant leaves using this approach, which may be unreliable, time-consuming, and lucrative. Therefore, it is crucial to maintain regular watchfulness and employ effective disease diagnosis methods to safeguard mulberry leaves from various disease attacks.

articleTitle: A Robot Dialogue System for Preschool Education Based on AI Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to improve the dialogue system of preschool education robots and achieve more accurate understanding and execution of text instructions in preschool children’s speech, the author proposes a children’s speech enhancement method based on a two-stage attention mechanism. This method is based on a two-stage attention mechanism and has undergone a series of steps and experimental validation, achieving significant optimization results. Firstly, a detailed analysis was conducted on mainstream speech enhancement methods, and the problems of single channel time-domain speech enhancement methods were identified. Subsequently, a two-stage attention enhancement network for speech enhancement was established. This method allows the machine to focus more on processing input speech data to improve speech quality and clarity. The experimental results show that the two-stage attention speech enhancement method improves the SSNR score by 3.2dB compared to the channel attention enhancement network with higher scores, and its loss value is the lowest among the four models, only 0.87. In addition, the enhanced speech waveform is also clearer, making it easier for the machine to understand and execute instructions in children’s speech

articleTitle: Transferable Deep Network Driven Medicinal Plant Disease Detection and Classification System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper proposes a first of its kind deep learning driven medicinal plants disease detection and classification system. In sync with structural and textural diversities, at first it performed pre-processing like resizing, contrast equalization. Histogram equalization and Z-score normalization. The previously processed datas were then subjected to feature extraction using a popular transferable deep network called AlexNet. With the aid of the ADAM optimizer, the 4096-dimensional deep features that were collected were processed for learning and classification at the Softmax layer, which distinguished between normal and diseased medicinal plants in each input image. The simulation results confirmed that the proposed AlexNet deep network driven solution yields medicinal plant’s disease detection and classification accuracy of 97.27%, precision 95.01%, recall 94.62% and F-Measure 94.81%.

articleTitle: Application of Convolution Neural Network Algorithm in English Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to further strengthen the application effect of deep learning neural network algorithm in English translation and solve the problems of unknown words, transitional translation and missing translation that are common in neural network machine translation technology, this paper proposes an English Chinese machine translation model based on convolution neural network semantic segmentation algorithm on the basis of traditional deep learning machine translation technology. The generalized corpus is used to train the model and predict the translation. At the same time, the unlisted words are translated with the help of dictionaries and translation rules. Model experiments show that based on RNN and transformer models, Bleu values are increased by 4.72% and 4.21% respectively, and the translation accuracy of unlisted words on the latter model is increased by 35.16%, which verifies the application effect of convolution neural network algorithm in Chinese-English machine translation.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System in IoT using Grey Wolf Optimization-Based Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is appearing as a new technology for the development of different critical applications. To prevent adversarial attacks, fraud, and network intrusion, the Intrusion Detection System (IDS) has become a major component of organizations. In this research, the Grey Wolf optimization based Support Vector Machine (GWO-SVM) is proposed for the intrusion detection system using machine learning. Initially, the data is obtained by the Bot-IoT dataset and then min-max normalization is performed to normalize the acquired data. The different feature extraction approaches such as LeeNET, Gray-Level Co-occurrence matrix (GLCM), and Local Ternary Pattern (LTP) are used to extract appropriate features from the obtained data. The GWO approach is used for feature selection which examines appropriate features for classification. Finally, the SVM classification is performed to identify and classify intrusion detection accurately and effectively. The proposed GWO-SVM achieves a better accuracy of 99.67%, precision of 99.50%, recall of 99.47%, and f1-score of 99.60% respectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Computer Open Labs under Mobile Cloud Environment Taking into Account Nonlinear Two-level Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Building a computer open laboratory in a mobile cloud environment is a complex task that requires comprehensive consideration of multiple factors. This paper proposes nonlinear bilevel programming, which uses nonlinear bilevel programming to model the network with a small sample size and categorizes it through computer open laboratories. Nonlinear bilevel programming is used to study the construction of computer open laboratories and to edge out accuracy detection graphs, Filter and process according to the corresponding mobile cloud environment, and finally carry out the construction of a computer open laboratory. Each user name has a corresponding deadline, and the timeout period needs to be reapplied for permission, and only after completing the identity verification in the cloud can the open cloud experiment platform be used to use the virtual experiment resources. The construction of a computer open laboratory can achieve the free opening of laboratory resources, promote the construction of teaching resource network sharing, better achieve a mixed online and offline teaching mode, and improve the quality of experimental teaching.

articleTitle: Enhancing Respiratory Disease Diagnosis through Deep Learning: A CNN-Based Approach for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Early and accurate identification is crucial for the efficient treatment of respiratory diseases. Leveraging the capabilities of Deep-Learning (DL), this work presents a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model for the detection of respiratory diseases utilizing chest X-ray images. We begin by discussing the significant impact of respiratory diseases on human health and the critical need for timely diagnosis. Our proposed CNN model is meticulously designed to classify these X-ray images, distinguishing between normal lung conditions and pneumonia cases. The results showcase an accuracy of 93.62% without normalization and 95.03% with normalization in this crucial diagnostic task. Furthermore, this work lays the groundwork for future enhancements, including image enhancement techniques, advanced feature extraction, and classification models, with the overarching goal of advancing respiratory disease diagnosis and patient care. Through this research, we contribute to the ongoing efforts to combat respiratory diseases, empowering healthcare practitioners with efficient and accurate diagnostic tools.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Analysis of Integrated Mobile Medical Building Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of limited hospital beds and overcrowded wards, a new numerical simulation system was developed with the help of computer-aided technology. This paper first briefly introduces the theory and basic principles of the finite element method. Then, this paper uses the finite element method to carry out a 3D visual simulation of the quality of the integrated mobile medical building, and verifies the model by testing its parameters such as seismic load capacity and wind load capacity. Through comparative analysis, test results are obtained, and the range of the building’s seismic index is between 0.74-0.84; the highest wind resistance index can reach 0.88. The finite element analysis can be used to analyze the permanent magnet linear synchronous motor and modify the finite element model of the bridge. The finite element analysis process mainly includes pre-processing stage, analytical solution stage and post-processing stage, in which mesh generation and mechanical model simplification are the key steps. Numerical simulation and analysis of integrated mobile medical building based on finite element method has broad prospects in practical application. Result shows damage index of the wind to the building is 0.41, and the damage index of the earthquake is 0.46.

articleTitle: Health Information Exchange Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the contemporary landscape, the demand for a distributed digital content system integrating Blockchain technology is burgeoning. Initially gaining prominence in finance with the advent of cryptocurrencies, Blockchain is now permeating diverse sectors such as IoT, Healthcare, Banking, and Supply Chain. This technology provides a decentralized framework, employing a peer-to-peer authentication mechanism to authenticate access management. This study explores the transformative potential of Blockchain in healthcare, offering a secure and tamperproof platform for storing and sharing patient data, thereby enhancing stakeholder management of healthcare information. The focus is on its application in a Health Information Exchange (HIE) system, ensuring secure and efficient access management of Electronic Health Records (EHR). These Blockchain-based solutions have the capacity to revolutionize healthcare information management, elevate patient outcomes, and foster improved stakeholder collaboration, marking a significant stride in the industry’s evolution.

articleTitle: Security and Privacy Preservation Method Based on Data Disturbance for Collaborative Edge Computing for Social-Internet-of-Things (S-IoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Socia1 Internet of Things (SIoT) is new paradigm that integrate human social with physical Internet of Things (IoT) systems, social IoT is ray of hope in providing ubiquitous connectivity among users. The collaborative edge computing for SIoT is significant because it ensures human social features and connections among IoT devices and users. But it is formidable to perform CEC for social IoT due to user privacy, data security and network heterogeneity and so on. The problem of computing and storage in IoT devices is solved by Collaborative edge computing (CEC) with deep learning (DL). To prevent privacy breach and security threats at edge network and edge devices in SIoT system. This research work discusses the data protection method based on data disturbance approach. To ensure correctness of model adversarial training viewpoint is introduced. The proposed method is capable of predicting contextual filtering words in adversarial text examples, and adaptively determine word replacement order. The proposed method BESAW, a BERT Based Simulated Annealing Word algorithm is used. BESAW compare with five existing methods includes TextFooler, BAE, BERT-Attack, PWWS, and PSO in experimental analysis.

articleTitle: Intelligent Management Model of Networked Teaching Resources Based on Natural Language
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Natural languages are used in natural environments and are abstract. However, the emergence of networked teaching resources has broken this situation. This paper first introduces the application of the artificial neural gateway model in the fields of natural linguistics and computer science, as well as the related theories of text and data mining technology. Secondly, this paper analyzes and researches the interactive online learning environment platform system based on the artificial neural gateway model established in different situations. Finally, an example is used to verify that the system can effectively provide personalized learning guidance and management for student groups. The verification results show that the accuracy of the model can reach up to 87.96%, the recall rate is between 0.746-0.895, and the data processing time is maintained within 3 seconds, which can ensure the normal operation of the system.

articleTitle: Temporal-Spatial Power Spectrum and Sensitivity Measure for Visual Perception Considering Video Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Multiple difficulties arise for video transmission in a wide-area millimeter wave (mm-wave) network due to the combined effects of network transmission link shortcomings and real-time limits of video data. The difficulties are compounded, especially in crowded environments, by users’ rising standards for video quality. This work proposes a Perceptual Quality Aware Video Encoding (PQAVE) to address these issues: in stage one, an efficient perceptual quality encoding method is implemented, making use of low-rank approximation to reduce overall video size; in stage two, a novel bitstream optimization method is utilized to enhance perceptual quality. The proposed PQAVE model outperforms the state-of-the-art perceptual video encoding technique in terms of bitrate percentage reduction $(\Delta R)$, and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), as demonstrated by experiments conducted on a standard video dataset. The PQAVE achieved an average $\triangle R$ of 58.012 and an average PSNR of 41.071 which is better when compared with BL-JUNIPER existing work.

articleTitle: Behavior Analysis and Abnormal Detection Technology of Children’s Internet of Things Devices Based on Big data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The security and health status of the children’s IoT system will have a direct impact on the future big data analysis and processing technology, so it is very necessary and meaningful to a security assessment. This paper conducts research on the children’s object domain network based on the large database. First of all, this paper introduces the relevant literature, research status and existing problems about the children’s sensor network platform; subsequently, in view of the lack of abnormal behavior values in the existing data, this paper uses the neural network method to construct a health risk early warning model based on the perception layer, and proposes corresponding algorithms for analysis and prediction; Finally, the experimental results are compared to verify the accuracy, real-time, high efficiency and high scalability of the technology. This paper discusses the importance of anomaly detection in intrusion detection, fraud detection, malware detection, social network anomaly detection in deep learning and log anomaly detection.

articleTitle: ALEXNet Optimized Cross layer Convolution Neural Network Algorithm for Efficient Diabetic Foot Ulcer Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Increasing variety of disease in daily fact affects the human nature, as far diabetic is most harmonic disease creates illness to affect the health. In such a way Diabetic Foot Ulcer (DFU) cause complication which is not controlled to leads diabetic treatment failures. By identifying the disease accurately is the most challenging factor because of prevailing techniques doesn’t concentrates the peripheral segmentation through image processing. This leads inaccurate to detect the disease effectively to find the risk factor. Still, the heterogeneity of diabetic skin lesions and the presence of noise in images taken with digital cameras make lesion extraction a difficult task. To resolve this problem, we presents a new method of Cross Layer Convolution Neural Network (CLCNN) is employed to improve the performance accuracy to contribute feature evaluation perfectly in segmentation level to find the ulcer. Initially preprocessing was carried out by Weiner Filter (WF) and Z-Score Monochrome Normalization (ZSMN) is applied to remove the noise to enhance the image quality. Then Color Quantum Histogram Evaluation (CQHE) is applied to find the spectral margins of wound region to increase the object entity parts findings, ALEXNet optimized Cross layer convolution neural network with ReLU activation function to increase the identification accuracy. Therefore, the experimental result provides high accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, ROC and F-score performance.

articleTitle: Retention Analysis and Player Segmentation based on Gameplay Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The global gaming market has been expanding at a fast pace. However, the online and mobile gaming industry is struggling with the lower retention rate compared to the other domains. Although improving the retention rate will lead to more profit and reducing costs, the extremely high churn rate makes it difficult to apply the mass marketing strategy. In order to solve this problem, player segmentation is one of the approaches to design appropriate marketing campaigns to improve the retention rate. Therefore, the goal of this paper is to improve the retention rate by cluster and retention analysis. To achieve this, new players needs to be segmented. Player segmentation was conducted by using the Agglomerative hierarchical and K-means algorithms and based on the aggregated player variables which were retrieved from play log. The K-means model with Manhattan method is selected as the best clustering model. New players are categorized into three segments by the model; Churners, Constant players, and Initially excited players. Next, retention analysis for the player segments was conducted. Retention rates were calculated on Day1, Day7 and Day28 for the three segments, and characteristics of each segment were extracted. Based on the characteristics, segmental recommendations to improve the retention rate were suggested for the three segments: constant players, churners and initially excited players. The segmental recommendations allow to adequately approach more specific and narrowed players.

articleTitle: Enhancing Resource Utilization in Cloud Environments using the Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Cloud computing provides many features to the user to retrieve, update and access the data virtually with the help of internet. It has emerged as a transformative pattern in information technology, giving scalable and on-demand access to a wide variety of resources. However, effective resource management continues to be a major obstacle to fully utilizing the advantages of cloud systems. This study examines the use of three different optimization algorithms, a Standard Particle swarm optimization (PSO), Aging Leader and Challenger (ALC)-PSO, and Whale Optimization Algorithm (WHO), to enhance resource allocation in cloud infrastructures. All these algorithms provide the greatest efficiency when we compare them to the 100 number of iterations to 1000 iterations. The Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) provides results highest in all among the standard PSO and the ALC-PSO makespan. This technique can be used in the context of cloud computing to dynamically assign resources depending on changes in workload and demand in real-time. This research aims to improve cloud resource utilisation by using swarm optimisation algorithms to the problem.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction and Portfolio Optimization Using Hidden Markov Model and Quadratic Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This study introduces a decision support system for optimizing stock portfolios. It employs a Hidden Markov Model for 95% accurate stock price forecasts over a five-day period. The system utilizes Quadratic Programming to refine allocation, focusing on up to 15 blue-chip companies. Key indicators like MACD, RSI, and Bollinger Bands offer clear buy, sell, or hold recommendations. It actively monitors the Philippine Stock Exchange, notifying users of significant deviations. Developed in Python and C#, both models were trained on a consistent 5-year dataset for reliable performance. Results show high prediction accuracy, averaging 98.923% (high price) and 98.741% (low price), benefiting investment strategies. The study compared SPOT-allocated portfolios to random ones, revealing a notable difference in profit/loss allocation. This underscores its value for informed and profitable decision-making in stock trading.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Sentiment Classification using Feature Selection and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Sentiment analysis (SA) is a popular method for collecting relevant and arbitrary information from text-based data. To locate, examine, extract reactions, and emotions from the data or states, it applies computational linguistics, biometrics, text analysis, and Natural Language Processing (NLP). A SA model can be developed and improved with the use of the features analysis method. However, it can be difficult to find best classification methods for this type of data. When compared to current feature-based methods, machine learning approaches for analysis of sentiment, are capable of providing precise representation and improved performance. In this paper, the machine learning (ML) method was proposed for improving sentiment classification performance with a sophisticated embedding word method and develop an Emperor Penguin Optimization (EPO) and Multi-class Support Vector Machine (SVM). For the purpose of predicting the sentiment of tweets for classification, a large amount of Amazon data is analysed. This study, concentrate on improving sentiment analysis performance by building a Multi-class SVM network and particularized model of machine learning with novel word embedding techniques. The Multi-class SVM model has achieved 99.89% accuracy sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Advanced Machine Learning for Risk Assessment of Cardiovascular Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This research carried out a thorough analysis of machine learning algorithms that are used to predict cardiovascular disease. Using a large dataset with a variety of patient variables, the study used a variety of models, such as logistic regression, neural network classification, random forest classification, support vector classification, and xgboost classification. The accuracy of the suggested model was quite good, especially when it came to logistic regression, which scored almost 90%. Based on a comparative examination of the models, logistic regression was shown to be the most dependable approach for precisely forecasting cardiovascular illness. By giving medical personnel a useful tool for early identification and individualised treatment planning, these results mark a substantial breakthrough and will eventually improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: An Insight into the Data Recovery of Deleted or Heavily Damaged Storage Media Through the Lens of R-Studio
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Data recovery is a part of digital forensic investigation that is carried out on storage media that is supported with different operating system and file system. This paper discusses on logical data recovery with R-Studio Data Recovery tool. The usage of R-Studio Data Recovery tool together with other R-Studio tools allows investigators to examine the challenging storage media efficiently. This paper will be divided into few sections which will discuss on the functionality, impact and requirement of the tool, challenges faced during the investigation process of hard drive or external storage media and critical discussion of analysis process.

articleTitle: Isolation Forest based Fraud Detection for Cryptocurrency Transaction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The growing popularity of cryptocurrencies has brought attention to the need for effective fraud detection mechanisms within this dynamic and rapidly evolving domain. This research explores the application of the Isolation Forest algorithm for detecting fraudulent transactions within cryptocurrency networks. The Isolation Forest algorithm is particularly well-suited for identifying anomalies in datasets characterized by imbalanced classes or rare instances, making it an ideal candidate for detecting infrequent fraudulent activities in cryptocurrency transactions. The proposed methodology involves preparing a dataset of cryptocurrency transactions, including features such as transaction amounts, timestamps, and wallet addresses. By labelling the data with known legitimate and fraudulent transactions, the Isolation Forest model is trained to recognize patterns that differentiate between the two classes. During training, the algorithm constructs a forest of isolation trees, and each transaction’s anomaly score is determined based on its average path length through these trees. A critical step involves setting a suitable threshold above which a transaction is deemed anomalous. This threshold is determined through rigorous experimentation and validation to strike a balance between minimizing false positives and capturing actual fraud cases. The trained Isolation Forest model is deployed in a real-time system, capable of processing incoming cryptocurrency transactions and promptly flagging potential instances of fraud. Performance evaluation of the model is conducted using relevant metrics such as precision, recall, and F1-score, on a separate validation or test dataset from which it is proved that the proposed methodology attains 6% performance improvement than the existing methodology.

articleTitle: Blending Tradition with Technology: Saving TULUNAD Art through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Art’s remarkable ability to convey complex ideas with simplicity is a global phenomenon, yet some art forms struggle for recognition due to limited exposure or artists’ financial constraints. Bridging the gap between traditional art and modern society is crucial, and in the culturally rich TULUNADU region of Karnataka, this connection has been weak. This paper introduces a platform with an innovative recommendation engine to address this issue. It empowers patrons to explore artists’ work, make purchases, and engage directly with the creators. Using machine learning, the system tailors recommendations based on individual preferences. This platform is a product of advanced machine learning and web development tools, providing artists with analytics to refine their creative and promotional efforts. The proposed model boasts a 32% novelty rate and an impressive 99% diversity score, making it a valuable tool for marketing and recommending similar arts or products.

articleTitle: Identification of Challenges and Limitations of Current Methods for Detection and Segmentation of Brain Tumor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This work presents a comprehensive survey having goal to uncover the challenges and limitations inherent in current methodologies for the segmentation and detection of Brain-Tumors (BT) in medical imaging. This paper introduces and rigorously evaluates six distinct methods, employing the Brats 2018 dataset as the testing ground. The assessment encompasses crucial performance metrics, including the Specificity, Dice-Similarity-Coefficient (DSC), and Sensitivity. Remarkably, the results underscore the effectiveness of the Group Cross-Channel-Attention Residual U-Net (GCAU-Net) as it consistently outperforms other methods, excelling in terms of Specificity, DSC, and Sensitivity. Furthermore, the study suggests that addressing class imbalance issues could be a promising avenue for future research, thereby offering a holistic perspective on the current state of brain tumor detection and segmentation methodologies. This paper contributes valuable insights to both the academic and medical communities, fostering advancements in the field and ultimately improving the accuracy and reliability of brain tumor segmentation techniques.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Path Planning based on LSTM
