publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent years, drones have become popular in the commercial and military fields due to their simple structure, high cost performance and easy operation. At the same time, the mission scenarios faced by drones have gradually become more complex and diverse, introducing more uncertain factors. Therefore, when facing more complex task scenarios, one of the current main strategies is to establish communication links and use neural networks to conduct path planning research to complete tasks in complex environments more efficiently. To address the challenge of cluster path planning in complex environments, we propose a new approach. During the path search phase, we take the drone’s kinematics and flight coordinate transformation into consideration to ensure that the resulting path is dynamically feasible. At the same time, we combine the LSTM neural network to memorize the flight trajectory and generate a judgment on the future path to make subsequent path planning, at the same time, the particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to optimize the results. Finally, we find that the accuracy of the proposed method is significantly improved compared with the traditional neural network method through experiments.

articleTitle: Preprocessing, Feature Extraction, and Classification Methodologies on Diabetic Retinopathy Using Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Significant progress has been made throughout the detection of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) over the past few decades because of the utilization of Deep-Learning (DL) techniques. Accurate and economical identification of DR using Fundus Images (FI) is made possible by combining state-of-the-art methods for image-processing, feature-extraction, and classification algorithms. This survey aims to explore and analyze the latest developments in preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification approaches, highlighting their key ideas and contributions. Novel approaches to feature extraction, involving traditional handcrafted features and DL-based methods, are investigated to capture relevant characteristics of DR lesions effectively. Furthermore, the survey explores diverse classification algorithms, including Support-Vector-Machines (SVM), Convolutional-Neural-Networks (CNNs), and ensemble methods, which enable accurate categorization of DR severity levels. This survey provides valuable insights into the state-of-the-art methodologies for DR detection, facilitating a comprehensive understanding of the key approaches and innovations in preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification techniques.

articleTitle: Hybrid Whale Optimization based Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit with Pre-trained CNN model for Software Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The deep learning model (DL) S-ResNet-152 (Squeeze-based ResNet-152) is used to pull out the features. Then, a bidirectional gated auto network (Bi-GRU-AN) is used to predict software faults based on a mixed DL model. A modified whale optimization algorithm and a crisscross optimization algorithm (MWOA-CS) are used to find the best weight for the suggested classifier. In MWOA-CS, the position of each dimension of the optimization problem is changed by a random better WOA optimization method while the repetitive process is going on. In this work, experiments are done on two software defect data sets (Kamei and PROMISE) to show how well the model classifies the data. The precision, recall, accuracy, and F1-score are the four complete evaluation measures used. The results show that the framework projected in this paper does a great job of classifying the two types of software fault data sets and is much better than the baseline models. then precision rate as 98.32 and then recall rate as 93.24 and then F-1 score as 94.53 correspondingly.

articleTitle: Intelligent Online Shared Home Design Based on Big Data Parallel Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As the overall economic strength of China continues to improve and people’s quality of life continues to improve, the application of high-quality engineering and environmental protection technologies is an inevitable choice for the future design of green housing. Therefore, it is necessary to consider high-tech solutions when designing similar houses. This paper puts forward the idea of utilizing modern high-tech means to renovate residential houses through the study of geographic conditions and architectural features of residential houses. With the rapid development of network information technology and the wide application of various multimedia devices, people’s understanding of the living environment has changed. Based on big data, online sharing of smart home design is realized, which is both conducive to the rapid improvement of informatization level of designers and the understanding of home design resources. With the help of the Internet and the platform of interactive sharing of information, it enables designers to communicate more with other designers, thus better assisting home design. Therefore, on this basis, this paper proposes a design method for an Internet-based interactive platform for home design. The method is simulated in the paper and the results show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Evolution of 6G - an In-depth Study on History of Spectrum Allocation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: There have been enormous breakthroughs in the field of mobile technology and communications in recent decades. The development of this trend is characterized by the debut of a series of generations, 1G being the first and 2G, 3G, and 4G following. First 4G, then 5G, and now 6G, with even faster speeds on the horizon. Many difficulties are shared between generations. However, 5G has risen to the top so far, providing access to the web at a rapid pace. This study sets out through an investigation of cellular evolution network links; documenting their evolution from 1G to 6G is the cutting edge of the future.

articleTitle: Advanced Encryption Standard on a Quantum System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Quantum computers have shown their capability to outperform the world's fastest supercomputers despite their nascent stage. This poses questions about the security of existing encryption schemes and offers exciting new possibilities to the field of cryptography. Extension of existing cryptographic algorithms and development of novel cryptographic protocols exploiting the physics of the quantum realm are unique prospects for the industry moving forward. This work implemented a hybrid classical-quantum AES-128 circuit on the open-source Qiskit simulator and explored the possibilities of reducing the qubit count necessary for implementing the same. Multiple classical bits were encoded into a single qubit for processing, and a machine learning model was trained to decode the output data back to classical bits. The circuit size was halved by changing the encoding form of classical bits into qubits. Our hybrid circuit also achieved significant speed up over the existing hybrid circuit for AES encryption and decryption.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis on Varying Transmission Ranges in MANET using AODV
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Mobile Adhoc Network is a small, spontaneous network emerging in the realm of ubiquitous networks. It needs effective management of transmission range in numerous sustainable development fields. A simulation is carried on NS3 using AODV routing over ad hoc networks. These simulations included providing background information and specifying a common transmission range for delivering data packets to the destination node. The study focused on the fast delivery using Johnson and Maltz’s Arbitrary Waypoint model and examining the number of the participating nodes on the efficiency of the AODV protocol, taking into account key metrics such as throughput, latency, packet delivery rate, dropped packets, and overall network utilization. Multiple simulations were conducted; varying the transmission ranges which signifies the fast delivery at lowest power consumption which is the most prominent requirement in the wireless world. Additionally, the study explored the feasibility of dynamically adjusting the transmission range to prolong the nodes’ lifespan.

articleTitle: Prototype System and Technical Verification of Automatic Optimization of Business Distribution Based on RPA Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Radar Performance Analyzer (RPA) system is an internet-based intelligent terminal device. It is based on the Internet of Things technology, combines computers and networks, and realizes automatic identification and transmission of data through comprehensive processing of communication, sensors and various sensor information. This paper first introduces the RPA growth platform architecture and its characteristics, and then analyzes and studies the application status, advantages and disadvantages of multi-class automation solutions. Finally, according to the existing system requirements, the technical verification method and process of the intelligent optimization model of business distribution based on RPA principle are proposed. The test results show that the system has a high degree of automation, which can basically reach more than 89%. In this paper, RPA system is helpful to realize information sharing among departments and can effectively improve enterprise management.

articleTitle: The Application of data Mining Technology in Student Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to understand the application of data mining technology in student management, the author proposes an application research based on data mining technology in student management. The author first introduces big data technology into university management work, opens up information channels between multiple business systems, and establishes a university data lifecycle management model. Secondly, the KNN classification algorithm in data mining is used to mine a large amount of data from students’ online activities. Finally, the relationship between traffic volume, duration, and student grades is found, and abnormal data student behavior is intervened, which is applied to student behavior management. The credit passing status of students was compared based on traffic trends. The experimental prediction results show that the accuracy, precision, and recall rates of abnormal prediction are 74.25%, 77.65%, 81.23%, and the F-Score value is 77.56%, respectively. The use of data mining technology has become an important way to solve this problem.

articleTitle: Web-Based System for Asia Pacific University (APU) Library Discussion Room Booking System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In today’s era, Information Technology (IT) plays a very important role in human’s daily life. This is because technology makes day-to-day tasks much easier and less time consuming. The impact of technology can be felt in every possible field especially in the field of education. According to the latest insights, university students of today prefer to use technology as the transfer of knowledge through technology is more convenient. Hence, Asia Pacific University (APU) have been constantly improving their Information Systems throughout their campus especially for the university’s library. APU Library plays a great role in providing students and lecturers of the university with abundant of reading materials and information. Besides that, APU Library also offers facilities such as discussion rooms for students and lecturers to use. In order to use the library discussion room, one must book the room in advance. However, the current library discussion room booking system is manually operated by APU librarians, many problems arises due to factors such as miscommunication and human errors.

articleTitle: Advancing P&ID Digitization with YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the realm of engineering diagram recognition and digitization, significant progress is evident across various domains, including the handling of intricate diagram categories like Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), scene text in images, and point symbols on scanned topographic maps. These advancements result from diverse methodologies, such as deep learning, neural networks, digital image processing, and the implementation of the YOLOv5 algorithm for symbol detection and recognition. These approaches substantially improve efficiency and automation in applications ranging from plant design to information extraction. They not only surmount challenges in processing complex visual data but also showcase how advanced technology like YOLOv5 is transforming industries, from manufacturing to geographic information systems. In the field of engineering diagram recognition and digitization, YOLOv5 achieves a 93% accuracy rate, demonstrating its significant impact. The model excelled in precision (92%), recall (94%), F1 score (93%), AUC score (0.97), nd ROC score (0.92), advancing document digitization and automation. These innovations pave the way for further enhancements in engineering and document digitization.

articleTitle: Application of Image Recognition Algorithms Based on Deep Learning in the Field of Communication Science
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the popularization of the internet, people have paid more and more attention to image processing, and deep learning has become a research hotspot. Analyzing images based on deep neural networks is a very valuable and promising direction for development. This article first introduced text representation methods and two commonly used classifiers in machine learning, namely the manual annotation model method. Then, it elaborated on the effectiveness and current application status of a fusion of multi-layer feedforward technology and convolutional neural networks for edge detection, feature extraction, and other fields. Finally, a new concept was proposed, and deep learning was applied to explain the important significance of image preprocessing in digital music file classification. Afterwards, a communication field training model based on image recognition algorithms was simulated and tested for its functionality. The test results showed that the image recognition algorithm based on deep learning had good noise processing performance during the propagation process, with an image clarity rate of over 90%. Through deep learning algorithms, automatic recognition and classification of radio signals can be achieved, including determining signal type, modulation method, frequency range, and other information. This is of great significance for radio spectrum monitoring, spectrum management, and interference source localization. By using deep learning algorithms, classification models for different types of radio signals can be trained, making the recognition of radio spectrum more accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Building Robust Machine Learning Models for Water Quality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This research focuses on developing machine learning models that can accurately predict water quality while being robust against adversarial attacks. The chosen approach involves using a logistic regression classifier and training the models on a dataset containing various water characteristics. The study investigates the models' vulnerability to poisoning and evasion attacks using data injection and iterative FGSM techniques, respectively. To enhance their resilience, a robust feature selection algorithm is proposed. This algorithm identifies and removes malicious or vulnerable features from the training data. The effectiveness of the proposed models and defense mechanisms is evaluated through experiments, demonstrating their ability to achieve accurate water quality prediction while mitigating the impact of attacks. Our result analysis revealed that, while adversarial attacks initially reduced accuracy, the models, fortified by the feature selection algorithm and defense mechanisms, consistently maintained an accuracy rate of 62.80%. Overall, this research contributes to improving the security and reliability of water quality assessment systems.

articleTitle: Analytic Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the increasing prominence of e-commerce, the demand for effective online financial management has surged significantly. Consequently, the prevalence of online fraud has emerged as a prominent issue. Addressing this challenge, fraud detection systems leverage analytical approaches, processing vast amounts of data through machine learning techniques. These systems are intricately designed to discern fraudulent or suspicious transactions within extensive datasets of normal activities. Despite their effectiveness, implementing a fraud detection system requires a substantial investment. This project proposal delves into the intricacies of the Financial Fraud Detection System, offering comprehensive insights and evidence of its efficacy. It outlines the methodologies employed by the system to identify and mitigate fraudulent activities. Additionally, the proposal examines the profound impact such a system can have on online businesses, emphasizing its role in curbing the escalation of online fraud.

articleTitle: CNN Shines in Brain Tumor Detection: Insights from Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The study focuses on the application of deep learning models for the detection and classification of brain tumors, a critical area in healthcare. Brain tumors, among various central nervous system disorders, pose significant challenges in terms of detection and treatment. The research reviews several deep learning models’ performance in this context. Notably, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) achieved exceptional results with an accuracy of 93.5%, an AUC of 98.57%, a recall rate of 91.7%, and a loss of 0.260. This CNN outperformed other models and exhibited a balanced accuracy curve during training. These findings underscore the immense potential of deep learning models, especially CNNs, in precise brain tumor identification. These models hold promise for improving the diagnosis and treatment of brain-related disorders, offering valuable contributions to the field of healthcare.

articleTitle: Visualizing Algorithms: A Comprehensive Exploration of Sorting and Computational Problem-Solving
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Effective visuals are essential for solving computational issues and comprehending complicated algorithms. Through the use of a web-based Sorting Algorithm Visualizer and associated components, this study presents a fresh approach to algorithm visualization. We look at different approaches to sorting, approaches to solving problems, and computing difficulties. With the help of a visual depiction, users may better understand the inner workings of sorting algorithms like bubble sort, selection sort, insertion sort, merge sort, fast sort, etc. by using the Sorting Algorithm Visualizer. Positive user feedback exhibiting better algorithmic comprehension is shown in the research, which highlights the Sorting Algorithm Visualizer's efficacy in offering an interactive and complete platform for viewing and learning sorting algorithms. The project's accomplishments and room for expansion demonstrate how crucial visualization is to understanding algorithms and addressing computational problems.

articleTitle: Design of Computer Data Acquisition System Based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Improving the accuracy and efficiency of computer data collection systems based on Matlab is a key issue in the field of computer science and technology. Through relevant research on traditional computer data collection methods, with the help of the basic composition and structure analysis of computer data collection system hardware, combined with the programming steps of Matlab data collection software, the following conclusions were drawn based on the data results: through simulation experiments, six dataset samples were selected, and the computer data collection system based on Matlab improved the system’s collection accuracy compared to traditional methods, with a comprehensive average improvement of about 10.3%. At the same time, the collection efficiency was also improved, with a comprehensive average improvement of about 8.35%. This article aims to provide a computer data collection system design based on Matlab for China through theoretical and empirical research. This indicated that the computer data acquisition optimization system based on Matlab has good results in practical applications.

articleTitle: Application of Particle Swarm Algorithm in Multi-objective Shop Floor Scheduling for Intelligent Manufacturing Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the intelligent manufacturing system, the assembly line is an important process in the production process. Its main purpose is to process the raw materials according to a certain process to make products that meet the needs of users. In the production process, the assembly line workers can realize the workpiece processing through the operating table, and can convert it into machine energy. As a complex and closed entity, the workshop needs to deal with many links. Therefore, for the whole production line scheduling problem is also very critical and has research value; Based on particle swarm optimization algorithm, this paper organizes and manages a workpiece reasonably and effectively on the production line to realize the automation of shop scheduling, and finds that it has a good effect in practical application, which can bring considerable economic benefits to the enterprise. Therefore, it is of great significance to use the method of multi-objective shop order task scheduling to improve productivity and reduce workload.

articleTitle: Application Research of Big Data Analysis in New Energy Automobile Maintenance Technical Support and Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Big data analysis in New Energy Automobile (NEA) maintenance and fault diagnosis improves efficiency and quality of maintenance, benefiting the future of the automobile industry. Based on big data analysis and combined with the current status of NEA maintenance technical support and fault diagnosis, the paper provides an in-depth analysis of the application value of big data in NEA maintenance technical support and fault diagnosis, and elaborates on the specific application of big data in NEA maintenance technical support and fault diagnosis. The experimental results show that the application of big data can reduce the failure rate of the battery system to a minimum of 11%, the power system to 10%, and the work efficiency to 89.5%, laying a good foundation for the healthy development of the NEA industry.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Flower-shaped Fractal Multiband Antenna for Vehicle Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this paper, flower-shaped multiband antenna is proposed for vehicle communication application. The fractal design structure incorporates multiband performance of antenna. A circular radiating element is used in this design with unique partial ground plane. An antenna is designed using partial ground plane with a circular split ring resonator (SRR) in the ground plane. It is fabricated using FR4 (Flame-retardant epoxy with a relative permittivity of 4.4) substrate material of size $50\text{mm} \times 40\text{mm} \times 1.6$ mm. This antenna is designed to operate in Long-Term Evolution (LTE2600), Sub-6GHz 5G and V2X (Vehicle to everything communication). Achieving a peak gain of 5.22 dB, maintaining a reflection coefficient below −10 dB, and attaining an 85% radiation efficiency across the entire frequency spectrum, the antenna has undergone successful prototyping. Measurement results exhibit a robust alignment with simulation outcomes, affirming the precision and dependability of the design. This validation underscores the accuracy of the antenna’s performance.

articleTitle: Construction of Group Algorithm Model under Green Innovation Capability Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the process of green innovation, there are problems of complex innovation data processing and inconsistent evaluation data, which in turn affects the ability of agree innovation. This algorithm simulates the optimization ability exhibited by bee colonies during behaviors such as dance and collective search. By employing an iterative search approach, the algorithm is able to identify the optimal solution for a given problem. The empirical results show that the bee colony algorithm can provide decision support and strategic guidance, and assist enterprises and organizations to achieve better results in the evaluation of green innovation capabilities. In order to promote the application of bee colony algorithm in evaluating green innovation capability and provide more support for sustainable development, research findings indicate that the green innovation capability assessment model can accurately analyze and enhance innovation capability. The model has an accuracy rate of over 95%, surpassing the evaluation method of neural network algorithm.

articleTitle: Improved Deep Reinforcement Learning for Intelligent Logistics Supply Chain Transportation Decision Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the context of new economic globalization, many industries have very complex supply chain systems, which bring various risks to enterprises. In terms of constituent elements, this article analyzed the logistics capacity of the supply chain from two aspects: resource allocation elements and structural elements. This article constructed a logistics capability model characterized by internal transportation in the supply chain, and derived the optimization results of logistics capability represented by cycle time and batch. A model suitable for intelligent logistics supply chain transportation decision-making was designed based on the framework of DRL (Deep Reinforcement Learning). The Line 1 took 2.4 hours before using the model, and 1.2 hours after using the model. In addition, this research was conducted on the performance of supply chain service providers under the intelligent logistics model, which can help them better improve their performance and also bring some inspiration to enterprises in the same industry.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Quality Monitoring Algorithm of Assembled Building Construction Based on Neural Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the continuous development of the city, prefabricated building has gradually become an important form of modern architecture, but at the same time, the construction safety of prefabricated building has increasingly attracted people's attention. Therefore, this paper aims to solve the problem of safety and quality monitoring during the construction of prefabricated building, and proposes a monitoring algorithm based on neural network technology. Through the collection and analysis of multiple safety and quality data in the construction process, a neural network model was established, and the superiority of the model in accuracy, recall, F1 value, AUC value and other indicators was verified. In terms of accuracy, the neural network technology was 0.82, which was significantly improved compared with 0.74 of the benchmark models. The research results provide a new safety and quality monitoring solution for the construction of prefabricated building, and have important practical significance.

articleTitle: Student Attendance Management System Based on Fingerprint Identification Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Accurate and efficient management of student attendance is a prerequisite for ensuring the healthy development of students and cultivating high-quality talents, and is also a top priority in school work. The establishment of attendance management system can solve the problems of delays and low efficiency in human resource management and attendance rate statistics in the past. The aim of this paper is to study the design and implementation of a student attendance management system based on fingerprint recognition technology. The design requirements and principles of the fingerprint recognition assisted management system are analysed, the overall structure of the system is designed, the functions and applications of fingerprint recognition technology are reasonably designed and adopted, and finally the fingerprint recognition assisted management system is implemented. The results show that after the system is implemented, it makes attendance more convenient, fast and standardized compared with the traditional methods of punching cards and signing on behalf of students, which greatly improves the learning efficiency of students in universities.

articleTitle: A Design and Display Platform for Fengtu Architecture Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As people’s demand for culture becomes increasingly urgent, architectural technology is also gradually developing towards virtual reality. Firstly, the background and significance of the project were elaborated, while the current situation and application prospects at home and abroad were introduced. Secondly, a brief analysis and explanation were conducted on the characteristics of virtual reality in the design of different types of buildings. Finally, this article proposes the application of virtual reality technology to building structures, and through simulation verification, the results show that the predicted temperature and actual temperature of this virtual technology differ by within 2 °C, and the predicted humidity value and actual humidity value also differ by within 2% rh; the average resource utilization rate of the vernacular architecture display platform is within 0.6, the average CPU utilization rate is within 0.2, and the average memory utilization rate is within 0.4.

articleTitle: Optimization Control and Management of Distributed Photovoltaic Grid Connection System Based on Intelligent Perception
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As the world’s population is growing every year, more energy is needed to keep the global economy running. Many countries around the world have put forward the slogan of saving energy and protecting the environment, and have adopted a series of energy saving and environmental protection measures. Under the dual pressure of energy saving and environmental protection, the development of new renewable energy sources is an urgent issue to be addressed. In such a new situation, a new way of energy utilization - grid-connected photovoltaic technology - has come into being. This paper discusses the optimal control and management of distributed PV grid-connected systems based on intelligent perception, starting with the concept of distributed PV grid-connected systems and intelligent perception, and ending with an experimental analysis of the performance of distributed PV grid-connected systems based on intelligent perception (as the grid-connected current reference value drops, the inverter DC voltage starts to rise back to the set value of 800V).

articleTitle: Construction of Enterprise Digital Intelligent Management Platform Based on Improved Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The purpose of studying the digital intelligent management platform for enterprises is to help them better carry out digital transformation and intelligent management, thereby improving their operational efficiency and market competitiveness. This paper aims to solve a series of problems encountered in the intelligent management platform through the improvement of neural network technology, so as to promote the digital transformation and intelligent management of enterprises. Through experiments on the accuracy and stability of this method, the results show that the accuracy based on improved neural networks is generally above 85%, with the highest stability reaching 85.72%. This indicates that the improved neural network algorithm can process complex data more accurately and produce more stable and reliable results. Adopting this method can provide higher quality and more effective management services for enterprises, thereby providing strong support for their sustainable development.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Ensemble Classifier using Wisconsin Dataset For Breast Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Subclass of Artificial Intelligence, machine learning integrates several optimizations, probabilistic, and statistical methodologies to help computers learn from prior occurrences and find it challenging to spot patterns in intricate datasets, noised and large datasets. As a result, machine learning in cancer diagnosis and detection has increased. In women, breast cancer is the utmost common malignancy. The study aims to predict breast cancer by comparing widely used machine learning algorithms and methodologies, neural networks, Random Forest, and Boosting, upon Wisconsin Diagnosis Breast Cancer data set to inspect the performance of critical characteristics such as precision and accuracy. This study’s accurate, competitive results can be used for detection and treatment.

articleTitle: Enhanced Reversible Image Watermarking using Improved Moth Flame Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With enhancing connectivity, undefended digital content is susceptible for attacks and hence watermarking is significant to protect copyright. In this research, an efficient image reversible watermarking method is proposed. The proposed method uses selection of optimum position for embedding in accordance with entropy and relevance threshold for selection of entropy is done through Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. A method in Integer Wavelet Transform (IWT) is implemented, next Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) is integrated to the process of embedding in whole selected blocks and Fractal encrypted watermark are combined to image coefficients utilizing mean proximity coefficient. The process of embedding is done through optimum scale that is produced through Improved Moth-Flame Optimization (IMFO) algorithm in accordance with fitness function. The proposed method attained superior image quality and high embedding capacity. The performance of proposed method id evaluated with performance measures of Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) and Normalized Correlation (NC). The proposed method attained high PSNR of 60.32 dB, SSIM of 0.9948 and NC of 0.9872 in Lena image which is superior than other existing algorithms.

Author Keywords: Particle Swarm Optimization and Reversible Watermarking

articleTitle: Improved Sail Fish Optimizer for Energy Efficient Routing in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: A Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a collection of nodes fitted with small sensors and transceiver elements that are utilized for sensing, tracking, and data collection in a variety of situations. Sensor energy is considered a significant resource due to the difficulty in providing battery a backup to sensors when they are deployed in an uncontrolled or wild area. Integrating clustering & routing strategies are the optimal techniques for saving sensor node energy. In this research, the Improved Sail Fish Optimizer (ISFO) is proposed for the energy efficient routing path selection in WSN to improve the network lifetime. The ISFO algorithm is utilized to identify an accurate routing to sink node for data transmission. The performance of proposed algorithm is evaluated with performance metrics of Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR), Throughput, energy consumption and delay. The proposed algorithm attained high PDR of 96%, high throughput of 97%, less energy consumption of 0.4J and less delay of 3ms which is superior than other existing algorithms.

Author Keywords: Sensor Nodes and Wireless Sensor Network

articleTitle: Evaluation of Cold Chain Logistics Delivery Path Optimization System Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Cold chain distribution is an important guarantee for standardized and large-scale production of fresh products. However, there are still many problems in the actual distribution process of cold chain logistics (CSN), and optimizing the distribution path is urgent. This article analyzes the csn distribution path optimization system based on neural networks (NNs) algorithm, focusing on the establishment and solution methods of its mathematical model. Based on the Hopfield neural network algorithm, a new csn distribution path optimization system is constructed, making the entire supply chain more efficient and convenient to operate, and reducing enterprise operating costs. Comparing the optimization system of CSN delivery paths based on NNs algorithm before and after optimization, two optimal delivery paths were calculated. The effectiveness and superiority of NNs algorithm were demonstrated from two aspects: path length and time cost. Especially in terms of path length, the total transportation distance of the optimized system was shortened from 21.8 kilometers to 21.5 kilometers, providing users with a more comprehensive service experience.

articleTitle: Analysis System of English Translation on Cloud Platform Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has greatly affected various fields including language translation. This paper aims to explore the design and implementation of an AI cloud platform developed specifically for English translation analysis. This is a research work that uses artificial intelligence technology to improve the quality and efficiency of English translation. In this system, artificial intelligence is applied in every link, from data processing to model training and result generation, to achieve more accurate and smooth translation. This paper mainly applies the experimental method and comparative method, proposes machine translation from artificial intelligence, and tests the English translation analysis system on the cloud platform. The experimental results show that the fidelity and fluency of the optical translation system are the highest, respectively 59% and 59.8%, and its translation level is the highest in the experiment. But at the same time, there are still some problems in machine translation, so it is necessary to summarize from its error types and make improvements.

articleTitle: Construction of an Intelligent Decision System for Building Construction Management Risk Based on PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the increasing severity of construction safety issues, the risk factors during the construction process have also become more and more significant. How to strengthen the monitoring of risk factors in the construction process, timely identify and deal with safety hazards during the construction process is an urgent problem to be solved. Building an intelligent decision-making system for construction risks based on the PSO (Ppaper Swarm Optimization) algorithm and real-time monitoring and warning of construction risks can provide relevant managers with a platform for timely and accurate acquisition of danger signals and intelligent decision-making analysis. Finally, it was found through experiments that the PSO algorithm could improve the accuracy of decision-making from 87.70% to 95.17%.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation for Cloud Wireless Access Networks Based on Distributed Task Scheduling Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to effectively improve the performance of distributed platform, its resource scheduling method needs to be studied thoroughly and diligently. In the process of distributed task scheduling, unbalanced load of sub-resources between network nodes often occurs, and this paper applies distributed task scheduling algorithm to the process of allocating resources of cloud wireless access network. By building a data-driven operation and maintenance framework through effective control of the distributed platform, the collected network information data are processed centrally, and the resources are allocated in a balanced manner according to the user’s business requirements in combination with virtualized network functions (VNF). Finally, the experimental simulation results show that the proposed distributed task scheduling algorithm can effectively realize the dynamic allocation of cloud wireless access network resources and also significantly reduce the energy consumption and times of VNF migration. As a result, this paper can effectively reduce the time consumption by 33%.

articleTitle: RSVM: A Promising Approach for Early Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The cardiovascular complications have rapidly increased after COVID-19 pandemic leading to various health effects, including heart disease. Irregular blood flow and inflammation harm the heart and vessels, driving cardiovascular problems that require early detection to prevent fatalities. A novel approach using supervised machine learning technique called Rule-based Support Vector Machine (RSVM) has been introduced in this paper, aimed at the early detection of this disease. The proposed rule engine is formed after K-Means clustering. Before applying this computational model, the data was cleaned, preprocessed and outliers were removed. The Stratified K-fold (K=10) cross-validation is applied here due to imbalance of target variables. The UCI based dataset of heart disease from Kaggle are utilized to analyze the model’s efficacy. The effectiveness of the proposed model has been assessed by computing various metrics, including mean accuracy (93.7%), precision (96.93%), recall (91.51%) and F1-score (94.06%) that clearly surpasses alternative models in performance.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Multimodal Control for Power Grid Payment System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to better adapt to the high-quality development needs of enterprises and meet the growing electricity needs of people, this article conducts analysis and research on the current business model of electricity meter reading and collection, providing a research foundation and innovative direction for the research of internet-based service models based on intelligent payment.. At the same time, this article adopts two perspectives of theoretical research and specific operational research to systematically demonstrate the technical issues that power grid enterprises need to do under the Internet based service model of intelligent payment. The results indicate that the rationality and accuracy of the genetic algorithm reached 88.13%, and the results were relatively poor. While the rationality of the design of the power grid payment system of the adaptive multimodal control reaches 97.73%, the accuracy rate reaches 98.91%, which improves the standardization of the electricity fee collection business process, innovates service models, enhances service capabilities, and establishes a modern power supply service system.

articleTitle: Dual Field of View Target Tracking and Positioning Technology for Sports Event Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the management of sporting events, accurate tracking and positioning of athletes, balls and other key elements is essential for real-time monitoring of the progress of the game, evaluating player performance, and formulating tactical strategies. However, the traditional single-vision target tracking technology has certain limitations in the face of factors such as occlusion, appearance changes, and motion blur. In this study, dual-field target tracking and positioning technology is used to track targets in sports event scenes using multiple viewing angles or sensors. Through comparative experiments and data analysis, we evaluated the performance differences of dual-field technology compared to traditional single-vision technology. The experimental results show that the tracking stability of the technology in this paper is between 84% and 95%, and the dual-field target tracking and positioning technology for sports event management has achieved remarkable results in improving the accuracy and stability of target tracking. The accuracy of the research technology in this paper is the highest at 96% and the lowest at 89%, respectively.

articleTitle: Data Security Defense System based on Computer Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, network security threats are also increasing, so establishing an effective data security defense system has become crucial. The system designed in this paper is based on Netfilter/Iptables technology, which is a powerful tool for packet filtering, forwarding and network address translation in Linux operating system. By using Netfilter/Iptables, the research can flexibly control and manage the data packets entering and leaving the network, so as to achieve the purpose of data security defense. Specifically, the system designed in this paper will make use of Netfilter/Iptables for the following aspects of data security defense: First, the system will set inbound and outbound filtering rules to prevent unauthorized access and insecure network connections. Second, the system will implement network address translation (NAT) functions to hide the real IP address of the internal network and provide an additional layer of protection. In addition, port forwarding rules will be set to ensure that only authenticated users can access specific network services. To enhance the security of the system, this paper will also introduce other data security technologies such as intrusion detection systems (IDS) and intrusion prevention systems (IPS). IDS will be responsible for monitoring network traffic and identifying potential intrusions, while IPS will proactively intercept and block malicious traffic based on IDS alerts. Finally, the study will evaluate the performance and effect of the designed system through experiments. Using Netfilter/Iptables framework, a data security defense system is designed and tested to ensure the security and stability of the system.Various attack scenarios are simulated and evaluated with appropriate performance indicators to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the system. To sum up, the Netfilter/Iptables based data security defense system designed in this paper is expected to provide a powerful and reliable solution to deal with the growing network security threats.

articleTitle: Object Detection and Recognition in Autonomous Vehicles using Fast Region-Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Object detection is a computer vision approach whose fundamental intent is to detect objects and it can be detected from any video or image feeds. The accurate and timely identification of traffic signs plays a vital role in autonomous vehicles. However, the traffic sign’ s size represents a small part of the input image. In this research, the Fast Region-Convolutional Neural Network (R-CNN) is proposed for object detection and recognition in autonomous vehicles using deep learning. Initially, the data is obtained by the KITTI dataset and data augmentation is employed to increase the generalization capability of the model. Then, the Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and ResNet-50 are used for feature extraction. The Attention-guided Context Feature Pyramid Network (ACFPN) is employed for feature fusion and then the Fast RCNN approach is utilized for detection and recognition purposes. The proposed Fast RCNN achieves a better mean Average Precision (mAP) of 99.26% compared to the existing methods respectively.

articleTitle: Ear Based Age Recognition System Using ANN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Biometrics involve the study of specific aspects of an individual’s anatomy or physiology, such as the face, fingerprint, ear, palm print, iris, etc. Among these, ear recognition systems are notably powerful tools, particularly in forensic applications. In conventional biometric facial images are employed for age classification of individuals. One drawback of the existing system, which relies on facial images for age recognition, is that it can be less accurate when there are variations in lighting and facial expressions. Additionally, the facial recognition approach may not be as robust in scenarios where individuals may not have readily available or visible facial images, such as in forensic or security applications. In our proposed Age Recognition system, we utilize ear images and an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) to precisely determine an individual’s age. This work presents a comprehensive analysis of the extraction of soft biometric characteristic, such as age from an individual. This study explores the utilization of ear biometrics and artificial neural networks (ANN) for accurate age estimation. A unique dataset encompassing A variety of age groups, spanning from 10 to over 50 years, forms the basis of our research. Gabor features are employed in a Feed Forward Neural Network (FFNN) to facilitate age estimation. The incorporation of seven Gabor features in the input layer aids in capturing vital ear details, enhancing age estimation accuracy. Seven hidden layers within the FFNN enable the network to discern intricate patterns in the data. The output layer classifies individuals into five distinct age groups, simplifying age estimation. Our paper highlights the potential of ear biometrics in age estimation, with practical implications for security, personalization, and beyond. This work is developed with own dataset, which is divided into five age groups. System has achieved 92.05% accuracy for age recognition for 302 samples. It also achieves an accuracy of 92% for verification and 90% for validation.

articleTitle: DWT Approach Based on Analysis of Seizures in EEG Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Seizures are neurological disorders that affect approximately 50 million people worldwide. It occurs unusually and unpredictably due to transient electrical brain disruption. The electroencephalogram (EEG) signal was decomposed using the discrete wavelet transform into five frequency bands are delta, theta, alpha beta and gamma. Signals were reprocessed, decomposed by using discrete wavelet transform DWT till 7th level of decomposition tree. Various features like mean. Standard deviation, median, entropy and energy were computed and consequently used for classification of signals. The range of these features in non-epileptic and epileptic group of 100 subjects each from data set is analyzed and interpreted. the parameters with distinct non-overlapping zone are identified. The results shows the compared frequency band beta frequency band of the entropy parameter decreased by 86% among seizure subjects among all frequencies and parameters. The enhanced beta activity reflects greater attention and hyperactivity. In the future, a large number of seizure data can be used and more statistical features to train and test the CNN to obtain higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Distance Vector (RIP) and Link-State (OSPF) Routing Protocols
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The routing protocols used by the routers are for routing information across the devices in the network. The information exchange across the network is vital and the routing protocols used by the routers will make sure that the information will reach its destination. This paper focuses on routing protocols, especially, the comparative study of Distance Vector (RIP) and Link State (OSPF) Routing Protocols. Also, this paper is to select the best routing protocol based on the network performance metrics throughput and delay. In addition to that, network scenario is created and simulated, through which the comparative study is performed and the results are discussed in the form of the queue. This study discusses about the pros and cons of different protocols on networks and their efficiencies with the help of different metrics. TCP and network metrics, which in turn helps to select the best routing protocol in terms of throughput and delay.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Personalized Learning System Based on Network Intelligence and Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Personalized online learning system is an inevitable requirement of today’s rapid development of informatization, and it is also a perfection of traditional online teaching. This article analyzes the application of network data mining in distance teaching. Users enter the client computer in the form of a page. The system recommends appropriate courses to students through data mining of students’ registration status, sends the content in the learning module to the client in the form of hypertext, and displays the learning content. After the user completes the learning transaction, the user sends the user’s learning information to the server, and then the server processes and saves the learning information. The server takes out the saved data from the database, filters the data, and removes dirty data, then hands the data to the data mining module to start data mining. In the satisfaction evaluation of students in different classes with the personalized learning system based on network intelligence and data mining technology, 78.9% were very satisfied and 13% were satisfied. The server will also return the mining results to the client, thereby showing the factors that affect its learning performance, and also suggesting how to adjust its learning status to improve the learning effect.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Intelligent Operation and Maintenance of Long-distance Ultra-high Voltage Underground Cables Supported by Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In modern society, electricity resources are strategic resources in national strategies. In order to maintain the stable input and operation of electricity, it is necessary to carry out the operation and maintenance of high-voltage power cables, and handle and manage various unexpected work. Therefore, it is necessary to use high-tech means to effectively manage high-voltage cables, in order to promote the healthy development and development of China’s society and economy. This article explored the intelligent exploration and practice of long-distance ultra-high voltage underground cable power operation and maintenance supported by digital twin (DT) technology. Firstly, it introduced the relevant knowledge of cable power operation and maintenance and DT technology. Finally, the progressiveness of the long-distance ultra-high voltage underground cable power operation and maintenance supported by the DT technology was verified through experiments (the cost of the cable power operation and maintenance system designed based on this paper was saved by 60%, while the cost of the traditional system was saved by 30%).

articleTitle: Research on the Detection Model of Wearable Fall Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Falls are very common today and and this behavior can lead to serious injuries and even accidental death in the elderly when they fall, especially among the elderly.. In order to avoid the injuries caused by the elderly who are not able to get timely assistance after a fall, this paper investigates fall detection algorithms that can reduce the injury and impact of falls on the elderly. In this paper, A bivearnerable fall detection algorithm based on a bidirectional long and short-term memory neural network (LSTM) will be presented to improve the accuracy and real-time performance of the detection algorithm. The algorithm automatically extracts the fall behavior data from the input data by taking the data from the inertial sensors, and the deeper data features from inside for the data to be pre-processed and processed to the detection results. The features from the acceleration sensors are extracted in the algorithm model and used to detect the algorithm model. In this paper, the algorithm model is validated with the SisFall dataset and the result shows bidirectional LSTM obtained 95.30% accuracy, which has good practicality and strong generalization ability.

articleTitle: Enhancing Speech Signal Clarity through Signal Noise Removal Using the LMS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Speech communication applications like speech recognition and speech enhancement currently face challenges in reducing noise in audio or speech signals. Noise is added to the audio signal for a number of unavoidable reasons, making it challenging to hear. To reduce noise, various filtering techniques are used. The effectiveness of specific noise reduction algorithms can be impacted by the filter characteristics you use. This paper presents a speech denoising approach using the Least Mean Squares (LMS) algorithm. The algorithm is implemented on a noisy audio signal, generated by introducing white Gaussian noise (AWGN) to the audio under analysis. Results from both time and frequency domains affirm the efficacy of the LMS algorithm in reducing noise from the speech signal.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable F shaped Antenna design for GSM, WLAN and WiMAX Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The demand for miniaturized, affordable, wide-band and multiband antennas has increased as communication technology has developed over the last decade. An innovative frequency-configurable F-shaped antenna for use in the GSM, WLAN, and WiMAX frequency bands is presented in this study. The antenna is fabricated on low cost FR-4 substrate and the vector network analyzer (VNA) is used to test the fabricated antenna. The results from the fabricated antenna are in good matching with those from simulations. The antenna may be made resonant at three modes of 1.8 GHz, 2.45 GHz, and 5.5 GHz frequencies respectively, by adding shorts at the suitable locations throughout the slot and offering suitably constructed matching stubs. By opening the door for more developments in wireless communication systems, this innovative frequency reconfigurable antenna design makes a significant contribution to the sector.

articleTitle: Detecting Attackers During Quantum key Distribution in IoT Networks using Quantum-Based Secure and Lightweight Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) is an auspicious model for Internet of Things (IoT) networks against attacks of eavesdropping. Nevertheless, standard quantum-based techniques are expensive and overweighted for resource-awkward devices in IoT. Especially, an out-band quantum channel needs to use for regular exchanges among the devices and QKD controller. To decreased IoT devices overweight pain against eavesdropping, implemented a new Quantum-based Secure and Lightweight Transmission (QSLT) method in this work. In particular, the system pre-distributes quantum keys to IoT SIM cards-equipped devices. Sensitive IoT data can be encrypted or decrypted using one of the keys by QSLT. It is important that two distinct devices arranged the session key using key-selection of in-band techniques. Once the data is received by another device, the key-selection field is extracts by QSLT and uses locally stored selected quantum key to decrypt the data. Investigated the implemented technique and analyses its performances of transmission and security.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques Based Secured Biometric Authentication and Classification using ECG Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The use of biometric authentication in our daily lives has progressively expanded, owing to the rising global requirements for information security and regulatory oversight. Face, palm print, voice, fingerprint, iris, and Electrocardiogram (ECG) are among the most adaptive and effective biometric features. However, contemporary methodologies frequently necessitate a large amount of training data, which is typically collected from an on-site ECG database for training and testing. To solve these limitations, Deep Learning (DL) techniques such as Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) is proposed for secure biometric authentication system. The preprocessing method is utilized for denoising the noises in every individual ECG signals. Then the preprocessing, the data are split into two phases for classification by utilizingRNN and Bi-LSTM. In this proposed method, the databases of on-person and off-person such as ECG-ID, Check Your Bio-signals Here Initiative (CYBHI), Physikalisch-Technische Bunde-sanstalt (PTB), and University of Toronto Database (UofTDB) are used. The proposed RNNBi-LSTM approach accomplished an overall value in on-person datasets from metrics such as 99.81% accuracy, 99.79% sensitivity, 99.86% specificity, and 99.78% positive predictivity. Similarly, in off-person dataset attains 98.76% accuracy, 98.78% sensitivity, 98.84% specificity and 98.73% positive predictivity.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach for Obstacle Avoidance and Navigation in Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Reinforcement learning has emerged as a prominent technique for enhancing robot obstacle avoidance capabilities in recent years. This research provides a comprehensive overview of reinforcement learning methods, focusing on Bayesian, static, dynamic policy, Deep Q-Learning (DQN) and extended dynamic policy algorithms. In the context of robot obstacle avoidance, these algorithms enable an agent to interact with its physical environment, learns effective operating strategies, and optimize actions to maximize a reward signal. The environment typically consists of a physical space that the robot must navigate without encountering obstacles. The reward signal serves as an objective measure of the robot’s performance towards accomplishing specific goals, such as reaching designated positions or completing tasks. Furthermore, successful obstacle avoidance strategies acquired in simulation environments can be seamlessly transferred to real-world scenarios. The promising results achieved thus far indicate the potential of reinforcement learning as a powerful tool for enhancing robot obstacle avoidance. This research concludes with insights into the future prospects of reward learning, high-lighting its ongoing importance in the development of intelligent robotics systems. The proposed algorithm DQN outperforms well among all the other algorithms with an accuracy of 81%, Through this research, we aim to provide valuable insights and directions for further advancements in the field of robot obstacle avoidance using reinforcement learning techniques.

articleTitle: Design of a Requirements Mining and Evaluation System Based on Fuzzy Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: At present, the power grid mainly classifies customers based on customer value, demand characteristics, credit rating, satisfaction, and other aspects to improve the service quality of electricity customers. The core of researching and establishing a value evaluation segmentation and value-added service system for power customers is accurate and efficient clustering algorithms. However, the lack of exploration of potential customer needs and analysis of demand value makes it impossible to further enhance the promotion ability of value-added products and better provide differentiated services to customers. The research results indicate that this article establishes a demand mining and demand value evaluation system, which effectively manages and scientifically analyzes the demand data of electricity customers. It can provide a basis for user demand information analysis and comprehensive analysis management, customer demand mining and demand value analysis, and make customer demand worth evaluating correctly. It helps customer managers better provide professional and high-quality services for electricity customers.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-objective Distribution Route Optimization of Agricultural Products Based on Dijkstra Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Multi-objective distribution of agricultural products is a new type of optimization problem, which has strong relevance and practical value, but there are many uncertainties due to its practical application. For example, high transportation cost, low vehicle loading rate and low information quantity. Due to the high complexity, flexibility and scalability, it has become one of the hotspots of research in many optimization fields. Therefore, how to reduce the impact of these stochastic factors on the system performance has become one of the research hotspots. In addition, it is difficult to optimize the multi-objective distribution path due to the inability to obtain the required data accurately because of the long driving distance of vehicles, and finally, the multi-objective distribution problem becomes more complicated because the agricultural products have the characteristics of short time limitation. In this paper, a vehicle scheduling model based on multi-objective distribution of agricultural products is proposed and the algorithm is verified to prove its high application value.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Framework for the Classification of Bearing Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this Paper, the faults in the bearings are detected and classified using predictive maintenance technique. Because, it is gaining significant importance in recent years due to its capability to monitor machines from shutting down, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance schedules. Predictive maintenance plays a crucial role in preventing unexpected failures and optimizing maintenance activities in industrial systems. This paper tells about application of deep learning networks for the classification of bearing faults. Deep learning techniques have demonstrated exceptional performance in various domains, and their potential in predictive maintenance for bearings is gaining considerable attention. The proposed model classifies the Faults in Bearings using CNN which achieves an accuracy of 83.3%. This paper also provides an overview of the use of deep learning networks in bearing fault classification. This paper includes an Introduction, Literature Review, Bearing Fault Classification, Experimental Results, and Conclusion.

articleTitle: High Speed Long-Haul Hybrid MDM/FSO System under Diverse Turbulent Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: A high speed $6 \times 20$ Gbps hybrid free space optics and mode division multiplexing (FSO-MDM) system considering weak-to-strong turbulent as well as diverse climate conditions is proposed. Three laguerre-gaussian (LG) modes viz. 00, 01 and 02 are incorporated for six transmission signals. The results indicate that faithful FSO range of 17-50km is obtained under weak-to-strong turbulent condition. Maximum signal to noise ratio of 50 dB can be obtained for the proposed work for LGOO followed by LGOI and LG02 mode signals. It is also shown that Gamma-Gamma FSO fading model performs better for the proposed model than log-normal under different climate conditions. The obtained optical spectra, eye pattern as well as timing diagrams clearly indicate the optimum performance of the system. Moreover, the existing model indicates better performance than existing models for long-haul applications. Therefore, a high speed FSO-MDM system at 120Gbps data rate over 50km range is successfully designed and realized.

articleTitle: Design Of Uwb Mimo For Bio Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper presents the design and characterization of a Ultra-Wideband Multiple Input Multiple Output antenna intended for operation within the frequency range of (2.13-2.36 GHz) and (4.7-20) GHz. The antenna is engineered to resonate at specific frequencies, namely 2.23, 5.44, 8.23, and 9.41 GHz, to cater to various applications requiring precise frequency response. The design integrates compact and low-profile features, making it suitable for integration into biomedical wearable devices. The proposed antenna architecture exhibits excellent impedance matching, radiation efficiency, and low cross-correlation between the MIMO elements. The resonant frequency of 2.23 GHz aligns with microwave frequencies commonly used in non invasive medical imaging techniques, while 5.44 GHz is associated with the Industrial, Scientific, and Medical (ISM) band, often employed in short-range wireless medical telemetry. Frequencies at 8.23 GHz and 9.41 GHz find relevance in microwave-based biomedical sensing and diagnostics.To enhance its performance, we will introduce a decoupling element within the MIMO antenna design. By reducing inter-element coupling, we aim to minimize interference and achieve improved signal quality. This antenna design will make it suitable for bio-medical applications,providing better reliability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Cloud Platform for Efficient Remote Sensing Big Data Processing Based on Open Stack
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The rapid preparation of computing resources is an important step to realize efficient remote sensing image processing. It takes a lot of time for researchers to prepare hardware resources and deploy computing framework. It often mistakes in the preparation and careless deployment of the framework which can lead to high research costs. To solve this problem, this paper uses Open Stack to virtualize hardware resources and uses Linux Shell scripting language to quickly prepare and deploy the Spark parallel computing environment. In this paper, based on the remote sensing image change detection method of connection condition, for example, the data processing algorithm in advance import platform algorithms library, component library, used to support the remote sensing image change detection of business flow of creation and recognition, resources rapid preparation, execution and presentation of the results of the algorithm and implement of massive remote sensing image change detection and efficient. It effectively improves the efficiency of remote sensing data management.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence and Multimedia Technology in Distance Education in the Context of Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The application of artificial intelligence technology has become a new high-tech means under the modern information technology and computer network era, it can effectively improve the teaching efficiency and quality. It can also cultivate students' comprehensive qualities such as independent innovation ability, practical operation and information processing. At present, China is vigorously developing intelligent education mode, and many scholars have researched the development of artificial intelligence technology, but because China is still in the initial stage of computer multimedia distance learning, its theoretical basis is relatively poor compared with foreign countries, so it needs further improvement and enhancement. This paper mainly analyzes the application of artificial intelligence and multimedia technology in distance education, and analyzes the development trend of artificial intelligence technology in distance education, which provides reference for the future intelligent distance education mode in China.

articleTitle: Causal Inference and Causal Relationship Identification of Machine Learning in Econometrics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In econometrics, selecting variables, determining regression coefficients, and determining significance have always been a very important and challenging topic. However, machine learning technology has solved this challenge. This article aims to introduce machine learning and its related theoretical foundations, and explore its role in different application fields. Subsequently, experiments were conducted to analyze and diagnose the extracted feature parameters, and corresponding algorithms were proposed to verify the applicability and feasibility of the model. The results showed that the original algorithm had a prediction accuracy of 0.7, while the machine learning algorithm had a prediction accuracy of 0.9. Combining econometrics and machine learning methods can achieve predictive ability, providing decision-makers with more scientific and effective reference information to help make accurate choices. The commonality between machine learning and econometrics lies in the similarity of the data types and task forms used by the two. The final input for both types of methods is structured data, including dependent variables, independent variables, and case observations.

articleTitle: Improving CCTV footage in Computer Vision Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The fields of computer vision and image processing, which deal with the analysis and modification of visual data like pictures and videos, are closely related. While computer vision focuses on tasks like object recognition and localization, image processing is dedicated to enhancing image quality through techniques like filtering and sharpening. Both are crucial as image quality impacts accurate analysis in various applications. Super-Resolution Generative Adversarial Networks (SRGANs) are a significant advancement in image processing, addressing the enhancement of low-resolution images into high-resolution ones. By employing an SRGAN framework with a generator, discriminator, and VGG19 feature extractor, remarkable super-resolution is achieved. SRGANs are valuable for improving image resolution in areas like scientific imaging, surveillance, and digital media. Higher resolution images enable finer detail detection, better object recognition, and enhanced visual experiences. The designed SRGAN demonstrated 85% training and 83.45% validation accuracy, with a testing accuracy of 80% on 1000 test images. Additionally, it achieved 84.55% testing accuracy on a low-resolution image dataset. This framework holds promise for various applications requiring superior image quality and resolution.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a Library Smart Service Platform Based on Deep Learning and Multi source Heterogeneous Information
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
