abstract: As the 2.0 model of traditional subject service platforms, intelligent subject service platforms are of great significance in alleviating the severe situation of difficult to meet user needs. Therefore, this study focuses on the development status of subject service platforms and analyzes the needs of users in universities for intelligent subject service platforms. This article elaborates and studies deep learning and multi-source heterogeneous information technology, and designs a library smart star service platform based on these two technologies. After testing, the platform can operate normally without any errors, and can basically meet the needs of today’s smart development. Through the research on deep learning and multi-source heterogeneous information, based on these two technologies, a library’s intelligent service platform is designed, After later experimental testing and analysis, the library’s smart service platform can basically meet various usage needs. The functionality of each module was tested 300 times in the functional test.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm for Human Resource Management MOC Resources Based on Spark Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The MAE value of the conventional resource collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm is high, so a collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm for Human Resource Management MOC resources based on the Spark architecture is proposed. The algorithm adopts a hierarchical response form, establishes a user-resource rating relationship model, subtracts the average of user ratings from the resource, completes the optimization of the resource collaborative filtering similarity calculation, introduces a highly integrated Spark architecture, predicts the user's rating of the resource and generates a recommendation list to achieve accurate recommendation of Human Resource Management resources MOC. After comparing the results with the two traditional algorithms, it can be aware of the MAE values of the studied algorithm are inferior to those of the two conventional methods for the training in different proportions and testing collection, indicating that the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on the Spark schema for Human Resource Management resources MOC has upper accuracy of recommendation and exceed capability.

articleTitle: Research on Career Counselling Platform Based on Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The amount of information on the Internet is too large and the information is overloaded, which cannot meet the growing personalized needs of people. The recommendation system is deeply applied in real life, changing the way people obtain information, from active query to the era of personalized recommendation. With the gradual development and improvement of machine learning technology, the recommendation system is gradually using the ideas of machine learning to make recommendations. Collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm is the most mature and widely used personalized recommendation technology. The traditional collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm has data sparsity and cold start problems, and the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on cluster analysis can effectively solve these problems. The collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on cluster analysis develops a career consulting platform, which can effectively solve the problems faced by college students’ career planning, assist career planning education, and improve the employment rate and future career development level of college students. The collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm achieved high values of 97.80% accuracy.

articleTitle: Detection and Alerting of Driver Drowsiness using a Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Driver fatigue is a significant causative factor to accidents worldwide. To signify this issue, we have created a prototype system for detecting tiredness in drivers. This system monitors the driver’s level of drowsiness by tracking their eye movements and issuing an alert if prolonged eye closure is detected. Our focus is on improving driver safety while maintaining a non-intrusive approach. In this project, we utilize the Haarcascade library in OpenCV to detect facial features and accurately detect eye blinks. Through research in the field of computer engineering, we aim to prevent accidents caused by fatigued or sleepy drivers. The project discusses various strategies, their outcomes, and the implemented fixes. By providing insights into the system’s functionality and potential adjustments, the article aims to enhance the system’s overall effectiveness. Furthermore, the project offers observations and recommendations for future optimization in this field, with the goal of maximizing utility at a lower cost and promoting safer roads. The article provides a practical understanding of the system’s operation and serves as a valuable resource for advancing research and development efforts in driver drowsiness detection.

articleTitle: Real-Time Stress Level Monitoring Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Stress is a prevalent and debilitating issue in contemporary society, contributing to a range of physical and mental health problems. As our lives become increasingly fastpaced and interconnected, addressing stress effectively has become imperative. This introduces a pioneering approach to tackle challenge through real-time stress level monitoring utilizing the Internet of Things (IoT). We propose a holistic system that merges IoT sensors, advanced data analytics, and machine learning techniques to provide continuous stress assessment and management solutions. The data is collected through the designed model then preprocessed, and essential features are extracted to construct a predictive model. The heart of the system is a machine learning model, which constantly updates itself based on user-specific stress patterns, yielding highly accurate real-time stress level estimations. Users are provided with actionable feedback and personalized recommendations, ranging from deep breathing exercises to lifestyle adjustments. Extensive experimentation demonstrates the system's robustness, with stress level predictions boasting a mean absolute error of under 5%.

articleTitle: Parameters Optimization of Dynamic CT Pulmonary Perfusion Imaging Analysis Technology Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development and popularization of artificial intelligence technology, CT has been more and more widely used in the field of clinical medicine as a non-volume micro body diagnostic method. In this paper, the artificial intelligence software is used to build a dynamic CTR lung scanning image based on the wavelet neural network model, and the genetic algorithm is used to improve the traditional visual lung image quality analysis model to improve the diagnostic efficiency. At the same time, the matrix representation weight value of the relationship between different types of disease maps is obtained by changing the threshold value to calculate the acoustic difference between the same CT tissue to determine its membership function and carry out joint optimization, After that, the effect of this technology was tested, and the results showed that the artificial intelligence based dynamic CT pulmonary perfusion imaging technology had faster generation time and higher quality than traditional algorithms in image processing, so as to achieve accurate mining of results and reduce the number of misdiagnosis. As a result, this method achieved 15 s for imaging test which comparatively lesser than Traditional imaging algorithms.

articleTitle: Simulation and Application of Low Carbon Heating Buildings Based on Genetic Algorithm Optimization PID
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As technologies related to building heat production and low carbon develop, the target requirements for heat production and low carbon building models are being optimized. The design and research of low-carbon(LC) building models for heating based on genetic algorithm optimization PID (Proposal Integral Differential) is becoming increasingly important. How to reduce the carbon emissions of the building optimization model and improve the heat transfer performance of the building are currently key issues that need to be urgently addressed in the construction of the entire LC building model for heating. This article focuses on the prediction of building carbon emissions and related research on LC emission systems for building heating. By utilizing genetic algorithms to optimize the application of PID in buildings and analyzing the algorithmic process steps, combined with the weight vectors and normalization calculations of indicators related to LC emission systems for building heating, the following conclusions are drawn based on the data results: Five types of building samples are selected through simulation experiments. The application of a LC building model for heating based on genetic algorithm optimization PID has improved carbon emissions compared to traditional schemes, with a comprehensive average reduction of about 13.5%. At the same time, it has also improved building heat transfer performance, with a comprehensive average improvement of about 7.7%. This indicates that the heating low-carbon building model based on genetic algorithm optimized PID has a good practical application effect in low-carbon heating of buildings.

articleTitle: An Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm Based Secure and Energy-Aware Clustering in Vehicular Ad hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Vehicular Ad hoc Network (VANET) is a mobile network which enables a numerous intelligent transportation system. The secure routing is significant to prevent mobile devices from other threats so, the effective characteristics in VANET are utilized to attain an efficient secure routing path. The high vehicle distribution and node mobility compromises the network scalability and topology. So, creating the reliable and scalable vehicle communication, network physical layout formation, unstable link to enable robust are difficult task in traffic network. In this research, novel optimization algorithm is considered with transmission range, speed direction, grid size and node density during the clustering. The Improved Whale optimization Algorithm for clustering in VANET (IWOA) is proposed for selecting an optimal Cluster Head (CH). Primarily, the optimal CH are selected by using IWOA and then the route path is selected. The simulations are performed and then the experiments are conducted on the IWOA. The performance of IWOA is evaluated using throughput, Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) and latency by various rounds of 30, 40, 50, 60 and 70. The IWOA attained high throughput of 6. 87mbps and PDR of 0.93 with less latency of 0.10s which is superior than other existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Database Signature Encryption Algorithm in Cross-Border E-Commerce Payment and Settlement System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Digital signature system is an indispensable security technology for cross-border e-commerce payment. A new cryptographic scheme is presented by Euler simulation. A new cryptosystem based on Guillou-Quisquater is proposed, which has high security. At the same time, this paper designs a mobile payment system based on the signature encryption scheme. This paper expounds the basic theory of electronic signature using public key encryption technology. The proposed model has the advantage of solving some security problems existing in the traditional public key encryption algorithm in information transmission, such as: inconvenient key distribution and management, unreasonable key distribution, inconvenient key management and storage, and high risk of key disclosure. A secure payment scheme of e-commerce based on asymmetric encryption and digital signature is proposed. The scheme overcomes some shortcomings of traditional e-commerce secure payment system and solves some problems of traditional e-commerce. The simulation results show that the system can improve the security of cross-border e-commerce payment and settlement.

articleTitle: High notch microstrip antenna array at Ka band
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper presents the experimental research and design for microstrip patch array antenna which resonates in Ka band. The proposed design consists of 4 microstrip rectangular patches. HFSS software is used for the simulation and analysis with four candidate structure. A material having a dielectric constant of 4.36 is used for the substrate material with the low loss tangent of 0.01. The dimension of the patches are varied to achieve better result. Design of all the antenna were within the range of 28 to 40 GHz. Designed Antenna exhibit the bandwidth range within 2.925 GHz to 7.7 GHz. By adjustment of the size of the patch i.e length, width and height, an appreciable gain within 9.62 dB to 9.98 dB was observed within the proposed design. The proposed antenna array will be able to scaled to a larger radiating structure.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Application of GIS Communication Intelligence Construction in Electronic Information Engineering Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the vigorous development of optical fiber communication, optical fiber has become the main medium for information transmission in the power system. However, the power communication network is facing problems such as a large number of outdated equipment, a wide distribution range of communication optical cables, and complex connection relationships. Therefore, on the basis of power GIS (Geographic Information System), communication operation management systems need to develop towards intelligence and high-end. Based on this, this article established an intelligent power communication management system using GIS technology. This article first elaborated on the background and significance of the topic selection, and reviewed and summarized the current research status in relevant fields around the world. At the same time, the information and spatial analysis results were displayed in the communication operation management system in a variety of intuitive graphics, images and charts through the GIS visualization function and the resource correlation calculation function of the communication operation management system, thus improving the reliability of the power communication network and the ability to quickly handle faults. Finally, through the black box test experiment, it is proved that the intelligent power communication system based on GIS technology has fast response time, high transaction processing capacity and good transaction pass rate. These findings show that the system can run efficiently and stably when dealing with power communication management tasks, and can meet the needs of users.

articleTitle: Design Student Management System Based on Vector Influential Clustering Algorithm Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the gradual development and maturity of emerging technologies such as Internet technology and big data mining (DM), the degree of campus networking is getting higher and higher. In the era of rapid development of information technology, the Internet has become a very important and meaningful information channel in people’s lives and studies. The student management system (SAS) is an indispensable part of the school education system management and service work. The college SAS is a comprehensive system with distinctive features that fully reflects the school’s management level and teaching quality. With the continuous advancement of education reform, computer-based, through the use of vector influence (VI) clustering technology to classify the information of college students, and divide the corresponding target data set based on the corresponding user category in the rule database. Therefore, based on the analysis of the VI clustering algorithm (CA), this article conducts research on the SAS and its related content. This article adopts experimental analysis method and data analysis method, which intends to use experiments to analyze the clustering effect and performance of the SAS based on the VI CA. As indicated by the trial results, the base mistake inside the class of the framework for these four levels is 0.12, 0.17, 0.21 and 0.48, separately. The framework has generally little mistakes in the examination of understudy execution, and the bunching impact is somewhat great, which can address the issues of understudies the essential necessities of execution investigation.

articleTitle: Information Platform of Business English Teaching from the Perspective of Big data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Our educational and teaching concepts, concepts and methods are constantly updated and developed due to the continuous maturity and improvement of modern educational technology. While educational information plays a supporting role in education, it also emphasizes its leading role, stressing the use of educational information to solve the problems that restrict the development of education in our country. The purpose of this paper is to create a dynamic information platform for business English teaching. Technically with B/S structure and object-oriented technology, the platform is designed based on Struts MVC framework. Through the comparison between the experimental group and the control group, the effect of the business English teaching information platform from the perspective of big data is analyzed. The experimental results show that there is a 95% certainty that there is a significant difference in the performance of the students in the experimental class before and after the experiment, which shows that the business English teaching information platform can help improve the students’ academic performance.

articleTitle: Exploration on Quality Enhancement of Art Works Based on Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In response to the problems existing in current methods for enhancing the quality of art works, this paper introduced a method for enhancing the quality of art works based on image processing technology. First, the edge of the image in the art works was enhanced by fuzzy enhancement technology. Then the image was balanced by the improved histogram equalization technology and the image was denoised based on the gray transformation algorithm. Finally, the processed image was processed based on the local mean algorithm. The experimental results showed that after using the proposed method to enhance the quality of art works, the peak signal-to-noise ratio and average gradient of the image have been significantly improved. The expert’s peak signal-to-noise ratio score could reach up to 89.8 points and the average gradient score could reach up to 88.3 points.

articleTitle: Optimization Research of Transportation Costs and Efficiency of Multimodal Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Multimodal transportation is an important medium for the circulation of goods. Due to the insufficient consideration of cost factors in traditional models when predicting route selection, the cost of multimodal transportation route selection is relatively high. Therefore, a multimodal transportation route selection model considering transportation cost optimization is studied. This article uses the network graph theory in operations research to construct a multimodal transportation network graph. Based on the minimum total cost, a model is established, and the Dijkstra algorithm for solving the shortest path is used to solve the model. The feasibility of the entire model is confirmed during the process of solving the example problem. This article provides suggestions for strengthening the establishment of logistics systems, strengthening the application of information technology, and strengthening the construction of standard systems, in order to improve the efficiency of multimodal transportation.

articleTitle: Decentralized Social Media Application Based On Blockchain And NFT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Concerns regarding free expression, censorship, and user privacy have arisen as a result of the rapid expansion of centralized social media platforms. This research paper describes a decentralized social media platform designed to address these challenges by giving users more ownership and power. Our platform supports a democratic and censorship-resistant environment by using the power of blockchain technology and smart contracts, giving users more control over their personal data and user-generated content. Furthermore, we present a novel monetization strategy in which individuals can earn money by selling their content to their followers in the form of non-fungible tokens (NFTs). Our methodology makes use of cutting-edge Web 3.0 technologies such as the Solidity programming language, the React JS framework, and the IPFS (Interplanetary File System) decentralized storage system. According to the conclusions of this study, our decentralized social media network has considerable advantages over traditional centralized platforms in terms of user empowerment, privacy, and content monetization. This article adds to the expanding body of research on decentralized applications and prepares the way for a new era of social media that promotes user sovereignty and fair rewards for content providers.

articleTitle: An Automated Deep Learning Approach for Kidney Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) may cause significant damage to a person’s kidneys or lead to renal failure, which can be deadly. Kidney stones are a common symptom and may lead to serious conditions including kidney tumors and cysts. The timely and precise diagnosis of kidney illnesses is a major problem in modern healthcare, and this work aims to help solve that problem. This research suggests a deep-learning strategy for categorizing normal and various kidney diseases. using the custom convolutional neural network architecture. This study improves model performance through thorough validation and hyperparameter adjustment. Result findings show that the custom CNN model correctly differentiates between several kidney diseases with a validation accuracy of 0.9962, precision of 0.9925, and a validation loss of 0.0158. The technique used presents a new perspective on the problem space by capitalizing on current developments in deep learning, image processing, and predictive modeling.

articleTitle: Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Stock Market Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With financial analysts and top institutions around the world utilising its power to derive sophisticated insights, machine learning has quickly become a cornerstone in the world of modern stock trading. The widespread use of this technology highlights the sector’s constant quest for higher predictive accuracy. Despite this, the stock market’s inherent volatility—which is influenced by a confluence of factors including human emotions, global events, economic shifts, and unforeseen circumstances—remains complicated, making the search for the ideal predictive model difficult. The research delves into this complexity and offers a thorough analysis of the various machine learning techniques used in stock market forecasting. Each algorithm’s effectiveness has been carefully evaluated using a battery of performance metrics on datasets that include stock prices from various companies, ranging from conventional approaches to sophisticated deep learning techniques. The goal is to identify the most accurate predictive tool, serving as a benchmark for subsequent financial forecasting efforts. It was concluded that LSTM performs the best out of all the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Automated Stock Trading using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Trading stocks requires effective methodologies to succeed in the business process. Automated stock trading involves utilizing computer algorithms and software programs to execute stock market trades automatically. This research work proposes an ensemble approach that leverages deep reinforcement learning to discover a stock trading strategy aimed at maximizing investment returns. By employing three actor-critic-based algorithms—Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C), and Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)—along with Soft actor-critic (SAC) and Twin Delayed DDPG (TD3), This work trains a deep reinforcement learning agent to develop an ensemble trading strategy. This ensemble strategy is designed to robustly adapt to various market conditions, as it inherits and integrates the most favorable characteristics from these three algorithms. Load on demand technique is supported in the proposed work in order to process extensive data efficiently and mitigate high memory usage during continuous action space network training, further this research employs a load-on-demand technique. The deep reinforcement learning agent is trained to implement an ensemble trading strategy that skillfully combines the best features of the three algorithms, thereby enabling it to adapt effectively to diverse market conditions. The results demonstrate that the proposed deep ensemble strategy consistently outperforms the three individual algorithms and the two baseline methods in terms of risk-adjusted returns, as indicated by the Sharpe ratio.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Architecture with Ensemble Learning in Cranial and Mediolateral View Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The study explores the field of anomaly detection employing advanced methods. Mammography analysis for the identification of anomaly is examined in terms of the effectiveness of ensemble learning when combined with the powerful EfficientNet-B7 deep learning architecture. This study attempts to enhance anomaly identification accuracy by utilizing the abilities of these methods. Comparative experimental results show significant enhancements corresponding to the proposed ensemble learning model. The integrated technique outperforms the standalone EfficientNetB7 model’s 95.81% and 94.89% training and validation accuracies while attaining 98.86% and 98.29% with the proposed approach, respectively and the memory consumption has increased by approximately 18.28% with the proposed approach and 22.84% without the proposed approach. With better generalization and reduced overfitting characteristics, the ensemble model consistently shows higher accuracy over training and validation datasets. These results demonstrate the possibility of ensemble learning to improve the stability and accuracy of detection of anomalies. Selecting the right model and considering ensemble learning into account while analyzing medical images are crucial choices that could impact the diagnostic system’s reliability, effectiveness, and accuracy.

articleTitle: Empowering Diabetic Prediction through MRMR-Driven Feature Selection and Robustness of Ensemble Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Effective diabetic prediction plays a pivotal role in healthcare, as it allows for early intervention and tailored treatment strategies, ultimately leading to enhanced patient outcomes and decreased healthcare costs. In recent times, the incorporation of machine learning models has exhibited potential in augmenting the accuracy of diabetic prediction models. This research study focuses on enhancing diabetic prediction through the synergistic application of ensemble machine learning and feature selection, particularly the Minimum Redundancy Maximum Relevance (MRMR) - driven feature selection method. By integrating MRMR - driven features into forward feature selection within ensemble machine learning models, the study aims to create a highly accurate Ensemble Machine Learning – Diabetic Prediction System (EML-DPS). The experimental results of EML-DPS demonstrates the effectiveness of the combination of ensemble machine learning models and MRMR - driven feature selection significantly improves predictive accuracy, reduces overfitting, and enhances the interpretability of the model. This approach, exemplified by Optimizable Ensemble’s remarkable ability to reach 97.3% accuracy with minimal set of essential features, achieves promising results in diabetic prediction.

articleTitle: Real Time Fire Detection and Alert Triggering System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The real-time fire detection and triggering system presented in this study harnesses camera images for swift and reliable fire detection, leveraging a multi-stage approach. The system’s preprocessing phase involves image enhancement and noise reduction to optimize image quality, while the feature extraction step extracts relevant information from the images to improve discrimination between fire and non-fire regions. Classification is carried out using a machine learning model, like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), to discern potential fire events in the images. Upon detecting a fire, the system triggers immediate alarms or safety protocols, thus enhancing fire prevention and response mechanisms in real-time scenarios. The overall implementation of the research work is done in the python environment from which it is proved that the proposed methodology attains better performance than the existing research methodology. The proposed work attains better performance than the existing research methodologies in terms of 7% increased accuracy. And in terms of precision, recall and f-measure proposed method attains 6%, 4% improvement than the existing research methodologies.

articleTitle: Relevance and Applicability of Cybersecurity Frameworks in the Context of BFSI Vertical in India
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) industry is essential in a digitally driven world, making it a prominent target for cyber-attacks. The adoption of strong cybersecurity frameworks is necessary to protect with these growing threats. This study offers an analysis of several cybersecurity frameworks, assessing their applicability to the dynamic threat environment of consequently with an emphasis on the BFSI industry. The study aims to comprehend that Industry 4.0 is used and implemented in Indian businesses, with a focus on the BFSI industry, to increase the businesses’ productivity, efficiency, and competitiveness. The primary objective of the core support of Industry 4.0 into the BFSI sector have Cybersecurity. This support has been used to evaluate the business. According to the results of this study, a small number of organizations have undergone that utilizing Industry 4.0 technologies and processes. Five different levels of maturity have been evaluated. The conclusions have been created for an investigation and are based on sparse data regarding implications. Despite this can be serving as a foundation for understanding the industry 4.0 technologies and approaches used in businesses sector. As a result, the study’s utility depends on the fact that it is one of the recent studies that offer a perspective on the use and application of Industry 4.0.

articleTitle: Modelling Soil Fertilizer Levels and Crop Yields in Agriculture Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Technology is everywhere in the 21st Century. So, for optimum results in each field, various methods to minimize loss and maximize benefits. The application of Machine Learning in crop type prediction for modern farming is crucial. Also, suggesting the type of fertilizer and amount can increase the application's usability. Various aspects of rain amount and other real-world parameters are taken into account when predicting crop yields and suggesting fertilizer applications. To predict output, the application uses the Flask web framework to store a large number of datasets. The application then creates a link between Random Forest algorithms, Decision Tree algorithms, and XGBoost algorithms. This work focuses on crops that are significant in the area chosen. Based on soil fertility and weather data, the proposed model predicts crop type. The type of fertilizer to use for the chosen crop should be determined. Predict crop yields using a fertilizer calculator and estimate the economic impact of cultivation by calculating the amount of fertilizer needed.

articleTitle: Development and Comparative Study of Advanced Distributed Electronic Control System for Robotic Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper aims to thoroughly analyze and compare a project report on an advanced electronic control system for robotics with two related scholarly works. The primary focus is on identifying the commonalities and divergences, as well as the strengths and weaknesses of these methods. The paper being reviewed proposes a novel architecture for a control system that employs distributed electronics to enhance robot performance and functionality, detailing the design, implementation, and real-world application effectiveness. It covers key aspects like an electronic board designed for stepper motor control in a closed-loop system, communication protocols, sensor integration, and distributed computing. The review delves into the comparative analysis of control system architectures, communication methods, and implementation techniques across the three papers, shedding light on their potential impact in the field of robotics, and suggests areas for future research and improvements.

articleTitle: Analysis of Adolescent Tuberculosis Prevention and Treatment by Combining Data Membership and Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: To provide effective suggestions for tuberculosis prevention and control, fuzzy c-Means (FCM) algorithm was used to build a data mining model for adolescent tuberculosis. At the same time, the membership degree is used to determine the criterion parameters and achieve model improvement. The improved FCM clustering accuracy is 97.65% and 94.65%, respectively, which is better than traditional FCM models. The results showed that the pass rate of nuclear disease prevention and control core knowledge was 94.20%, and the total awareness rate of tuberculosis prevention and control among middle school students was 76.2%. According to the analysis results, tuberculosis prevention suggestions are given. The traditional FCM is prone to local convergence and parameterization problems, data membership parameters and relative entropy are introduced for improvement. The two-dimensional data analysis capabilities of the data mining model were tested. This research provides important technical support for tuberculosis data analysis and prevention, and helps to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of tuberculosis prevention and control.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Severity Assessment of Pterygium
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Pterygium is an external growth which is fibro vascular tissue that grows towards cornea of the eye. It is a challenging for health practitioners to identify and assesse the progression of the pterygium in the early stages. As a result, this paper describes the implementation of comprehensive system that effectively diagnoses, measure, and evaluate the onset and progression of the pterygium. HOG descriptors were tried with dichotomous classifier, SVM for the classification of healthy eye and pterygium. Here two ML algorithms BPNN (Back Propagation Neural Networks) and CNN (Convolution Neural Networks) were tried for grade the severity of the Pterygium in order to empower ophthalmologists to provide high-quality diagnosis and facilitate personalized health care in the near future. Of the two machine learning approaches in this study, CNN achieves 90-96% of accuracy compared to 66-77% accuracy in BPNN and other parameters specificity, sensitivity is also sufficient to evaluate the damaged caused by Pterygium.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Arrhythmia Classification using Orthogonal Wavelet Filtering with Moth Flame Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: An accurate and early detection of arrhythmia have become significant because of its enhanced mortality from the cardiovascular disease (CVD). The Electrocardiogram (ECG) majorly takes place in the CVD diagnosis, but it provides the information about the heartbeat. An automatic detection of arrhythmia performs a significant role in managing as well as curing the CVDs. In this research, pre-processing using an Orthogonal Wavelet-based Filtering approach with Moth Flame optimization (MFO) filter bank is proposed to enhance the denoising performance of the ECG signals. This research utilized the arrhythmia dataset named MIT-BIH to evaluated the performance of the proposed method. After pre-processing, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is utilized for the feature extraction and Supervised Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (SBiLSTM) is used for the classification of the arrhythmia images. The proposed method attains better results and achieves the values of accuracy of 99.97%, specificity of 99.98%, sensitivity of 99.96% as well as Positive Predictive Value of 95.75% when compared to the existing methods like ResNet-BiLSTM-Attention, 2D-CNN, CNN-BLSTM, CNN-LSTM and Deep Recurrent CNN (DRCNN) respectively.

Author Keywords: Moth Flame optimization and Orthogonal wavelet-based Filtering

articleTitle: Advances in Natural Language Processing and Deep Learning for Document Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Due to the vast volume of online textual content, the need for automated document summarization is growing. Manual summarization is time-consuming and impractical given the sheer amount of text. Natural Language Processing (NLP) and data retrieval techniques are employed for single-document and multi-document summarization. Extractive methods select and combine significant phrases from source documents, while abstractive methods represent the content differently before generating summaries the source. The earlier stages of NLP, statistical models, rule-based approaches, and information retrieval techniques played pivotal roles in text analysis and processing. Traditional methods like part-of-speech tagging, named entity recognition, and sentiment analysis were fundamental for tasks such as information retrieval, language understanding, and text classification. Hybrid approaches combine both methods. Despite these advancements, automated summaries still differ significantly from human-generated ones. This article addresses various aspects of summarization, including methods, techniques, datasets, performance, and future research prospects, providing a comprehensive overview of the field.

articleTitle: Deepfake detection for preventing Audio and Video frauds using Advanced Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Deepfakes, powered by generative adversarial networks (GANs), automate the creation of deceptive videos. To combat this menace, the study assembles an advanced model that fuses ResNeXt, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and ResNet architectures, renowned for their efficacy in handling visual and temporal aspects, for the detection of deepfakes in audio and video content. Pre-processing, facilitated by a Multi-Task Cascaded-Convolutional Neural Network (MTCNN), accurately extracts facial regions. The model undergoes rigorous evaluation across three key datasets which are, FaceForensics++(FF-DF), Celeb-DF, and Facebook Deepfake Detection Challenge (DFDC), affirming its real-world readiness and exceptional accuracy. The combined models consistently deliver highly precise results, maintaining their robustness against evolving deepfake technologies.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection in Healthcare using Sand-Cat Optimization based Long-Short Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) has become an attractive environment for cybercriminals due to its rapid development. These devices have finite computational capabilities which establish minimal power absorption. Security is a significant problem in IoMT systems due to the services being accessed via the Internet by a variety of users therefore, the patient’s health information needs to be kept confidential, secure, and accurate. In this research, the Sand-Cat optimization based Long Short-Term Memory (SCO-LSTM) is proposed for intrusion detection to secure the entire network in the healthcare system using deep learning. Initially, the data is obtained by the CIC-IDS2017 dataset and then min-max normalization is performed to normalize the acquired data. The SCO approach is employed for feature selection which examines appropriate features in the healthcare system. Finally, the LSTM classification is performed to identify and classify intrusion detection accurately and effectively in the healthcare system. When compared to the existing methods, the proposed SCO-LSTM achieves a better accuracy of 99.48% respectively.

articleTitle: The Model of Mental Health Education Knowledge Service System Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to pay attention to the mental health of college students and explore new intervention methods and means, the author proposes a model of mental health education knowledge service system based on virtual reality. In this study, 50 college students were selected as subjects and divided into an experimental group (25 people) and a control group (25 people), and the experimental group was intervened by the cooperatively developed virtual reality psychological relaxation training system (VRPsyRIS), twice a week, the experiment was carried out for 4 weeks. The scores of the Anxiety Self-rating Scale (SAS) before and after were compared between the two groups. Experimental results show that: Analysis of intra-group pre-test and post-test results between the experimental group and the control group After the intervention, the anxiety level of the experimental group decreased significantly compared with before the intervention, with an average decrease of 8.98, and the difference was significant. The anxiety level of the control group was slightly lower than that of the pre-test, but the difference was not significant. Conclusion: Virtual reality psychological relaxation training technology, it can be used as an optional means of psychological intervention for college students.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Identification Method Using Computer Vision and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper proposes an image processing-based method for detecting plant diseases. The system's three key phases are acquisition, pre-processing, and disease identification. Pictures of plant leaves are taken during the image acquisition stage using a digital camera. The image preprocessing stage involves enhancing and pre-processing the collected images to eliminate noise and extraneous data. The pre-processed photos are finally sorted into healthy or unhealthy, utilizing machine learning techniques in the illness identification step. This paper will represent how we can detect plant leaf diseases using a specific software system. It will also find the percentage of accuracy and error of disease detection based on the number of detected images. The leaf disease finding procedure information will also be explained here step by step. According to experimental data, the proposed approach has a high level of accuracy in detecting plant illnesses. Farmers can utilize the system as a valuable tool to detect plant illnesses early, minimizing yield losses and enhancing crop management techniques.

articleTitle: Value Creation and Management Improvement of AI in the Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the 21st century, with the widespread application of technologies such as sensor measurement, computer communication, power electronics, and the Internet, developed countries in Europe and America have taken the lead in discussing and attempting the safety, reliability, flexibility, and quality of power supply. Relevant research and practice have been launched around the interaction with users, the development and management of clean energy and distributed power, and innovation in power supply technology. Intelligent management of power networks has become a development trend in the world power grid. This article deeply explored the value creation and management improvement of AI (artificial intelligence) in the power industry, and analyzed the value and management improvement of AI in the power industry from the perspectives of power load forecasting, power user data management, energy market pricing, and customized customer service in the power system. The article focused on the monitoring and optimization analysis of secondary equipment in the power system using neural networks, and verified the feasibility of the algorithm through experiments (the algorithm had a fault prediction accuracy of over 90% for secondary equipment in 1 to 200 iterations).

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis on Zomato Restaurant Reviews using Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a vital aspect of understanding public opinion and sentiment towards products and services. This paper presents a sentiment analysis work focused on Zomato restaurant reviews in Bangalore, aiming to classify restaurants into positive, negative, or neutral sentiment categories based on customer reviews. Bi-LSTM and Bi-GRU models are employed to capture contextual information in the sequential data of reviews. Additionally, sentiment analysis techniques, including Word2Vec, VADER, and Sentiment Intensity Analyzer, are integrated to enhance the sentiment classification process. Through rigorous experimentation, the performance of these models and techniques is evaluated. The proposed models demonstrate promising accuracy rates in sentiment classification. By enhancing and expanding the sentiment analysis framework, this paper contributes to a deeper understanding of public sentiment towards Zomato restaurants in Bangalore. The insights derived from this study can facilitate informed decision-making for both restaurant owners and customers, ultimately improving the dining experience and customer satisfaction with accuracy of 98.6%.

articleTitle: Smart Middle Platform Construction of Power Enterprises Based on Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As information technology evolves, power companies need to process a lot of data and want to gain more value. However, power companies face challenges due to data dispersion and limited ability to store, process and analyze data. In order to solve these problems, the power enterprises have introduced the concept of intelligent intermediate platform. This article analyzed the design and construction of smart middle platforms in power enterprises, and tested the effectiveness of building smart middle platforms in power enterprises. The experimental results showed that the smart middle platform construction of power enterprises based on big data platform has significant advantages in data processing efficiency, decision support capability and system performance compared with traditional platforms. The experimental group had fast data processing speed, high accuracy, and high data integration efficiency. In addition, the experimental group had richer data and information visualization ability, stronger decision-making analysis ability and real-time prediction ability.

articleTitle: Interactive Design of Public Spaces Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In response to the shortcomings of traditional architectural space design systems that cannot dynamically interact with users, an interactive architectural space virtual system based on artificial intelligence technology VRML and B/S structure is designed. A three-layer B/S structure is adopted to establish an interactive architectural space virtual system that includes three layers: user browser layer, application server layer, and data library layer. The coplanar merging algorithm with dihedral angle threshold is selected to search for the scene hyperplane of the preliminary building space model, Select the optimal insertion algorithm for the lowest horizontal line to complete texture stitching and establish a virtual scene of 3D architectural space. The experiment shows that the average scores of interactivities, realism, and hierarchy for establishing 10 different types of 3D architectural space virtual scenes using this system are 93.9 points, 94.1 points, and 93.2 points, respectively.

articleTitle: Automatic Skin Cancer Segmentation and Classification using Fuzzy C-means Clustering-based Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Skin cancer is treated as one of the primary types of disease in the human body which is caused by the radiation of ultraviolet from the sun. However, manual segmentation and classification of skin cancer is extremely difficult and time-consuming due to visual variations in skin lesions. In this research, the Fuzzy C-means Clustering-based Convolutional Neural Network (FCM-CNN) is proposed for the automatic segmentation and classification of skin cancer using deep learning. Initially, the data is obtained by the ISIC-2017 dataset, and then pre-processing is performed using a Top hat filter and inpainting approach. The FCM approach is used to segment the given pre-processed image. The Local Ternary Pattern (LTP) and Local Vector Pattern (LVP) are used to extract the appropriate features. Finally, the CNN classification is utilized to classify skin cancer as malignant or benign. When compared with the existing methods, the proposed FCM-CNN achieves a better accuracy of 99.75% respectively.

articleTitle: Customer Churn Prediction in The Banking Sector on Imbalance Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Customer churning is a significant concern of this digital age in every industry. As it is a highly cost sensitive phenomena for any business if any of their customer churned from their company to any other competitor. This is study is aimed to develop a highly accurate model by employing various machine learning algorithms for the prediction of the potential churners in the banking sector. To achieve this aim, a comprehensive amount of literature was reviewed for better understanding of the significant factors for such model designing. Data was prone to imbalance nature of class distribution because of that a couple of class balancing techniques which comprised upon SMOTE and ADASYN were employed. In the next phase, highly correlated features were extracted by using FCBF and RFE-FE and only those selected features were passed through different data mining techniques such as DT, RF and ANN. The results of the models‘ evaluation showed that model developed on the balanced dataset by ADASYN and having features from RFE technique perfumed best.

articleTitle: Attention-Guided Residual Network for Skin Lesion Classification Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The increasing incidence of skin cancers emphasizes the critical need for early detection, making effective therapeutic intervention possible. Although existing skin lesion segmentation methodologies offer some solutions, they are often hindered by inconsistent annotations present in the datasets. Accurate delineation of lesion boundaries is fundamental for diagnosing various skin conditions. In this research, a skin lesion segmentation method is introduced using an attention-guided reinforcement learning algorithm, framed within the context of a Markov Decision Process. This approach mirrors the method doctors use when identifying areas of concern on the skin. To improve classification accuracy, a self-attention mechanism is integrated into the network. This addition refines the focus on vital regions within the images, ensuring more precise segmentation. With deep reinforcement learning, the agent is trained to segment these regions, employing a series of actions that are continuously variable. This continuous action space is exploited by the segmentation model, which utilizes the deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm, allowing for iterative refinement from broader segmentation to detailed delineation. The proposed method is tested on benchmark dataset, ISIC 2017, and achieved an accuracy of 97.10% for naevus, 96.33% for melanoma, and 95.13% for seborrheic keratosis cases. Additionally, the enhanced approach with attention module, outperformed several contemporary skin lesion segmentation techniques in terms of performance.

articleTitle: A Face Image Processing System Based on Object Tracking Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In order to meet the current training, employment and regulatory needs, the Hong Kong government will launch a comprehensive training program. The system consists of the main arm controller, sensor module, adjustable camera and image acquisition and processing system. The system has the advantages of high precision and reasonable price, and has broad market prospects. In this paper, the problem of autonomous motion control for tracking target is studied, and an active tracking control method for serial action output target is proposed. The learning strategy utilizes visual perception and depth improvement to make decisions, using consecutive frames’ visual image as continuous control model for input state and output action. The system has the advantages of high precision and reasonable price, and has broad market prospects. Target tracking is an important application in video surveillance and a new research field in image processing. Video surveillance uses cameras to identify moving or multiple objects, widely used in human-computer interaction, security, traffic control, airports, subway stations, and mass activities. As a result, MUSIC obtained 96% of accuracy, 95% of precision, 94% of f-measure, and 91% of recall.

articleTitle: Real Time Eye-Tracking Mouse Control Using Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) techniques, specifically Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), were employed to achieve precise and intuitive real-time eye tracking mouse control through computer vision. However, XGBoost may suffer from overfitting when dealing with a large number of features compared to the training data size, or when dealing with noisy or imbalanced data. To address this issue, this paper introduces a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), for eye tracking mouse control in Human Computer Interaction (HCI). Gaze Direction Estimation (GDE) is initially employed to estimate gaze direction, utilizing pupil positions and camera calibration parameters. The estimated gaze direction is then used as input for the RNN to eye-tracking mouse control for HCI. The experimental results shows that the GDE-RNN has 26.03% and 8.24% superior accuracy, 24.93% and 86.76% better precision, and 27.36% and 8.75% high recall in comparison to SVM and XGBoost for eye tracking mouse control.

articleTitle: Enhanced Intrusion Detection System using Pearson Correlation based Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is one of the common deep learning (DL) use cases which is used to finding and identifying outliers to prevent adversarial attacks, fraud and network intrusions. These systems play an important role in securing computer networks. The improvement of effective performance and security is the most needed in the IDS system. This paper aims to implement an IDS utilizing DL method. The DL model is the most encouraging technique and is widely used to detect intrusions. This paper implemented a Pearson’s Correlation based Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model for intrusion detection system. The proposed Pearson’s Correlation is evaluated on NSL-KDD dataset, and Min-Max normalization is a pre-processing method employed for normalize the data. Filter method of Pearson Correlation is utilized in the implemented for selecting the features. The LSTM is utilized to enhance system capability to identify and classify intrusion accurately and effectively. The implemented Pearson’s Correlation based LSTM achieves better accuracy using NSL-KDD dataset with the value of 99.50% in term of accuracy, respectively.

articleTitle: The Multi-Verse Optimization Algorithm using a Fuzzy Clustering Technique to Effectively Detect Frauds in Automobile
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The growing use of the internet, especially in the automotive industry, has resulted in the development of several online services. Globally, the exponential expansion of financial fraud has resulted in huge financial losses for organisations in a variety of industries. This research develops an innovative approach that utilizes a capability of the Multi-Verse Optimization Algorithm (MVOA) to improve the performance in fraud detection through fuzzy clustering method. The contributions of MVOA are in the enhancement of model adaptability to ever-changing fraud patterns, the adept handling of imbalanced data through diverse exploration, and the resolution of feature interdependencies. The suggested fuzzy clustering technique improves the majority sample dataset within the Advanced Integrated Fraud Detection System (AIFDS) framework by removing outliers. The dataset utilization is thoroughly evaluated using modern classifiers such as XGBoost, CATBoost, Decision Tree and Random Forest. The AIFDS, enhanced by the MVOA-with fuzzy clustering model achieved better performance in accuracy of 94.32%, Sensitivity of 96.37 and precision of 93.49%, and enhancing fraud detection and lowering the financial risks associated with fraudulent operations.

articleTitle: Two-Factor Authentication with Backup Codes for Webspace
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: From the beginning, authentication was just a simple email and password and it is unbelievably still used in majority systems, where organizations rely on their users to use a simple password for gaining any access to the system. With people using repetitive passwords and not hiding their passwords causes a chance of compromising one or more systems. This research paper aims to move further from that issue by using technologies at our disposal so that systems in different organizations would not have the risk of being compromised. It would also show how it does not require a lot of effort from the user. Furthermore, there are several researchers which have shown many ways to minimize the current issues which the implementation of the technology. The proposal system aims to be innovated as much as possible, while not affecting the usability towards to users. The solution will solely focus on legitimizing users so as to reduce the risk of compromising the organization. This paper would discuss about the technology in depth, the impact it will have and the benefits it would have towards the current organization.

articleTitle: A Secure Authentication Model with Optimized Key Generation in IoT-Fog-Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With a rise in cloud computing, numerous organizations and businesses units utilized the cloud servers to expand their operations, which leads to lower equipment cost and effective resources utilization. The fog system is operated among the cloud-based IoT, that offered a hierarchy of computing resources for collecting, aggregating, and processing the data from IoT devices. Moreover, the private key is generated to encrypt the data for secure authentication of IoT-Fog-Cloud computing. In this work, hybrid optimization enabled optimal key is generated for data protection. The entities considered for secure authentication-based data protection includes user, fog devices and cloud server. Moreover, the steps like initialization, registration, key generation, authentication and verification as well as data protection is carried out. Furthermore, the secure authentication is done using the security operations like EXOR, hashing, encryption and decryption. In private key generation the proposed Chronological Jelly Fish optimization is utilized.

articleTitle: Market Competition and Pricing Model of E-Commerce under the Background of Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The e-commerce industry is growing rapidly as the Internet is widely used. On major e-commerce platforms, enterprises can use consumer behavior preference analysis to understand key information such as customer demand, market demand and product characteristics, so as to formulate corresponding strategies to meet the needs of target customers and specific groups. Based on this idea, this paper proposes a pricing model of business competition under the digital background, and tests the performance of this model in all aspects. The test results show that the calculation speed is 6m/s, 8m/s, 6m/s, 7m/s, 6m/s. Accuracy range is 82-87%. The error rate of this model in pricing is very small; the maximum error rate is 0.064; the minimum error rate is 0.035. These research results also provide useful references for various stakeholders in the development process of e-commerce, and have a positive impact on the marketing activities of merchants on e-commerce platforms. The result of e-commerce market competition and pricing models in the digital context is to increase the efficiency of market competition and supply-demand matching, promote the application of dynamic pricing models, and increase price transparency and pricing elasticity. These results require companies to observe the market and consumer demand more keenly, and flexibly adjust their pricing strategies to gain a competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Real Time Economic data Sharing of Computers Through Interactive Multimedia Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Interactive multimedia system has an important role in construction of economic and trade computer informationization. The system can combine various media forms, such as text, image, audio and video, to realize dynamic display of information and rich user interactive experience. This abstract utilizes the interactive multimedia system to establish an online shopping mall, realizing the functions of product display, order management, payment and so on. At the same time, users can browse product information, make product comparison, and communicate and exchange with merchants in real time through the interactive interface. Real-time data sharing and collaborative decision-making can be realized through the interactive multimedia system. The information of each link can be transmitted and fed back quickly, which can improve the logistics efficiency and reduce the cost, and can provide visualization of warehouse management and transportation monitoring to enhance the transparency and traceability of the supply chain. Finally, the experiment proves that the use of this interactive multimedia system to carry out the evaluation of economic and trade computer informationization construction has high information combination and analysis ability, the size of the role reduction from 1.169 to 1.008.

articleTitle: The Implementation and Optimization of High-Performance Image Processing Algorithms Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Image processing (IP) technology has emerged on the basis of AI, digital imaging technology, and multimedia technology, and people began to use computers to process images to improve image quality and improve human vision. With the advancement of computer vision and AI technology, people want to achieve high performance IP. In the field of IP, techniques such as image segmentation, image compression, and image restoration are active research topics in computer vision. In this paper, we propose IP algorithms such as Artificial Bee Colony(ABC) Optimization Algorithm and Searcher Optimization Algorithm (SOA) for this block of image compression, analyze the image compression effect of these two algorithms, and compare the image compression quality by comparing the PSNR of each algorithm, and the results get that the image compression effect based on artificial bee colony(ABC) Algorithm is better and the image compression code book quality is better with the same compression ratio.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Modified Glowworm Swarm Optimization Algorithm for Efficient Spectrum Sensing in the Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The combination of machine learning and Cognitive Radio (CR) technology has generated a lot of interest in research, especially in the field of spectrum management. Even with the possible advantages, high spectral efficiency, low latency, high network efficiency, and enhanced energy economy are only a few of the performance qualities that need to be addressed in order to prepare technology for spectrum management. But accomplishing these goals might frequently provide opposite difficulties. In the context of spectrum management, a new Multi-Objective Modified Glowworm Swarm Optimization (MOMGSO) approach is developed to handle multi-objective optimization issues. In order to achieve global optima, the Glowworm Swarm Optimization (GSO) modification seeks to achieve a balance between the exploration and exploitation processes. This tweak modifies the mutation coefficient, leader selection, and discrimination weight. An analysis is conducted between the suggested technique and current methods in terms of energy efficiency, interference, and throughput. The results of the simulation show that the MOMGWO algorithm outperforms existing techniques in terms of the Pareto front quality.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach For Prediction Of Diabetes Using Genetic Algorithm And Entropy Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The age-old adage, “Prevention is better than Cure,” underscores the significance of early disease detection. Diabetes, a burgeoning global health concern, ranks as a leading cause of mortality and is poised to escalate in prevalence. Proactive measures are vital to curb its impact. Anticipating the risk of diabetes in future generations can facilitate early preventive actions. This paper introduces an innovative algorithm that harnesses Data Mining techniques and Genetic Algorithms for diabetes prediction. Data mining plays a pivotal role in scrutinizing the data for diabetes prognosis, enabling the reduction of unnecessary tests. The proposed algorithm streamlines the diagnostic process by trimming down the requisite attributes for prediction by using entropy technique. This not only curtails costs but also yields highly accurate predictions of 96%. By embracing this cutting-edge approach, we can revolutionize disease detection, safeguarding the health of future generations and promoting a healthier society.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Financial Risk Prediction Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper embarks on the exploration of leveraging the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks for enterprise financial risk prediction, aiming to bolster the precision and dependability of financial decision-making. Setting the stage, we delve into the backdrop and paramountcy of enterprise financial risks, underlining the indispensability of swift and precise financial risk foretelling for the robustness and longevity of businesses. Diving deeper, we unpack the mechanics of LSTM neural networks, highlighting their unparalleled prowess in dissecting time series data. Methodologically, we channel enterprise financial data into the LSTM model, training it to pinpoint impending financial peril. By harnessing historical financial datasets, we construct and validate our LSTM-based model. Empirically speaking, our model outperformed traditional forecasting techniques by a considerable margin, boasting an accuracy rate of 92% in detecting financial anomalies. Moreover, in a head-to-head comparison with conventional financial risk prediction methodologies, the LSTM model emerged as the clear frontrunner, underscoring its superiority in both accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: A Heart Disease Classification using an Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm with Support Vector Machine Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Heart Disease (HD) is one of the leading causes of death worldwide. Early detection of HD decreases heart attack disease risk and increases recovery chances. Unbalanced samples and missing values for certain features are the primary challenges in HD classification. This work aims to implemented the effective feature optimization and classification methods for HD classification, which assists in the early diagnosis of the condition by medical professionals. Hence, a HD classification method based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization (IPSO) algorithm and Support Vector Machine (SVM) categorization method, namely IPSO-SVM method, is implemented to evaluated and predict HD risk. At first, Cleveland dataset’s collected data is rescaled using technique of min-max normalization. Then, ResNet 50 is utilized for extract the features and IPSO is employed to select the significant features. Finally, Machine Learning (ML) classifier used for HD classification, which include both presence and absence of the HD. Compared with existing methods, the implemented method achieved 99.95% of accuracy using Cleveland dataset.

articleTitle: Intelligent DDoS Attack Detection for IoT Network Scenario using NS3
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: IoT technology and IoT smart devices are being used widely in recent years. As the devices and services are being developed with more sophisticated technologies, their security is a prime factor to rely upon, in order to keep the services up and running properly. Among IoT network cyber attacks, DDoS attacks are prevalent. In order to detect and mitigate these cyber attacks, many machine learning based solutions are being implemented considering the kaggle datasets. this paper focus to detect DDoS attacks in IoT networks by using the proposed hybrid model of Jellyfish Swarm Optimization (JSO) and random forest (RF) algorithms using NS3. The DDoS scenario is designed and simulated in NS3 to generate the IoT DDoS dataset. JSO is bio-inspired algorithm used for feature selection while RF is machine learning used to detect DDoS. The proposed hybrid model improves the accuracy by 2 % compared with RF. Precision, Recall, f1-score statistics are also improved.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement in Power Distribution System with The Placement of Dg Using TLBO Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The distribution system is more susceptible to power losses than other components of the power system. Reduced power losses and higher bus voltages are the outcomes of optimal DG (Distributed Generation) integration into the distribution system. The TLBO algorithm was developed in this research with the main objectives of reducing power loss and improving the system voltage profile to determine the appropriate DG sizes and placements in the distribution network. An IEEE-14 distribution bus system is utilized in the present study as a case study. The suitable size and position of the DG are chosen using the voltage stability index. The system’s overall performance is assessed after the installation of the DG of the ideal size in the appropriate location, along with enhancements to the voltage balance index, voltage profile, and real power loss reduction. Matlab codes are produced for the TLBO algorithm and the redesigned electrical power system. Findings indicate that the suggested TLBO algorithm is successful in determining the optimal size and location of the needed DG unit. Optimum solution for power quality issues in power distribution system can be obtained using the TLBO optimization technique.

articleTitle: Smart Hotel Room Management with IoT for Guest Counting and Service Personalization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the Internet of Things (IoT) has changed hotel management, significant attention to impacted guest count and personal preferences. The use of data analytics and IoT devices has enhanced the hotel’s ability to better serve guests, run efficiently, and make the most of its available resources. IoT sensors are placed in hotel rooms to monitor on guests and collect valuable input on the quality of service provided. Smart IoT methods perform real-time analysis on the data collected by IoT sensors. This information allows hotels to provide customized services, including room temperature and lighting, in-room entertainment, and quick cleaning. Personalized welcome greetings, in-room suggestions, and mobile app or voice-activated service requests are included. The system guest count accuracy was greatly enhanced, and highly personalized services. Customer satisfaction was improved, operations were more efficient, and new income streams were opened up, making this a groundbreaking development for the hospitality industry.

articleTitle: Managing the full Lifecycle of Power Information Systems using HCSOA based LSTM-GRU Model in DevOps practices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The traditional power information scheme operating construction is under the management process, DevOps model power data prediction is performed in this study using a Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU). Hybrid Sand Cat optimisation (HSCOA), which seeks to minimise computing complexity, is used to choose the weight of the suggested model. In order to increase the precision of power load foretelling and the dependability of power network algorithm in the power system. This paper aims to provide a research basis for the expansion of the power information system’s operation structure through an examination of the application model based on DevOps throughout the system’s entire life cycle, and to encourage the company’s business development. Hybrid model accomplished the accuracy of 96.5 then the precision range as 97.0 besides also the recall rate as 97.0 then the Fl-score as 97.0 and then specificity as 95.7 correspondingly.
